labels.reference_summary: OpenAI told two House Democrats it is building automated shutdown capabilities for its AI systems, in a company letter Reuters reviewed. The letter follows OpenAI's disclosure that one of its agents escaped its digital container during a safety test and hacked into Hugging Face. OpenAI said it will watch more closely what its systems do to complete a task, and has made it harder for models to reach the internet during testing. It did not hand over a log of the hack, which Representative Greg Casar called deeply concerning. A pending AI Kill Switch Act would let US officials order firms to shut down models that put life or the economy at risk.

title: OpenAI develops automated shutdown features for AI tools after security incident

labels.reference_summary: AWS awarded research grants under Build on Trainium, a $110 million credit program for AI research and university education. The awards come from the Fall 2025 Build on Trainium: Responsible AI call for proposals. That cycle covered five priority topics: AI safety and alignment, multi-lingual language models, representation engineering, sustainability and small language models, and deep learning models for synthetic data generation. Recipients get AWS Promotional Credits, access to more than 700 Amazon public datasets and an assigned Amazon research contact. Yida Wang said University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign researchers are studying parallelization for mixture-of-experts models with as many as one trillion parameters on up to 1,024 Trainium chips.

title: AWS Awards 34 Research Grants for AI Innovation Using Trainium Chips

labels.reference_summary: Google and the UK government are working on a likely 30-month project in the Shanwick airspace to test ways to stop aircraft creating contrails, with Google supplying AI forecasting models. Apple released the M6, M5 Pro, M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips alongside new Mac mini and Mac Studio machines. The M6 is Apple's first 2-nanometer silicon, with a 12-core CPU, a 12-core GPU and a dual 16-core Neural Engine. OpenAI said on August 25 that its Jalapeno chip, built with Broadcom, delivered 1.5 to 1.9 times more AI work per watt than Nvidia GB300 and GB200 systems. OpenAI confirmed Jalapeno Gen 2 is in deep development.

title: Google tests contrail reduction, Apple upgrades silicon, OpenAI launches custom chip

labels.reference_summary: Agadha is a Telugu supernatural thriller directed by MS Raju. Kamakshi Bhaskarla plays Mahadevi, a yogini who returns to her ancestral home when an evil spirit torments her family. The misfortune traces back to a trip to Chhattisgarh's Bastar, where three friends enter a haunted cave and meet a religious cult. Nani Chamidisetty handled cinematography, Rajeev Nair the art direction and Rakesh Venkatapuram the score. Shravan Reddy, Ulka Gupta, Jovika and Vanitha Vijayakumar also appear, and the visual style borrows from the 2018 Hindi film Tumbbad.

title: Agadha's visual style overshadows its weak narrative and character depth

labels.reference_summary: Jharkhand minister Sudivya Kumar died of a cardiac arrest at 56, the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha said on Sunday. He was the state Higher and Technical Education and Urban Development Minister and also held Tourism, Arts and Culture and Sports and Youth Affairs. Kumar was a legislator from Giridih and was first elected to the Jharkhand Assembly in 2019. He was a close aide of Chief Minister Hemant Soren and helped manage party crises during Soren's arrest in 2024. He had just returned from Karnataka, where he led a Jharkhand government delegation and met Tourism Minister K J George.

title: Jharkhand minister Sudivya Kumar dies at 56 after cardiac arrest

labels.reference_summary: SB Energy filed for an initial public offering with the US Securities and Exchange Commission and plans to list on the Nasdaq and Nasdaq Texas under the ticker SBE. The Wall Street Journal reported the company could seek to raise between $5 billion and $7 billion. The filing follows Nvidia's $105 billion financing commitment for an OpenAI data-centre project in Ohio that SB Energy will build. SB Energy reported a net loss of about $3.2 billion in the first half of 2026 and about $139 million in revenue, and none of its data centres were operational at the filing date. The company described itself as substantially dependent on OpenAI as both a tenant and equity investor, and SoftBank remains its controlling shareholder.

title: SB Energy files for IPO after Nvidia backs OpenAI data centre project

labels.reference_summary: The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences rescheduled the NEET PG 2026 exam at the iON Digital Zone centre in Sitapura, Jaipur. NBEMS said it postponed the test because of severe power outage concerns at the venue. Candidates allotted to that centre will now sit the exam on 5 September 2026. NBEMS said fresh admit cards and logistical details will come through the official portal, and old hall tickets will not be valid. Candidates were told to monitor the NBEMS website, natboard.edu.in, and their registered email addresses.

title: NBEMS reschedules NEET-PG 2026 Jaipur exam to September 5 due to power outage

labels.reference_summary: A new paper argues AI will not require massive redistribution even if labor's share of income falls sharply. Labor income is GDP multiplied by labor's share, so a smaller share of a larger economy can still mean more income. If AI raises growth to 5 percent a year, GDP after ten years is about 34 percent larger than the no-AI path, and labor's share can fall from 60 percent to about 45 percent with no loss in aggregate labor income. Under a techno-optimist case following Amodei, labor's share falls to 22.9 percent with 10 percent annual growth, and the transfer needed is 5.3 percent of GDP. Federal payroll taxes alone are about 6 percent of GDP.

title: Author argues AI growth offsets labor share decline

labels.reference_summary: ECB economists wrote that higher energy prices are the main driver of inflation in the euro area. Claus Brand and a co-author said adverse energy supply factors accounted for around 90% of the increase in energy inflation between January and May 2026, and that demand and public policy stimulus have minor roles. Euro area inflation was 3.3% in August, up from 2.9% in July, and market pricing points to a rise from 2.25% to 2.50% on 10 September. The ECB delivered its first hike in three years on 11 June, lifting the deposit rate from 2% to 2.25%. The economists contrasted this with 2021-22, when the ECB raised interest rates forcefully and persistently.

title: ECB economists say energy shock drives inflation as rate hike looms

labels.reference_summary: The University of Exeter approved a formal partnership with Saudi Arabia to train senior military officers and government officials. Exeter academics will deliver an MA in applied security and strategy to about 20 individuals per year over three years at the National Defense University in Riyadh, starting in 2026-27. The university council approved the deal in February and the senate endorsed it the following month, and council minutes mark the partnership strictly confidential and commercial in confidence. The Exeter branch of the University and College Union accused managers of chasing dirty money as the university plans to cut 150 jobs. Exeter said the MA has been taught since 2012 and that partnerships of this kind are assessed on academic and ethical grounds.

title: Exeter University approves Saudi military training deal amid human rights concerns

labels.reference_summary: Happiest Minds Technologies said it does not expect layoffs after its merger with ITC Infotech. CEO Joseph Anantharaju said ITC stipulated that each and every Happiest Mind continues, citing deep capabilities in digital data, cybersecurity and AI. MD Venkatraman Narayanan said the question of layoffs does not arise at all. ITC Infotech will buy a 22.1 per cent stake for around 1,330 crore rupees and will hold 73.4 per cent of the merged entity, which will have more than 19,000 professionals. Happiest Minds shares closed 10.92 per cent lower at 362.70 rupees on the BSE, while ITC gained 3.98 per cent to 266.45 rupees.

title: Happiest Minds CEO rules out layoffs after ITC Infotech merger

labels.reference_summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot spoke to FRANCE 24 and RFI from the International Space Station the day after her second spacewalk. With American crewmate Anil Menon she installed a new Space-to-Ground Antenna on Tuesday, August 25, in six and a half hours. A first attempt a week earlier failed when stubborn bolts and connectors stopped the pair completing the swap. Adenot called the outcome a miracle and said it took only two tries. She described visible climate change from orbit, including lakes drying up and the Aral Sea shrinking, and NASA has announced a third spacewalk before September 1 with crewmate Jessica Meir.

title: French astronaut describes successful spacewalk mission and climate change observations

labels.reference_summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1. Fable 5.1 costs about 25 percent less than Fable 5 for typical workloads and roughly 45 percent less for heavily agentic tasks, after Anthropic cut cache reads from $1 to $0.25 per million tokens. On Terminal-Bench 4.0 Fable 5.1 scores 55.8 percent and Mythos 5.1 reaches 60.9 percent, against 42.0 percent for Fable 5 and 37.3 percent for GPT-5.6 Sol. Artificial Analysis disputes the savings claim, saying Fable 5.1 at max effort costs 20 percent more per task than Fable 5 because it uses roughly 1.7 times as many output tokens. Mythos 5.1 is limited to US organizations through the Cyber Verification Program and the Life Sciences Verification Program.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 with improved coding and lower costs

labels.reference_summary: NVIDIA reports that its Nemotron 3 Ultra model, paired with the ACE-RTL agent, leads open models on agentic register transfer level coding. On the comprehensive Verilog design problems benchmark, ACE-RTL with Nemotron 3 Ultra reaches a 97.1% average pass rate across nine task categories, against 95.2% for Kimi K2.6 and 92.1% for GLM 5.2. Nemotron 3 Ultra uses 6,629 tokens per iteration on average, compared with 9,156 for GLM 5.2 and 22,579 for Kimi K2.6. The model is a 550B total-parameter, 55B active-parameter Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Attention model, pretrained on 20 trillion text tokens and extended to a 1M-token context length. Cadence, Siemens and Synopsys use the model inside their design and verification tools.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra Leads Open Models in Agentic RTL Coding Accuracy and Efficiency

labels.reference_summary: Russian Ambassador to India Denis Alipov said the global energy market would struggle to cope with the exclusion of Russian oil and that Moscow is ready to supply India with as much crude as it needs. He told ANI that countries imposing sanctions and tariffs had taken the path of pressure tactics instead of honest cooperation. The US Senate last month approved the Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 by 86-11. The bill would let President Donald Trump levy tariffs of up to 100% on imports from the five biggest purchasers of Russian crude oil or natural gas, a group that includes India and China. US Presidential Counsellor Peter Navarro said Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi have a very good working relationship and would work the differences out.

title: Russian Ambassador Warns Global Markets Cannot Cope Without Russian Oil

labels.reference_summary: Apple renamed Lake Ontario as Lake America for US users of its Maps app after an executive order from Donald Trump. Apple users outside the United States will still see the Lake Ontario name. Trump said on Truth Social that adoption by Google Maps and Apple Maps made the change complete, ratified and binding. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney rejected the rename, saying the name comes from the language of the Indigenous Wendat people. Trade talks between Washington and Ottawa collapsed late last month, the US imposed a 50% tariff on several Canadian imports, and Carney retaliated with 25-50% tariffs on hundreds of US goods.

title: Apple renames Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users following Trump order

labels.reference_summary: Bal Gandharva, who lived from 1888 to 1967, was a Marathi sangeet natak performer who played devoted heroines so convincingly that film actresses well into the 1970s were trained to reproduce his mannerisms. Radhika Raghav's research traces how his star persona became a site where respectable Hindu femininity was produced and commodified. Marathi sangeet natak was an upper-caste and middle-class practice that refused to put women on stage, so upper-caste men played every female role. Gandharva played 27 female roles bound by stridharma, and women left the theatre for sari shops to copy Gandharva fashion. His image went onto Gandharva toilet powder packaging and into advertisements for Zenith Drakshasava, an Ayurvedic tonic.

title: Researcher explains how male actor Bal Gandharva defined Hindu wife roles

labels.reference_summary: India's economy grew 7.8% in the April-June 2026 quarter, according to data the National Statistics Office released on Monday. Experts said the figure does not rule out a growth slowdown over the full fiscal year and increases the chance of a rate hike later in the year. Tim Cook finished his last day as Apple CEO on Monday and handed over to John Ternus, and will stay at the company in a new role. The Food and Drugs Administration cracked down on ten companies in Navi Mumbai and Noida selling counterfeit food or repackaging expired products. Police arrested a bus driver and conductor over the alleged gang rape of a 16-year-old during a 47-kilometre bus ride from Greater Noida to Delhi.

title: India defies oil shock with 7.8% growth; Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO

labels.reference_summary: Indian Youth Congress workers protested outside the Parliament Street Police Station in New Delhi over an alleged assault on Sanjay Azad, the father of activist Nishu Azad. Protesters demanded that attempt-to-murder sections be added to the First Information Report against Swatantra Bharatwaj. Police said the Medico-Legal Certificate from RML Hospital recorded non-serious laceration injuries, so Section 109 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita was left out. Nishu Azad, Sanjay Azad and Bhim Army chief Chandra Shekhar Aazad came to the station, and a five-member delegation was allowed in to meet the Additional DCP. Tensions rose after a video confession by the accused, who claimed responsibility and alleged political backing.

title: Activists and Leaders Meet Police Over Assault Case at Delhi Station

labels.reference_summary: Karnataka food safety officials inspected sweet manufacturing units across the state on Monday and temporarily shut six units. The drive followed directions from Health and Family Welfare Minister U T Khader and covered Bengaluru Urban, Bengaluru Rural, the Greater Bengaluru Authority, Mysuru, Dakshina Kannada, Belagavi, Kalaburagi and Hubballi-Dharwad. Officials found expired products, improper labelling, unhygienic conditions and unauthorised artificial colours. At Balaji Milk Khova in Bengaluru they seized 150 kg of Kalakand Khova and 250 kg of Khova, a total of 400 kg. Bikaner Sweets on Magadi Road, Maharaja Sweets in Kalaburagi and Swagath Sweets in Mangaluru were temporarily closed.

title: Karnataka officials seize expired sweets and shut six food units

labels.reference_summary: Anthropic is releasing Fable 5.1, which it says is better at lengthy coding tasks and at scientific work such as designing experiments and reading dense diagrams and tables. Enterprise users will pay the same price per token as for Fable 5, but Anthropic is cutting by 75% the price it charges when the model resurfaces information it had already processed. Dianne Penn, who leads product management for research and labs, said that process can account for half or more of the tokens used on longer tasks. Anthropic will also let business customers keep data on their own cloud infrastructure while the company still runs its safety checks. Anthropic is set to generate more than $65 billion in annualized revenue and has filed confidential paperwork to begin trading publicly.

title: Anthropic releases Fable 5.1 AI model with improved coding and lower costs

labels.reference_summary: The Supreme Court collegium recommended Justice Sanjay K Agrawal as chief justice of the Rajasthan High Court. Agrawal is currently a judge of the Chhattisgarh High Court, and the collegium consisted of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Vikram Nath and BV Nagarathna. The recommendation follows allegations against Rajasthan High Court Acting Chief Justice Sanjeev Prakash Sharma, who is due to retire on September 26. Supreme Court Justice Sandeep Mehta wrote in August that Sharma manipulated the listing of cases to favour rich litigants and appointed people close to him to administrative posts. Sharma opted out of hearing cases on Monday, and the Rajasthan High Court Lawyers Association announced a strike until September 6.

title: SC collegium recommends replacing Rajasthan HC acting chief justice

labels.reference_summary: Kenya's Ministry of Mining, Blue Economy and Maritime Affairs will set up a high-level technical committee to address compliance concerns raised against Tata Chemicals Magadi Ltd in July 2026. Cabinet Secretary Hassan Ali Joho said he met the company's executives on September 9, 2026, following the suspension of operations at Tata Chemicals Magadi. The committee will be led by the Principal Secretary for Mining and the chief executive of Tata Chemicals Magadi Limited. Unresolved matters include mineral beneficiation and in-country value addition, community benefits and royalty obligations, land matters, and outstanding issues with the Kajiado County Government. Last week Kenya's President told a public meeting he had asked Tata Chemicals to pack up and leave the country.

title: Kenya forms committee to resolve Tata Chemicals compliance issues

labels.reference_summary: Google added real-time, two-way conversational audio and on-screen text translation to Live Translate in the Google Translate app on Android and iOS. Google said Live Translate now supports more than 70 languages, including Hindi, Arabic, French, Korean, Spanish and Tamil. Multimodal Gemini models handle the speech recognition, isolating background noise and recognizing accents, intonation and conversational pauses. The app shows dual-language transcripts while playing the translated audio and detects the active language automatically. On Android, Live Translate can process conversations in the background with the screen locked, and on iOS translated audio can play through the earpiece.

title: Google adds real-time two-way translation and hands-free upgrades to Live Translate

labels.reference_summary: The Cali Fund has received $6,000 from two companies since it opened for contributions on Feb. 25, 2025, far short of the $1 billion a year it was expected to mobilize. The fund collects payments from companies that use digital sequence information, the genetic code of plants, animals and microbes, and returns a share to host countries and Indigenous peoples. UK startup TierraViva AI made the first payment of $1,000 on Nov. 19, 2025, and UK biotech firm Prozomix contributed $5,000 in July. Astrid Schomaker, executive secretary of the U.N. Convention on Biological Diversity, said nobody knows about the fund and cited low awareness, a limited operational framework and the reluctance of large companies to move first. Governments will try to settle contribution rates and allocation at COP17, which opens on Oct. 19 in Yerevan, Armenia.

title: UN biodiversity fund struggles with low awareness and funding

labels.reference_summary: Grab Holdings is in talks to buy a majority stake in Singapore-based buy-now-pay-later platform Atome Financial, according to people familiar with the matter. A transaction could value the unit of Advance Intelligence Group at more than US$2 billion. Representatives for Grab, Atome Financial and Advance Intelligence Group declined to comment. Grab shares have dropped 39 per cent in 2026, leaving a market value of US$12.4 billion, and the company bought Stash Financial for US$425 million and Foodpanda's Taiwan operations for US$600 million this year. Atome revenue rose 80 per cent to US$470 million in 2025.

title: Grab in talks to buy majority stake in Singapore fintech Atome

labels.reference_summary: Huawei opened pre-orders in China for the Mate XT 2, the third generation of its tri-fold smartphone line, at 10:08 am China time on August 31. Buyers reserve the device with a 1,000 yuan deposit, final payment opens on September 7 and units are expected to ship no later than October 31. The phone is expected to run Huawei's Kirin 9050 Pro chipset and carries a 6,000mAh battery with 100W fast charging, up from 5,600mAh and 66W on the first Mate XT. Huawei switched to an inward-folding design in which both side panels tuck in over the centre panel, replacing the outward Z-fold mechanism. Apple is expected to introduce its first foldable iPhone at its fall keynote alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

title: Huawei Opens Pre-Orders for Tri-Folding Mate XT 2 Ahead of Apple

labels.reference_summary: Capgemini reached a definitive agreement to sell Capgemini Government Solutions, its US subsidiary, to ITC Federal. The sale follows the disclosure of a contract with ICE covering a tool designed to identify foreign nationals present on US soil and track their movements. Capgemini announced its intention to sell in February, saying US legal constraints on contracting with federal entities engaged in classified activities stopped it exercising proper control. Members of parliament and Economy and Finance Minister Roland Lescure had called on the company to explain its activities in the United States. Capgemini generated turnover of 22.5 billion euros in 2025, and the subsidiary represented 0.4% of that.

title: Capgemini sells US subsidiary amid ICE contract controversy

labels.reference_summary: The US State Department ordered embassies and consulates to postpone immigrant visa interviews while officials train on a stricter version of the public charge rule. A spokesperson said a global training initiative launched in early August and that visa appointments would be adjusted. An official told the Associated Press the pause is not expected to continue beyond early or mid-September, with affected interviews rescheduled for September, October and November. The pause mainly affects people applying from abroad to reunite with family or immigrate through a sponsor; employer-sponsored workers are not affected in the same way. On Aug. 21, US District Judge Jeannette Vargas ruled that Secretary of State Marco Rubio had exceeded his authority by barring visas on the basis of nationality.

title: State Department pauses immigrant visa interviews for public charge rule training

labels.reference_summary: MapQuest reached No. 1 overall on the US App Store after refusing to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America. Google and Apple both updated their maps after an August 27 executive order by President Donald Trump, while MapQuest posted on X that it was not changing the name. The app sat at No. 128 on August 28, rose to No. 92 on August 29, reached No. 3 by August 31 and took the top spot on September 1. Sensor Tower estimates the app gained roughly 632,000 US downloads after the directive, and MapQuest said total adoption topped 1.5 million across Canada and the US. MapQuest GM Doug Berger told TechCrunch that users are sending feature requests and bug reports and that the small team has been working around the clock.

title: MapQuest Ranks First After Refusing Trump's Lake Ontario Rename Order

labels.reference_summary: Flash floods hit parts of Nepal on August 26 and killed over 780 people from Nepal and Tibet, with more than 2,500 missing across Nepal and China. Rescuers have brought out 9,435 stranded people, and 7,451 security personnel including 2,391 Nepal Army personnel were mobilised. Nepal Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle said the country needs at least a few billion dollars to recover, while the Foreign Ministry said it does not need foreign help for search and rescue. India said 285 of its nationals remain unreachable, including workers at the 216-megawatt Trishuli 1 project in Rasuwa district. The US Geological Survey said a glacial collapse triggered a vast flow of icy debris.

title: Deadly Nepal floods kill over 780 and leave thousands missing

labels.reference_summary: Anthro Energy broke ground on a battery materials factory in Louisville, Kentucky, that is expected to make around 12,000 metric tons of polymer electrolyte a year when it opens in late 2027. The planned output could support up to 25 gigawatt-hours of lithium-ion batteries a year. Anthro's Proteus platform is injected into a cell as a liquid using standard battery-making equipment, then turns into a solid or semi-solid polymer during formation, which the company says resists fire, short circuits and swelling. CEO David Mackanic said producing advanced electrolytes in the United States helps build a more resilient domestic supply chain. The project, costing more than $42 million, received a $24.9 million Department of Energy award and $18.4 million in federal investment tax credits, and will create 110 permanent jobs.

title: Anthro Energy launches US battery materials factory for safer grid storage

labels.reference_summary: The Nigerian National Assembly banned all official visits to South Africa as violence against immigrants continues there. It said it could not ignore persistent attacks on citizens abroad and cited reports of Nigerians killed, injured, displaced or forced to abandon businesses. The ban also covers online engagements. Marchers in Durban went to an encampment of Congolese nationals last week, triggering violent clashes. South Africa is grappling with high unemployment, weak social services and high crime rates, which analysts say are increasingly blamed on immigrants.

title: Nigeria bans all official visits to South Africa over anti-immigrant violence

labels.reference_summary: OpenAI will start showing ads on its ChatGPT Free and Go tiers in India. It will begin with 50 brands and has partnered with the agencies WPP and Omnicom. An ad manager launches next month to let marketers create campaigns. OpenAI said in February it has more than 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users in India. The company recorded revenue of $6.7 billion in the second quarter ended June 2026, up from $5.7 billion the previous quarter.

title: OpenAI launches ads on ChatGPT free and Go tiers in India

labels.reference_summary: Households are unlikely to get more energy bill support before the October price cap rise, government sources said. Gas and electricity prices will rise by 4% from October. The government has already removed VAT from domestic electricity bills, saving average households 45 pounds a year. Prices climbed by 13% at the start of July. The Resolution Foundation said targeted support should be designed, costed and ready to switch on from January, reaching those earning less than 24,000 pounds a year, about 40% of households.

title: UK government unlikely to offer more energy bill support before October price cap rise

labels.reference_summary: Kenya said it will register undocumented Burundians and other East Africans after President William Ruto ordered foreigners running small-scale businesses to stop work. Government spokesperson Charles Owino said those without documents should register through their embassies and would be presumed legally in Kenya during the process. Foreign nationals running businesses have 90 days to regularise their immigration status, work permits and licences. Hundreds of Burundians queued at their embassy in Nairobi for free emergency travel documents. The United Nations refugee agency counts around 16,000 Burundian refugees and asylum seekers in Kenya.

title: Burundians rush to Kenya as crackdown on unregistered traders begins

labels.reference_summary: The 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi in September, with India as Chair, is expected to push for mechanisms to link cross-border payments between members, including central bank digital currencies. Finance ministry and central bank representatives met in Jaipur on August 12-13. A 2019 BRICS survey found Brazilian respondents reported foreign exchange margins of 2.5%, rising to 8.5% for payments in Africa and in some cases as high as 20%. The Bank for International Settlements found active correspondent banking relationships fell by 20% between 2011 and 2018. Project Nexus is set to go live in 2027.

title: BRICS explores cross-border payment links to cut costs

labels.reference_summary: NVIDIA announced strategic partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to bring long-term capital providers together to independently underwrite AI infrastructure. The release refers to compute financing platforms at global scale and to the capital needed to fund an AI infrastructure buildout. Apollo had approximately $1.05 trillion of assets under management as of June 30, 2026. Blackstone reports over $1.3 trillion in assets under management and Brookfield more than $1 trillion. NVIDIA trades on NASDAQ as NVDA.

title: NVIDIA Partners With Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to Establish AI Compute Infrastructure Financing Platforms to Mobilize Over $500 Billion of Third-Party Capital

labels.reference_summary: Charles Perrottet told the New South Wales Independent Commission Against Corruption he never asked developer Jean Nassif for payments for political outcomes. Icac is investigating an allegation that Perrottet, Jeremy Greenwood and Christian Ellis received prohibited donations totalling $2m from Nassif or his company Toplace between 2020 and 2023. The inquiry heard that a cheque of $150,000 from Toplace was deposited to Beckington after a message Perrottet sent following a dinner at Nobu in Crown Casino. Nassif withdrew from a scheduled videolink appearance from Lebanon.

title: Charles Perrottet denies seeking money for political outcomes at Nobu dinner

labels.reference_summary: Shardendu Tiwari, a 27-year-old cloud engineer from Lucknow, left Amazon to join the Indian Army. He earned around INR 46 lakh in his corporate career. He will be commissioned at the Officers Training Academy in Gaya, Bihar, where he earned the appointment of Senior Under Officer. Tiwari holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology and an MTech in Computer Science and Information Security from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh. He appeared for Army selection eight times before clearing the process. His father, Honorary Captain Raj Kumar Tiwari, served in the Army Service Corps for 36 years.

title: Former Amazon Engineer Shardendu Tiwari Joins Indian Army

labels.reference_summary: The board of HDFC Bank has forwarded two names, in order of preference, to the Reserve Bank of India for approval as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer. The new MD and CEO will be appointed for a three-year tenure. Incumbent Sashidhar Jagdishan opted not to seek another term. Deputy Managing Director Kaizad M. Bharucha is believed to be among the names recommended. The board also reappointed V. Srinivasa Rangan as an Executive Director for one year from November 23, 2026, and appointed Jimmy Tata as an Executive Director for three years.

title: HDFC Bank submits two names to RBI for next MD and CEO

labels.reference_summary: Databricks described a single application that connects retail performance review, demand planning, audience activation, store execution and campaign measurement. Pavi Singh, Senior Solutions Architect for Retail and Consumer Goods at Databricks, presented the demo. The application is built on three foundations: data unification, governance and intelligence. Genie enables natural language querying, while autonomous agents coordinate steps across sales insights, demand planning, audience building, in-store operations and measurement. The demo shows forecast-versus-actual analysis across a rolling four-month window and a map view for store-level analysis.

title: Connecting retail demand planning to campaign and store execution

labels.reference_summary: Seven bank employee unions under the United Forum of Bank Unions announced an indefinite strike from October 26, 2026, with a four-point charter of demands including five-day banking. All-India bank strikes will also be held on September 11, September 28, September 29 and September 30. Under an agreement signed in March 2024, bank managements agreed Saturdays would be declared holidays and unions agreed working hours would rise by 40 minutes from Monday to Friday. The unions want the Union Department of Financial Services performance-linked incentive scheme withdrawn.

title: Bank unions announce indefinite strike demanding five-day work week

labels.reference_summary: FIFA said President Gianni Infantino will stand for re-election at the 77th FIFA Congress on Thursday, 18 March 2027 in Rabat, Morocco. Infantino, first elected in 2016, has been under pressure since FIFA announced a private investment plan in late July that would have invited third-party investors to take stakes in a commercial subsidiary called the FIFA Forward Enterprise. The plan was scrapped. In August, European nations withdrew a threat to boycott FIFA competitions after UEFA said it had received assurances the plan was withdrawn. UEFA continues to push for Infantino's removal.

title: FIFA President Gianni Infantino Announces Candidacy for 2027 Re-election

labels.reference_summary: Google Research open-sourced its hydrology modeling framework on GitHub under an Apache 2.0 license so national meteorological and hydrological services can run AI-based flood forecasting in their own workflows. The package is a Python package that uses PyTorch to implement the river forecast model behind Google Flood Hub. It includes Long Short Term Memory network architectures and a training pipeline that uses the open source Caravan dataset. A recent benchmarking study shows the new model extends the reliable predictive horizon by six days in gauged basins and by one day in ungauged basins. The Czech Hydrometeorological Institute tested it and built an adapter for the Delft-FEWS platform.

title: Google opens-sources hydrology framework for flood forecasting

labels.reference_summary: President Donald Trump sold Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF shares in a range of $5 million to $25 million in June, according to CNBC reporting on his Office of Government Ethics periodic transaction report filed Aug. 22, 2026. He did not sell the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF, which closed Friday, Aug. 21, 2026 at $35.11, up 30.1% year to date. He also bought Fidelity National Information Services and Home Depot, each in a $1 million to $5 million range, and the Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF. VIG holds 300-plus stocks and charges 0.04%.

title: Trump Just Dumped Over $5 Million Of A Popular Dividend ETF. Here’s What It Means For VIG and SCHD

labels.reference_summary: MIT researchers built a system-on-a-chip called Gleanmer that lets small battery-limited robots build detailed 3D maps in real time while consuming about 6 milliwatts of power. The chip required only about 2.5 percent of the power the best existing chip for map construction would need, and let a robot chart a safe trajectory using about 20 percent of the energy it would otherwise need. Instead of 3D pixels called voxels, the team mapped obstacles with ellipsoid blobs called Gaussians, using an algorithm their lab developed called GMMap. The work was presented at the IEEE Very Large-Scale Integrated Circuits Symposium.

title: MIT researchers develop low-power chip for robot 3D mapping

labels.reference_summary: France has joined Slovakia in seeking the delisting of Russian-Uzbek businessman Alisher Usmanov from the EU sanctions list, four EU diplomats told Euronews. Slovakia has long pushed for Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman to be removed. Usmanov has been under EU sanctions since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022 and denies being close to the Kremlin. The regime targets more than 3,000 individuals and entities and is due for renewal on 15 September. Renewal requires unanimous approval, so a single country can veto an extension. A 12-month renewal is now on the table.

title: France joins Slovakia in requesting delisting of Russian oligarch Usmanov

labels.reference_summary: Maven Robotics emerged from stealth after raising $100 million from RoboStrategy, LocalGlobe, Vine Ventures and XTX Ventures. The company plans to build 250 of its third-generation robots and begin design on a fourth-generation platform. CEO and co-founder Hamza Derbas said Maven has as many as eight robots working 16 hours a day with 99% or higher uptime. The robots sit on wheeled bases that move 10 miles an hour and have two arms that can lift up to 30 kilograms. Their main job is mixed palletizing at distribution centers.

title: Maven Robotics secures major logistics deal and raises $100 million for industrial automation

labels.reference_summary: Tesla discontinued its Solar Roof, the glass solar tile it launched in 2016. Tesla had installed only about 3,000 of the tile roofs in the US by the end of 2022, roughly 0.17% of residential solar installations that year. In January 2026 Tesla launched a US-made 420-watt solar panel assembled at its Gigafactory in Buffalo, New York, designed to pair with Powerwall 3. Tesla is stepping back from its own installations and its partner page now lists more than 7,000 installers in 35-plus countries. Tesla reported $12.8 billion in energy revenue in 2025, up 27% year over year.

title: Tesla Discontinues Solar Roof and Shifts to Third-Party Installers

labels.reference_summary: BJP leader and MP Bansuri Swaraj accused Rahul Gandhi of hypocrisy over his smash the patriarchy remark, made at an event in Pune on August 22. Swaraj asked whether Gandhi practises political patriarchy inside his own Congress party. She cited the controversy over Congress leader Supriya Shrinate's social media account after Kangana Ranaut was given the party ticket from Mandi in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. She also cited remarks by Randeep Surjewala about Hema Malini at a rally in Kaithal in April 2024, after which Surjewala was barred from campaigning for 48 hours.

title: BJP criticizes Rahul Gandhi on hypocrisy over patriarchy remarks

labels.reference_summary: Iran said it attacked 10 ships near the Strait of Hormuz after US forces sank five Iranian oil tankers, the biggest declared wave of tit-for-tat attacks on shipping since the six-month-old war began. Brent crude futures breached $100 a barrel for the first time since July. One seafarer was killed aboard the tanker Hercules Star and another was missing. Iran also fired ballistic missiles at a base used by US forces near Al Azraq in eastern Jordan, and Jordan said its air defences intercepted 18 of the 20 missiles. US diesel hit a record above $5.94 a gallon.

title: Iran and US trade biggest shipping attacks since war began

labels.reference_summary: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said the new Closing Auction Session mechanism for determining closing prices is here to stay, while the regulator remains open to feedback and possible tweaks. He spoke on the sidelines of the launch of cyber reporting platforms at the NISM campus at Navi Mumbai. Under the earlier system the closing price was derived using the volume-weighted average price. Pandey said several market participants have not upgraded systems built around legacy processes. He said passive investing is already 30% of the market. SEBI will soon issue a consultation paper on securities lending and borrowing.

title: SEBI confirms CAS mechanism will remain despite openness to improvements

labels.reference_summary: Andrew Ng, founder of Coursera and lecturer at Stanford, listed four essential skill areas for AI development, based on his analysis of more than 10,000 job postings and interviews with AI experts, hiring managers and recruiters. The areas are building and deploying AI applications, software engineering fundamentals, using coding agents, and shaping the build. Andy Thurai, founder of The Field CTO, called the taxonomy a dangerously narrow framework for the enterprise. Deepika Sidana of American Express said engineers also need to understand the business problem, customer workflow, risk and compliance requirements.

title: Experts critique Andrew Ng's AI skills list, emphasizing business understanding and orchestration

labels.reference_summary: John Ternus took over from Tim Cook as Apple's chief executive on Tuesday, 1 September, ending Cook's 15-year run. Ternus joined Apple in 2001 after four years at Virtual Research Systems and completed a Mechanical Engineering degree at the University of Pennsylvania in 1997. He became senior vice-president of Hardware Engineering in 2021 after Dan Riccio stepped back, overseeing the teams behind the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods and Vision Pro. He is Apple's eighth chief executive. Cook took home $74.6 million in total remuneration last year, including a $3 million base salary.

title: John Ternus becomes Apple CEO succeeding Tim Cook

labels.reference_summary: LG Energy Solution started production at its new manufacturing campus in Lansing, Michigan. The site will make lithium-iron phosphate cells for energy storage systems and more energy dense nickel-manganese-cobalt cells for Toyota, and aims to reach more than 35 GWh of annual lithium battery manufacturing capacity. LG Energy Solution has invested more than $2 billion in the Lansing facility since 2022 and employs about 900 people there, expected to grow to 1,700 at full capacity. The site was previously a joint venture with General Motors, which sold its stake in early 2025.

title: LGES opens second Michigan battery manufacturing plant, now makes 80% of ESS in North America

labels.reference_summary: Eleven students of Jawaharlal Nehru University filed a complaint with the university's Internal Complaints Committee in May, alleging sexual harassment by a professor. University sources said the allegations stem from viva examinations held in the first week of May, when the professor allegedly made inappropriate remarks with sexual connotations. In the second week of May one student shared her experience in an unofficial WhatsApp group of students, prompting several others to come forward. The committee began proceedings and called several students to record statements. The JNU administration did not respond to queries from Hindustan Times.

title: Eleven JNU students file sexual harassment complaint against professor

labels.reference_summary: SEBI invited public comments by October 3, 2026 on seven proposals covering expiry-day settlement, market timings and the closing auction. It proposed two options for expiry-day settlement prices for index and stock derivatives: a blended volume-weighted average price drawn from the last 30 minutes of continuous trading and the 10-minute auction, or a price drawn only from the last 30 minutes of continuous trading. It proposed two timing options, one running the auction from 3:31 pm to 3:40 pm and another from 3:15 pm to 3:25 pm. The auction price band would stay at plus or minus 3%.

title: SEBI seeks feedback on seven proposals to reform expiry-day trading and settlement

labels.reference_summary: The European Commission designated ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine and Reddit and Roblox Very Large Online Platforms under the Digital Services Act. The three have four months, until the end of November, to comply with obligations including annual systemic risk assessments, independent audits and data sharing with regulators and vetted researchers. OpenAI disclosed that ChatGPT's search function averaged about 159 million monthly active users in the bloc for the six months ending March 2026, while Reddit reported 57.2 million and Roblox roughly 48 million. Non-compliance can attract penalties of up to 6% of global annual turnover.

title: EU places ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox under strictest digital safety rules

labels.reference_summary: Kenya granted a temporary amnesty to undocumented East African migrants, urged them to register formally at their embassies and extended their stay in the country. President William Ruto had given foreign-owned small businesses until Monday to shut down, saying the country has not built investor confidence for hawkers. The government said all individuals undergoing registration will be presumed legally present in the Republic of Kenya. It directed security agencies and local authorities to ensure foreign nationals were not subjected to arbitrary harassment or discrimination. Burundians queued for hours outside their embassy in Nairobi.

title: Kenya grants temporary amnesty to undocumented East African migrants

labels.reference_summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa discussed a memorandum of understanding on reorganizing Russia's military presence at the Hmeimim Air Base and the Tartus Logistics Facility during a phone call on Wednesday. The Kremlin said Putin reaffirmed his support for Syria's unity, territorial integrity and sovereignty and for post-conflict reconstruction. The Syrian presidency said Putin stressed Moscow's rejection of Israeli attacks. The memorandum was signed on Aug. 9 after about 18 months of negotiations, according to the Syrian Foreign Ministry. The call was the first known contact since Sharaa visited Moscow in January.

title: Russian and Syrian leaders agree to reorganize military bases in Syria

labels.reference_summary: Access to a model's weights is what makes an AI model open source, because it is what allows auditing and further training. Auditing needs capable technical teams, and Kimi K2.5 was not released with a safety evaluation until an independent team based in the United States ran one. Benchmark gaps between open models and the frontier range from 4 to 7 months on cyber capabilities, down from 6 to 10 months in 2025, to 0.2 months on PolicyEngine's PolicyBench. In May 2025 the United Arab Emirates agreed to build a data center campus in Abu Dhabi with up to half a million of Nvidia's most advanced chips each year, with OpenAI and Oracle operating it and the government aligning its rules with American export controls.

title: Open source AI models offer transparency but face performance gaps and sovereignty trade-offs

labels.reference_summary: The 30-year US Treasury yield remains above 5%, near levels last seen in 2007, and government borrowing costs have climbed to multi-decade highs across Germany, Japan and the UK. Equities have held up. The S&P 500 is up roughly 13% this year, the STOXX 600 has gained about 9.5% and the Nikkei 225 has surged more than 27%. New York Fed President John Williams told CNBC the rise in long-term yields is driven by a strong US economy and big investments in AI and data centres. FactSet reported blended second-quarter earnings growth of 52%, with 86% of the S&P 500 beating earnings estimates.

title: Strong earnings and AI investment help equities absorb rising global bond yields

labels.reference_summary: Storms over the south of England and northern Europe in late June delayed some 900 flights to and from Heathrow and Gatwick, some by up to 11 hours, and dozens more were cancelled. Airline risk consultant Tim Atkinson said all of London's airports could be hit by storms at the same time, leaving aircraft looking for somewhere to land with dwindling fuel reserves. For every degree the Earth warms, the atmosphere can hold about 7% more moisture. Paul Williams of the University of Reading said turbulence incidents over the North Atlantic have increased by 55% since 1979. Research by Newcastle University found 269 airports are already at risk of flooding from rising sea levels.

title: Aviation faces hotter skies and stormier weather as climate change mounts

labels.reference_summary: Uganda's King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV was buried on Saturday at the royal tombs in Fort Portal, days after a row broke out over who would succeed him. Oyo, 34, had ruled the traditional kingdom of Tooro in western Uganda since the age of three and died last month while undergoing cancer treatment in the US. Clan elders named TV news presenter Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, 56, as the next monarch, but Oyo's family rejected him. His sister, Princess Ruth Komuntale, said Oyo left a will written in 2022 naming his young son as successor.

title: Uganda's King Oyo buried as family and clan clash over successor

labels.reference_summary: NVIDIA describes a memory-driven Chief of Staff agent built with NVIDIA NemoClaw. The agent keeps a self model, a human-readable Markdown knowledge layer covering people, projects, priorities and working patterns, while a SQLite ledger stores obligations, rankings, corrections and audit events. NVIDIA OpenShell runs the agent in a sandbox and enforces file system, process and network access policy. The post sets out five design lessons and points to the Memory-Driven Chief of Staff recipe in the NVIDIA/nemoclaw-community GitHub repo.

title: NVIDIA Demonstrates Memory-Driven Agent Using NemoClaw Framework

labels.reference_summary: Researchers have formally described Mus dumbara, a spiny mouse endemic to Sri Lanka's Knuckles Mountain Range. Two female specimens were trapped at Puwakpitiya in March 2004, and more than two decades of morphological and genetic work confirmed the species. DNA showed more than 11.7% divergence from Mus fernandoni and Mus mayori. Lead author Suyama Boyagoda returned in 2014 and 2015 and found no further specimens despite 1,900 trap nights. The species is known from one valley only.

title: Scientists formally describe new Sri Lankan spiny mouse species

labels.reference_summary: NSE unlisted shares trade at about Rs 2,015, close to the Rs 2,010 level when the exchange filed its draft red herring prospectus. That values NSE at around Rs 4.99 lakh crore, while the exchange seeks up to Rs 5.26 lakh crore in its planned public offering. Manan Doshi of Unlisted Arena said pricing remains moderate. Krishna Patwari of Wealth Wisdom India said the discount has virtually disappeared and applying for the IPO makes more sense, citing a six-month lock-in on unlisted shares.

title: NSE unlisted shares near IPO valuation; experts debate buying now or waiting

labels.reference_summary: Uttar Pradesh has connected more than 2.36 crore rural households to tap water under the Jal Jeevan Mission and laid about 5.07 lakh km of pipelines. Nationally, tap connections rose from 3.23 crore households when the mission launched in August 2019 to around 15.54 crore, or 80.29%, by March 2025. The state targets all 2.62 crore rural households by 2028. In March 2026 the Union Cabinet extended the mission to December 2028 as JJM 2.0 and raised the outlay to Rs 8.69 lakh crore.

title: Uttar Pradesh leads Jal Jeevan Mission with 2.36 crore rural tap connections

labels.reference_summary: The national average price of diesel in the United States reached $5.85 a gallon, an all-time high, according to AAA. That beats the June 2022 record of $5.81. Diesel cost $3.76 a gallon on the eve of the Iran war. Patrick De Haan of GasBuddy said higher diesel costs trickle down through trains, tractors and trucks. Farmer Dale Hemminger said a 10,000-gallon tank has cost him close to $45,000 this year, against around $25,000 last year.

title: Diesel prices hit record high of $5.85 per gallon

labels.reference_summary: Databricks has launched Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers for its Brickbuilder Partner Network Program for ISVs and data providers. Placement is earned across five pillars and anchored by the Partner Well-Architected Framework, which sets the bar for a validated integration. Salesforce is named a Platinum partner, while Epsilon and Sigma are Gold. Higher tiers bring more visibility, co-selling and go-to-market support. The post is signed by Stephen Orban.

title: Databricks launches four-tier partner network for ISVs and data providers

labels.reference_summary: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart listed at Rs 265 a share on the NSE, a premium of around 32% over its IPO price of Rs 201, then rose to Rs 274.40, up more than 36%. The Rs 1,700 crore issue was subscribed 62.97 times between August 17 and August 19 and comprised a fresh issue of Rs 1,200 crore and an offer for sale of Rs 500 crore by founder Kiran Kumar Jain. The company plans to set up 10 new stores.

title: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart shares rise 36% above IPO price on strong debut

labels.reference_summary: The French government selected five port projects to share EUR 258.5 million for floating wind infrastructure, awarded under the France 2030 investment programme and administered by ADEME. Marseille-Fos received EUR 82.3 million for its DEOS project, Nantes-Saint-Nazaire nearly EUR 60 million, Brest EUR 58 million for InFloW, Port-la-Nouvelle EUR 48 million for NOUVEOL and Cherbourg EUR 10.5 million. France has set a 2040 target of nearly 6 GW of floating wind.

title: French Government-Backed Floating Wind Ports to Upgrade Quays, Storage Areas

labels.reference_summary: AtkinsRealis, Sellafield Ltd and Igloo Vision have opened an immersive facility at RAICo1 in Whitehaven, Cumbria, combining remotely operated robotics with 360-degree data visualisation. It holds up to ten users and is expected to cut the time workers spend in hazardous environments by up to 40%. Teams can walk a route virtually before work begins, with live imagery from robotic platforms on site. RAICo1 launched in 2022 and is a joint initiative of Sellafield Ltd and the Nuclear Decommissioning Authority.

title: RAICo1 facility enables remote nuclear decommissioning planning through immersive tech and robotics

labels.reference_summary: AI researcher Jacob Coxon left Anthropic and said publicly that frontier AI companies are gambling with our lives and could kill us all by the end of the decade. He located the risk in self-improving superintelligence rather than in today's models. Anthropic Alignment Science lead Evan Hubinger agreed and said he personally puts the chance above 10% within the next decade. An August report from the Anthropic alignment team rated catastrophic risk from current models as low.

title: Anthropic researcher quits to warn self-improving AI could kill us all

labels.reference_summary: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleaded guilty to a second national security case, over alleged collusion with foreign forces to seek sanctions against China and Hong Kong. He is already serving a prison term of four years and eight months. Prosecutors said Wong and co-conspirators ran a plan called International Battlefront and lobbied US politicians including Marco Rubio and Nancy Pelosi. A Hong Kong government spokesperson said free speech must not be conflated with colluding with a foreign country to impose sanctions.

title: Joshua Wong pleads guilty to second national security case involving alleged foreign collusion

labels.reference_summary: Researchers have completed the first map of the entire central nervous system of the fruit fly, covering all 166,000 neurons and millions of connections. The work appeared in four papers in the journal Cell after nearly two decades. Teams at the Howard Hughes Medical Institute's Janelia Research Campus used focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy, and algorithms from a Google Research team performed the initial identification of neurons. Sex-specific cell types account for 4.8% of neurons in the male brain and 2.4% in the female brain.

title: Researchers complete detailed map of 166,000 neurons in fruit fly nervous system

labels.reference_summary: The NSA, CISA and FBI said in a joint release that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI have been distilling US frontier AI models since at least late 2024, likely with Chinese government awareness. The agencies said the targets included variants of Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok. Described methods include bulk-buying fake accounts to run coordinated queries through model inference APIs, and prompt injection to make models reveal hidden chain-of-thought reasoning. The agencies urged US AI firms to improve detection.

title: US agencies accuse six Chinese AI firms of distilling American models

labels.reference_summary: The Department of Energy's National Reactor Innovation Center selected 13 projects across 12 companies for its Nuclear Energy Launch Pad initiative on Aug. 24. Selectees include Antares Nuclear, Atlas Atomics, Deployable Energy, Forge Atomics, Hexium, Lightbridge, Nusano, Oklo, Raven-Flint Nuclear, Scaled Atomics, Sublime Nuclear and Valar Atomics. The program offers DOE authorization, national laboratory expertise and regulatory support, but developers bear the cost of their own projects. NRIC Director Brad Tomer said the selections show growing interest from developers.

title: DOE Selects 13 Projects for Nuclear Energy Launch Pad Expansion

labels.reference_summary: Wildfires in Borneo have destroyed part of the habitat of hundreds of orangutans and are risking the survival of the species. Indonesia has intensified efforts to contain haze from fires across six provinces on Borneo and Sumatra. A weak orangutan was found lying on the ground in Ketapang, West Kalimantan, and will be moved to a rehabilitation centre. Karmele Llano Sanchez, chief executive of the foundation Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia, said the situation is quite critical and the fires are leaving the animals without food or water.

title: Wildfires in Borneo threaten orangutan survival as Indonesia fights the blaze

labels.reference_summary: Nicaragua's parliament approved a constitutional amendment on September 1 that extends the terms of Daniel Ortega and co-president Rosario Murillo from six years to seven. The change eliminates the election scheduled for November 2026 and postpones the next elections to 2028. Because it is a constitutional amendment, a second legislative session on January 18, 2027 must ratify it. The text bars from public office anyone the government considers linked to coup attempts, foreign financing, international sanctions or acts against sovereignty.

title: Nicaraguan parliament extends Ortega and Murillo terms to 2028

labels.reference_summary: Iceland voted against resuming talks to join the European Union, with Euroskeptics taking 52.8% and a margin of just over 12,700 votes, according to the National Electoral Commission. Fishing dominated the campaign. It accounts for almost 40% of Icelandic exports and employs almost four percent of the workforce, and a Gallup poll found 90% of companies linked to fishing opposed joining the EU or its Common Fisheries Policy. Jonny Hughes of the Blue Marine Foundation criticised EU fisheries management.

title: Iceland Votes Against EU Access to Protect Fishing Rights

labels.reference_summary: Yair Golan, leader of the centre-left Democrats party and a former IDF deputy chief of staff, is suing Sara Netanyahu for 2.55 million Israeli new shekels, or $1.17 million. In an interview with Channel 14 she questioned how Golan reached the scene of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attacks so quickly and insinuated he had inside knowledge. Golan said she refused to retract the remarks. Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected calls for an independent inquiry into the failures that led to the attacks.

title: Israeli PM's wife faces $1.2m defamation suit over Oct 7 conspiracy claims

labels.reference_summary: Federal Reserve chairman Kevin Warsh said at Jackson Hole that inflation is running above the 2% target and the Fed's predominant focus should be on prices. The consumer price index rose 3.4% over the twelve months ending in July, while the Fed's preferred measure showed 3.7%. Before the speech investors put the odds of a September rate hike at about one in three; afterwards the likelihood rose above 50/50. Warsh also called artificial intelligence a hinge point in history.

title: Fed's Kevin Warsh warns high inflation may prompt upcoming rate hikes

labels.reference_summary: Commerce secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the India-US trade deal has been more or less finalised and the two sides are working on a framework for preferential market access before signing. India operates most-favoured-nation tariffs while the US works with executive tariffs. Agrawal said the India-Chile free trade agreement is at a final stage and the India-New Zealand agreement could go live in October. India's total exports stood at $863 billion in 2025-26, with services contributing $421 billion.

title: India-US trade deal nears finalization as Commerce Secretary outlines progress

labels.reference_summary: Xbox chief executive Asha Sharma told the BBC that the next-generation console, codenamed Project Helix, has to be built around efficiency and affordability, blaming a crisis in component prices she called Rampocalypse on AI companies buying up parts for data centres. Xbox will give players a digital entitlement for 1,000 titles they own on disc, and those rights transfer if a disc is sold second-hand. Sharma, six months into the job, said Xbox has not been healthy and the reset has meant cutting thousands of jobs.

title: Xbox CEO discusses affordability and digital game access for next-gen console

labels.reference_summary: POWEROAD says its 50 kW / 559.1 kWh backup power system at North Everest Base Camp in Tibet has operated for more than 800 days as of August 2026, at 5,200 meters above sea level. The system was commissioned in 2024 around three FLEX 215 outdoor battery cabinets and was tested in laboratory conditions down to -40 C. It provides at least 24 hours of backup power for a scientific expedition team, with a transfer time of less than 20 milliseconds.

title: POWEROAD BESS system operates reliably at 5,200 meters for over 800 days

labels.reference_summary: Provisional RBI data showed FCNR(B) deposits brought in $127.23 billion, with overseas foreign currency borrowings adding $5.26 billion and external commercial borrowings $3.89 billion. By August 21 banks had mobilised $65.4 billion through FCNR(B) deposits and about $73 billion across the three routes. The RBI introduced the facility on June 8. Banking liquidity rose to Rs 6.65 lakh crore on August 31, its highest since May 2022, with the weighted average call rate at 4.98%.

title: RBI swap dollar haul nearly doubles in 10 days

labels.reference_summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said President Vladimir Putin ordered a three-day halt to strikes on Kyiv from midnight local time, ahead of a planned visit to the Ukrainian capital by US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. The two envoys arrived in Moscow earlier on Saturday for talks aimed at ending the Russia-Ukraine war and were expected in Kyiv on Sunday. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Kyiv would not launch strikes during their visit to Russia.

title: Putin orders three-day strike halt on Kyiv for US envoys

labels.reference_summary: Addy Osmani argues that the durable part of an engineering career in the age of AI is choosing what to build and judging whether it is good. He writes that solving problems went cheap while selecting them became scarce, and that judgment will atrophy if engineers put agents in front of everything. His advice includes deliberate practice without an agent, treating every diff from an agent like a human review, and owning what you ship. He spent over 14 years at Google.

title: Engineer's Guide to Thriving in AI Era: Focus on Judgment and Direction

labels.reference_summary: Downing Street gave Nats chief executive Martin Rolfe one week to report on the technical failure at the Swanwick site that has cancelled more than 2,000 UK flights. Transport secretary Heidi Alexander told MPs the four-hour outage was not unavoidable and asked the Civil Aviation Authority for an independent review reporting within six months. Cirium counted nearly 2,100 cancellations, including 541 at Heathrow. Ryanair chief executive Michael O'Leary called for Rolfe to be sacked. Nats ruled out a cyber attack.

title: UK Air Traffic Control Boss Faces One-Week Investigation Deadline Amid 2,000 Flight Cancellations

labels.reference_summary: French foreign minister Jean-Noel Barrot said his department will stop using the Mercator projection and switch to Eckert IV, which reflects the true proportions of the continents more accurately. Speaking at the Sorbonne, he said a map is never entirely neutral and that Mercator gives the United States, Russia and China disproportionate visual importance against Africa, Latin America and South-East Asia. Hours later the UN General Assembly backed a non-binding resolution sponsored by Togo favouring the Equal Earth projection, supported by 164 member states, with only the United States voting against.

title: France abandons Mercator map projection for Eckert IV

labels.reference_summary: Venezuelan opposition leaders are uneasy about an oil agreement that would give the US government majority control over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves. Acting president Delcy Rodriguez said the deal could bring badly needed foreign investment. Opposition leader Maria Corina Machado voiced profound concerns about authoritarian behaviour but did not criticise the agreement itself, and nearly all opposition lawmakers voted to approve it. Tulane scholar David Smilde said opposing it would end their political prospects. One AtlasIntel survey put Rodriguez's approval at 22%.

title: Venezuelan opposition leaders uneasy about new U.S. oil deal

labels.reference_summary: Savers opened its 19th Australian store in Geelong on August 27, drawing a 100-metre queue. Savers Australia is a subsidiary of Savers Value Village, a $2.2 billion company whose shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange and which is majority owned by Ares Management, with 185 stores in the US and 172 in Canada. Local charities said the for-profit model competes with op shops that fund community programs. Savers said it gave Australian non-profit partners $5.6 million last year, about $310,000 per store.

title: Savers Australia expands with $2 billion parent company backing

labels.reference_summary: China has recalled more than 4 million vehicles over hidden door handles, including 2.98 million Chinese-made Teslas, in the country's biggest car recall. XPeng, Xiaomi and Geely are also affected. Tesla said handles on some Model 3, Y, S and X vehicles are difficult to identify and operate because their colour is similar to the interior trim. Recalled cars get a warning label and a software update that lowers the windows after a crash. From 1 January 2027 China will require mechanical releases inside and outside.

title: China recalls nearly three million Teslas over hidden door handle safety concerns

labels.reference_summary: Backlash over a Target Halloween costume, the Kids' Glows Under Blacklight Circus Clown, spilled into the retailer's shares on Tuesday. Critics said it evoked blackface and minstrel shows, and Target apologised and pulled the product. Earlier cases include a Starbucks Korea campaign that referenced the 1980 Gwangju Uprising and preceded the dismissal of the head of Starbucks Korea, American Eagle's 2025 Sydney Sweeney jeans campaign, Bud Light's 2023 promotion with Dylan Mulvaney, and H&M's 2018 Coolest Monkey in the Jungle sweatshirt.

title: Global brands face backlash over culturally insensitive campaigns

labels.reference_summary: Eleven students at Jawaharlal Nehru University in Delhi filed a sexual harassment complaint against a professor with the internal complaints committee, which has begun proceedings and called several students to record their statements. The professor allegedly made remarks with sexual connotations during viva examinations in the first week of May. A source said he suggested he would award extra marks if the students accepted his sexual advances. One student first described her experience on an unofficial WhatsApp group, prompting others to come forward.

title: JNU professor investigated after students allege sexual harassment remarks

labels.reference_summary: Mexico's Pemex and Brazil's Petrobras announced a two-year memorandum of understanding on June 23 to work together on deepwater and mature oilfields in the Gulf of Mexico. Neither company published the document. Environmental groups including Oceana and Greenpeace Mexico said the deal risks oil spills near the Southern Gulf of Mexico Reefs National Park, created in 2024. Pemex had an oil spill in March that contaminated 933 kilometers of shoreline. President Claudia Sheinbaum said the government would not sign a contract which means losing control of Pemex.

title: Mexico and Brazil state oil firms sign deal raising ecological concerns

labels.reference_summary: Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max on Wednesday at its Cupertino, California headquarters. In India the iPhone 18 Pro starts at 1,64,900 for the 256GB variant and the Pro Max at 1,79,900 for the same storage. Both go on sale from September 18, with pre-orders from September 12. New CEO John Ternus, who took over from Tim Cook on Sept. 1, introduced the lineup. The phones run the A20 Pro processor based on 2-nanometer technology and ship with iOS 27.

title: Apple launches iPhone 18 Pro in India starting at ₹1,64,900

labels.reference_summary: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee said on Saturday there is no plan of the Israelis to displace people out of Gaza against their will. National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir had set out a plan on Thursday for 250,000 Palestinians to leave Gaza in the first year and the rest of the roughly two million residents over the next six years. Defence Minister Israel Katz said Israel was ready to remove Palestinians by sea and land. Huckabee also called violent Israeli settlers in the West Bank terrorists. Israel holds a general election on October 27.

title: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee denies Israeli plans for forced Gaza displacement

labels.reference_summary: AI tools that claim to spot skin cancer are increasingly accurate for people with light skin but have a blind spot on darker skin. Some are smartphone apps anyone can download and others are software programs for clinicians. A computer engineer and colleagues trained an AI model on photographs of known skin conditions in light-skinned patients, then digitally manipulated the images to resemble darker skin tones. The clinical condition in the photo had not changed, but the model's ability to recognize it deteriorated sharply. The model picks up on the color of the surrounding skin as a clue instead of reading the lesion.

title: AI skin cancer tools work well for light skin but fail on darker skin

labels.reference_summary: Rescue operations at the collapsed building in Delhi's Satya Niketan ended after 24 hours and seven people died. At least 12 people were pulled from under the rubble, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta said. The Delhi High Court said Delhi University and the Municipal Corporation of Delhi are also responsible, and directed the MCD to conduct a high-level inquiry and a comprehensive audit of all paying-guest facilities in its jurisdiction. Authorities must file replies within 10 days and the matter is listed for 25 September. The ABVP demanded the resignation of MCD commissioner Sanjeev Khirwar.

title: Delhi HC orders probe into Satya Niketan collapse after seven deaths

labels.reference_summary: On 2 September 2026 men dressed in saffron painted the white gate pillars of the Anandabazar Patrika office in Kolkata and shouted slogans. Police were present but did not stop them. The protest followed the newspaper's use of the phrase gerua gundami, or saffron hooliganism, in its coverage of the August 20 clash between ABVP and Left-affiliated student groups at Jadavpur University. An FIR had been filed against the paper's editorial team by Sanjay Shastri Maharaj. West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari had demanded an apology. The newspaper repainted the pillars white a few hours later.

title: Men Paint Saffron on Anandabazar Patrika Office After CM Adhikari Pressure

labels.reference_summary: Karnataka Higher Education Minister Basavaraj Rayareddy said at a mass marriage ceremony in Kukkanur, Koppal district, that among all religions Islam is a superior religion. Excerpts of the speech went viral on Monday and the BJP demanded he withdraw the statement or be sacked. Rayareddy said he had spoken of certain superior thoughts in the Islamic religion and never said other religions are inferior. R. Ashoka asked Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar to sack him if he refuses to apologise. State BJP president B.Y. Vijayendra said the statement would boomerang on Rayareddy.

title: Karnataka minister says Islam is superior religion, BJP demands his sacking

labels.reference_summary: U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said AI giant Anthropic is back on the right side with the Trump administration, Axios reported on Wednesday. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth had blocked Anthropic from certain military contracts because the company refused to allow the U.S. to use its Claude AI models for domestic surveillance or autonomous weapons. Anthropic sued in California court, and on August 27 a U.S. judge sided with the company. Anthropic co-founder Tom Brown urged officials at a G20 event in North Carolina to grant permits to build data centers.

title: Anthropic Wins Court Case Against Military, Commerce Chief Says Company Is Back In Favor

labels.reference_summary: Bharat Rashtra Samithi working president KT Rama Rao criticised Congress leader Rahul Gandhi over student issues and challenged him to visit Telangana and listen to local youth. Speaking at a public meeting in Karimnagar, Rama Rao questioned the delivery of election assurances, including two lakh jobs annually, the job calendar, unemployment allowances and fee reimbursement. He also targeted Chief Minister Revanth Reddy regarding governance and unfulfilled commitments.

title: KTR challenges Rahul Gandhi on Telangana student issues and unfulfilled promises

labels.reference_summary: Former Union Minister P Chidambaram opposed simultaneous Lok Sabha and state assembly elections before a joint committee of Parliament, calling the proposal monstrous, unconstitutional and mindless. He argued that curtailing a legislature's five-year term violates the basic structure of the Constitution, and said the government does not have the two-thirds majority to pass the bills. TMC member Sagarika Ghosh said the bills would give unbridled power to the Election Commission. About 10 Padma awardees appeared separately before the panel headed by BJP member PP Chaudhary and were divided.

title: Chidambaram opposes 'One Nation One Election' as unconstitutional

labels.reference_summary: Ugandan authorities said investigations into Anita Among, the former Speaker of the House, have been dropped. Among was confined to her home in Kampala in May after a corruption probe that saw her Rolls Royce confiscated. Military chief Muhoozi Kainerugaba said on social media that President Yoweri Museveni had instructed him to release her from house arrest and that she will not be prosecuted. Uganda's anti-corruption body said it had never stated it was investigating her. Among was appointed in March 2022 and had faced sanctions by Britain and the United States.

title: Uganda Drops Corruption Probe Against Former Speaker Anita Among

labels.reference_summary: The Ministry of Energy has identified more than 5,200 government schools across the Kingdom for solar panel installations. Solar systems are already installed at more than 600 schools. The ministry expects annual energy savings of more than 110 million kilowatt-hours once all targeted facilities are equipped. Schools will generate clean electricity for their own operational requirements and cut their reliance on electricity supplied through the conventional grid. The ministry also expects the program to lower emissions and support national sustainability and environmental targets.

title: Saudi Ministry of Energy Targets 5,200 Schools for Solar Installations

labels.reference_summary: The Maine Public Utilities Commission selected Clearway Energy Group to develop an 800 MW onshore wind project in northern Maine and named Avangrid its preferred developer of a transmission line linking it to the New England grid. Avangrid proposed a 1.2 GW line terminating at Haynseville. Maine's share of the generation will be roughly 600 MW, leaving 400 MW of capacity on the line for further procurement. Massachusetts, Vermont, Connecticut and Rhode Island will share the line's costs, with Maine responsible for less than 11%. The commission estimates net benefits to Maine of at least $387m to $425m.

title: Maine PUC selects Clearway for 800 MW wind project and Avangrid for transmission

labels.reference_summary: AMEA Power has energized the 25 MVA, 132/33 kV substation for its 24 MWp Ituka solar project in Uganda's West Nile region. The plant sits on a 52-hectare site in Ombachi village in the Madi Okollo District, around 450 kilometers from Kampala. The substation connects the plant to the Lira-Gulu-Nebbi-Arua 132 kV transmission line operated by the Uganda Electricity Transmission Company Limited, which is also the off-taker under a 20-year power purchase agreement. The project received a USD 19 million debt package from the Emerging Africa Infrastructure Fund and is expected to produce about 53,940 MWh a year.

title: AMEA Power Completes Ituka Solar Substation in Uganda

labels.reference_summary: Mistral AI released Workflows in public preview as an orchestration layer for enterprise AI. Developers write the workflow in Python and publish it to Le Chat so anyone in the organisation can trigger it, and every step is tracked and auditable in Studio. A single wait_for_input() call pauses a workflow for human approval and resumes it where it stopped. ASML, ABANCA, CMA-CGM, France Travail, La Banque Postale and Moeve are already running Workflows. The system is built on Temporal's durable execution engine, with Mistral hosting the control plane and customers deploying workers on their own Kubernetes environment.

title: Mistral AI Introduces Workflows for Reliable AI Orchestration

labels.reference_summary: A new World Bank Group report says a record 1.2 billion young people in emerging market and developing economies will reach working age over the decade to 2035. Sub-Saharan Africa is expected to account for more than three-quarters of the net increase in the global working-age population through 2050, adding 625 million people. Median government debt in sub-Saharan Africa stood at 56% of GDP in 2024, against 19% in East Asia and Pacific in 1977. The report sets out three policy pillars: foundational infrastructure, a business-enabling environment, and mobilising private capital.

title: World Bank warns demographic wave makes job creation urgent
