labels.reference_summary: Between 2019 and 2025, 706 EU-flagged or EU-owned ships were dismantled worldwide, and only 22% were recycled in EU-located facilities, representing 5% of total tonnage, according to a study from NGO Shipbreaking Platform and T&E. Nearly half were beached in India, Bangladesh and Pakistan, which accounted for 66% of tonnage. As many as 102 ships swapped their EU flag shortly before dismantling to avoid EU restrictions. Benedetta Mantoan said the EU lets valuable steel be lost to third markets.

title: New Study Confirms Most EU Ships Are Scrapped in South Asia

labels.reference_summary: Fires in Indonesia produced 76m tonnes of carbon in 2026 as of 7 September, according to the Global Fire Emissions Database. That puts the year on the same trajectory as 2015, when fires burned 2.6m hectares and generated 333MtC. Dr Guido van der Werf of Wageningen University said the fires are more or less on track to reach the levels seen 11 years ago, and that Papua is burning more than it ever has. Dr Nisa Novita said El Nino acts as a major amplifier rather than a direct cause. Indonesia dissolved its peatland restoration agency last year.

title: Indonesia fires in 2026 on track to match 2015 record emissions

labels.reference_summary: ESS Inc CEO Drew Buckley said the company has put its iron flow battery on a longer trajectory, aiming to bring it to market in maybe 24 months, and is pivoting to a sodium-ion product called Bridge that uses cells from Alsym. ESS went public on the NYSE through a SPAC listing in 2021, and its shares now sit at US$0.39 with a market cap of US$12 million. Its latest SEC filing mentioned substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. Buckley described a proposed combination with an unnamed energy technology company at about $515 million, leaving ESS shareholders with 5-10%.

title: ESS Inc CEO outlines pivot to sodium-ion batteries after iron flow battery struggles

labels.reference_summary: Researchers propose an unlearning framework that reduces the size of datasets before unlearning, leading to computational savings of up to approximately 50 percent on real world empirical examples. They ask whether points that have a negligible impact on a model's learning need to be removed at all. Through a comparative analysis of influence functions across language and vision tasks, they identify subsets of training data with negligible impact on model outputs. The work responds to growing concerns around data privacy in machine learning.

title: Researchers Propose Efficient Unlearning Framework by Identifying Low Influence Data Points

labels.reference_summary: Planned gas-fired power capacity tied to data centers nearly doubled in the first half of 2026. The United States had 378 GW of gas-fired power capacity in development, up 50 percent in six months, of which 189 GW was tied directly to data centers, according to Global Energy Monitor. Amazon is building a gas-fired plant in Texas, Nvidia is teaming with SoftBank and the federal government on a plant for an OpenAI project in Ohio, and Microsoft is in talks with Chevron for a $7 billion gas-powered data center in Texas. A Heatmap poll found 75 percent of US voters oppose new data centers in their area.

title: Data Centers Drive Massive U.S. Natural Gas Power Buildout

labels.reference_summary: LONGi reported operating revenue of RMB 27.045 billion in the first half of 2026. BC module sales reached 19.55 GW, up 125% year-on-year and more than 65% of total module shipments. Overseas module shipments rose more than 26% year-on-year, and overseas revenue passed 65% of module revenue. New PV installations in China fell 66% year-on-year to 72.07 GW in H1 2026, according to the National Energy Administration. LONGi said its crystalline silicon-perovskite tandem solar cell reached 35.5% conversion efficiency, certified by the European Solar Test Installation.

title: LONGi Reports 125% Growth in BC Module Sales and Rising Overseas Revenue Share

labels.reference_summary: U.S. oil majors moved deeper into Iraq as Washington pushed back Russian and Chinese influence. ConocoPhillips agreed to acquire a 42% interest in BP Energy Company of Kirkuk Limited, supporting redevelopment of five producing oil fields in northern Iraq. Chevron moved into West Qurna 2 after sanctions drove Russia's Lukoil out, and signed an addendum on the Nasiriyah field. Iraq holds about 145 billion barrels of proved crude oil reserves and plans to raise output to between 8 million and 10 million barrels per day within six years.

title: U.S. Expands Oil Influence in Iraq Amid Global Power Rivalry

labels.reference_summary: Mistral AI expanded its work in Germany. The company said it is building a multiyear partnership with SAP to deliver a sovereign AI stack for Germany and Europe, integrating its models into SAP's AI Foundation. With Helsing, Mistral is developing vision-language-action models for defense and security applications. Mistral said it will increase its local team and open an office in Germany in the coming months.

title: Mistral AI expands in Germany to support European AI autonomy

labels.reference_summary: Alabama Power customers paid the highest total residential bills of the 100 utilities Inside Climate News examined, reporter Dennis Pillion said. Alabama has not held a rate case hearing for an electric provider since 1981, and a system created in 1982 adjusts rates automatically to keep the utility inside a set return range. Alabama Power reported a $1.5 billion profit in 2025. Reporter Lee Hedgepeth said 12 to 20 data center proposals are pending, and the demand from the quarter he has documents for exceeds the energy used by every household in the state.

title: Alabama Faces High Utility Bills and Data Center Expansion

labels.reference_summary: Humanoid robots are closing the physical performance gap with people, and a humanoid beat Usain Bolt's 100m sprint record at the World Humanoid Games in China. Machines that match infantry tasks would need no sleep, food or water, would not feel fear, and could share a target detected by one unit with every other unit. Boston Dynamics specifies four hours of typical operation for its Atlas humanoid and battery replacement in less than three minutes. Military competition would then push states to replace human infantry, ending the battlefield role of courage.

title: Humanoid Robots Challenge Infantry Capabilities and Military Traditions

labels.reference_summary: Polling by Heatmap News and Embold Research found the cost argument for renewables does not persuade climate skeptics. 78% of voters who are doubtful or dismissive about climate change said advocates for wind and solar exaggerate how cheap the sources have become, against 17% who disagreed. 55% of all voters said wind and solar are only cost-competitive with oil and gas because of subsidies. Only 7% of skeptics found a tailored message extremely believable, and 54% said nothing could convince them that solar was affordable.

title: Polling shows clean energy cost arguments fail to convince climate skeptics

labels.reference_summary: Core Power (US) Inc and the US Maritime Administration signed a non-exclusive Memorandum of Cooperation in Washington DC to collaborate on maritime nuclear frameworks. The framework links the US Maritime Action Plan with allied shipbuilding and specialist US nuclear integration. Core Power said it is targeting first construction starts from 2028 and plans a dedicated US nuclear-grade integration and lifecycle shipyard. Stephen Carmel, Administrator of the Maritime Administration, said nuclear propulsion is a commercial opportunity that must be approached as a complete system.

title: Core Power and US Maritime Administration collaborate on nuclear propulsion for commercial shipping

labels.reference_summary: A United Airlines flight from Edinburgh to Chicago O'Hare on July 27 was diverted to Green Bay, Wisconsin because of stormy weather, and passengers stayed on the plane for about four hours after landing. The crew then exceeded its allowable duty time, and travellers waited outside on the tarmac for five hours before a replacement crew arrived. Heather Fields said she reached Denver about 20 hours after her scheduled landing. United offered her $200 in flight credits, then raised the offer to $500.

title: Passenger describes 20-hour flight delay due to weather and crew time limits

labels.reference_summary: Physicists at the National Institute of Standards and Technology calculated that clocks on Mars tick 477 microseconds faster per day than clocks on Earth. Mars' eccentric orbit and the gravity of its neighbours change that figure by as much as 226 microseconds a day over the Martian year. Neil Ashby and Bijunath Patla published the work in The Astronomical Journal. Time on the Moon runs a consistent 56 microseconds faster than on Earth. Patla said the result helps prepare navigation and communication for future missions.

title: NIST Physicists Calculate Precise Time Differences Between Earth and Mars

labels.reference_summary: Researchers from Silliman University and the Philippine Genome Center Visayas sequenced the first draft genome of the Visayan spotted deer, using a tissue sample from a captive animal named Abraham. The genome contains 2.5 billion DNA letters and 24,531 genes. Abraham's heterozygosity score was 0.17, below the 0.3 typical of healthy wild populations. The last count in 2016 recorded about 700 mature individuals. The team found a rare allele in one individual that is still sexually active and plans a genome-based breeding protocol.

title: Scientists sequence Visayan spotted deer genome to guide conservation

labels.reference_summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation registered an FIR against Essel Group and Zee founder Subhash Chandra over two loans totalling Rs 980 crore from LIC Housing Finance. The complaint says he submitted inflated net worth certificates in 2018, one valuing his net worth at about Rs 59,000 crore and another at Rs 40,562 crore. Both loan accounts defaulted, causing an alleged wrongful loss of more than Rs 1,322 crore. Chandra later said his net worth in 2024 was Rs 31.79 crore.

title: CBI books Subhash Chandra in Rs 1,322 crore LIC Housing Finance fraud case

labels.reference_summary: Raafe Khan of Camelot Energy Group said capacity market design blocks long-duration energy storage. A 100MW/400MWh battery receives a 59% ELCC rating in PJM while an 8-hour system receives 71%, so doubling duration costs about US$72 million in capital but lifts annual revenue only from US$7 million to US$8.5 million. Khan said merchant value in ERCOT fell roughly 90% between 2023 and 2025 while the fair market value of assets rose. He called for a 10-year capacity price lock and accreditation aligned to the cost curve.

title: Raafe Khan analyzes financial challenges and market dynamics for long-duration energy storage

labels.reference_summary: Orris Infrastructure proposed time saved per day as a measure of a home's value alongside price per square foot. Its Carnation Residency, Aster Court and Aster Court Premier projects sit in a 29-acre development in Sector 85, New Gurugram, about five minutes from schools in Sectors 84, 81 and 89 and from Aarvy Healthcare Super Speciality Hospital in Sector 90. Cyber City and IGI Airport are about 30 minutes away. Vishal Sabharwal, Head - Sales at Orris Group, said a well-positioned home can cut everyday journeys.

title: Orris Infrastructure proposes time saved per day as a new real estate metric

labels.reference_summary: OpenAI's head of data centers, Chris Malone, has left the company. Malone joined in March 2025 after data center roles at Meta and Google, and his exit follows a reorganisation that moved his reporting line from President Greg Brockman to Vice President Sachin Katti. Business Insider put the total of senior departures in 2026 at 13. OpenAI envisions committing around $600 billion to compute through 2030, and CFO Sarah Friar told employees the company will be a public company in 2027.

title: OpenAI data center head Chris Malone leaves amid executive departures

labels.reference_summary: The Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost its last operating external power line on 20 August and has relied on emergency diesel generators since then to cool six reactors and their used fuel ponds. IAEA Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi said the plant could face a station blackout within about ten days without restored off-site power or more diesel deliveries. IAEA experts saw several dozens of tonnes of diesel moved to the site from two off-site locations. A drone incident near the cooling pond on 25 August injured two plant staff.

title: IAEA warns Zaporizhzhia plant faces blackout without diesel

labels.reference_summary: The National Institute of Standards and Technology released RM 8043, a forensic DNA reference material that includes degraded DNA and mixtures of DNA from more than two people. The set holds eight vials from anonymous donors who consented: six with high-quality DNA from one, two or three individuals, and two with degraded DNA. NIST fragmented those samples by irradiating them with ultraviolet light. Each vial holds close to 900 nanograms, against the half to one nanogram a test needs. About 100 forensic laboratories tested the samples before release.

title: NIST Provides Forensic Labs with New DNA Reference Material for Complex Cases

labels.reference_summary: India remains committed to bringing economic fugitives back to face the law, MEA Secretary (West) Sibi George said at a briefing on the visit of Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever. Mehul Choksi, a key accused in the Rs 13,500 crore Punjab National Bank loan fraud case, was arrested by Belgian authorities in April last year and has been in a Belgian jail since. In December, Belgium's Court of Cassation dismissed his appeal against extradition and upheld the Antwerp Court of Appeal ruling of October 17, 2025.

title: MEA confirms commitment to extradite Mehul Choksi to India

labels.reference_summary: Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, king of Uganda's Tooro kingdom, has died at 34, Tooro's regional leader Calvin Armstrong Rwomiire Akiiki announced. No cause of death was given. Oyo took the throne in 1995 at the age of three after his father died, and the Guinness Book of World Records said in 2025 that he was still the youngest reigning monarch alive. Akiiki said the king leaves behind a prince as heir whose identity will be revealed later.

title: Uganda's youngest reigning monarch King Oyo Nyimba dies at 34

labels.reference_summary: Six months after American bombs fell on Iran, the war has no resolution and both sides still trade strikes. Benchmark crude prices are around $90 per barrel, up 25 per cent from $72 on the eve of the conflict. More than 8,000 people across the Middle East have been killed since 28 February, and the Pentagon counts 18 US service member deaths and 758 wounded. Energy inflation had cost consumers $91.6bn as of 26 August, and a Reuters/Ipsos poll put Trump's approval at 33 per cent.

title: US to impose 'D-Day' sanctions on Iran as Tehran warns of retaliation

labels.reference_summary: The Indian Army opened a facility in New Delhi called AASHVAST to test military drones for hidden software threats and for Chinese components. Army Chief General Dhiraj Seth opened it on August 14. The lab runs air-gapped and read-only, so it works offline and does not alter the drones it examines. QuickPay Tech set up the facility for the Directorate General of Electronics and Mechanical Engineering, and its director Rajib Roy said the checks can find concealed credentials, undisclosed command channels and modified flying limits.

title: Indian Army inaugurates AASHVAST lab to detect Chinese drone components

labels.reference_summary: U.S. power plants raised output by 2.1 percent in the first half of the year against the same period of 2025, with data centers driving demand. Texas led the increase, generating 293,151 gigawatt-hours, and its utility-scale solar rose 35 percent to 35,992 gigawatt-hours, passing coal in five of the first six months. Washington gained 10,925 gigawatt-hours of hydropower. Natural gas held 38.4 percent of national generation, renewables 28.5 percent, nuclear 17.1 percent and coal 14.4 percent. California's utility-scale generation fell.

title: Texas Leads U.S. Electricity Growth as Solar Surges Past Coal

labels.reference_summary: ONE Nuclear Energy signed a binding letter of intent with a group of Louisiana landowners to secure site control for Project Cayman. The plan combines a 2.88GW natural gas-fired power plant, a 700MW/2.88GWh battery energy storage system and a data centre campus near the RiverPlex MegaPark. CEO Richard Taylor said the project will deliver reliable energy, create jobs and expand the local tax base. Public information meetings run from September through December 2026. In June 2026 the company signed a separate letter of intent with Sunshine Partners US covering five West Texas sites.

title: ONE Nuclear secures Louisiana site for 2.88GW Project Cayman

labels.reference_summary: OpenAI is expanding its cooperation with Samsung Electronics across semiconductors and enterprise AI services. Harrison Kim, General Manager of OpenAI Korea, told a Seoul press conference that joint production and research on next-generation chips is where the two companies have made the most progress. ChatGPT Enterprise users across South Korean businesses and institutions grew roughly 28 times by late August from a year earlier. Samsung is shipping HBM4E memory samples, and OpenAI unveiled its first custom AI chip, Jalapeno, built with Broadcom, in June.

title: OpenAI expands partnership with Samsung on next-generation AI chips

labels.reference_summary: Scatec secured EUR 132 million from BCR and Erste Group for its 77 MW Urleasca wind farm, northeast of Bucharest. A contract for difference covers 57% of expected production at EUR 71.3 per MWh, and the rest will be sold on the Romanian wholesale power market. The project costs EUR 168 million excluding value-added tax and will use 11 Nordex N175/6.X turbines, with commissioning targeted for the second half of 2028. Scatec bought the project from OX2 a month ago and holds 100% of it.

title: Scatec begins construction on 77 MW Romanian wind farm with BCR loans

labels.reference_summary: The Bombay High Court said the Palghar police had carried out no investigation into the assault on medical staff and the vandalism at Relief Hospital, and called their casual approach unacceptable. A bench of Justices AS Gadkari and Kamal Khata was hearing a suo motu petition about an earlier assault at a civic hospital in Thane. Superintendent of Police Yatish Deshmukh said one of the 10 people named in the FIR, Rahul Gharat, had been arrested and the other nine were absconding. The court said it could hand the case to the Mumbai Police Crime Branch.

title: Bombay High Court questions police inaction on Palghar hospital assault

labels.reference_summary: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of US goods took effect on Tuesday morning. They range from 15% to 50% and cover over 700 US products including steel, aluminum, dairy products, household appliances, agricultural equipment and electronics. The Canadian government also announced a C$7.5 billion relief package for affected businesses and workers. In July 2026, Canadian exports to the US fell 6.6% from the previous month and the US share of total exports fell to 66.3%, while exports to other markets rose 7.4% to C$25.62 billion.

title: Canada imposes $20B tariffs on US goods amid trade dispute

labels.reference_summary: Chinese companies showed storage systems and battery technologies at a renewable energy expo in Mexico City, where new solar and wind projects are required to include energy storage. Industry representatives warned that Mexico's tariffs on Chinese imports could raise costs and slow deployment, and said the government is considering additional trade restrictions. CGTN's Alasdair Baverstock reported from Mexico City.

title: Chinese battery firms showcase storage tech at Mexico energy expo

labels.reference_summary: Tesla stock fell 3% after its Cybercab launch in Austin, Texas gave few details on fleet size. Hours later the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened an investigation into whether the robotaxi, which has no steering wheel or pedals, meets federal motor vehicle safety standards. Nvidia rose after announcing it will buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, a deal expected to close in the first half of 2027. Snowflake stock surged 20% after hours, and Dell reported a record $60.9 billion in AI server orders.

title: John Ternus becomes Apple CEO as stock slips amid legal battle with OpenAI

labels.reference_summary: Kenya's President William Ruto ordered Tata Chemicals to pack up and leave the country, accusing it of failing to create jobs and process minerals locally. His mining minister had directed the company to suspend operations at one plant five weeks earlier, and the company said it provided evidence of regulatory compliance and remains committed to constructive engagement. Ruto said the government has sought new investors to take over the operations. He has also ordered authorities to begin shutting down foreign-owned businesses from Sept. 7.

title: Kenya's President Ruto orders Tata Chemicals to leave the country

labels.reference_summary: NVIDIA said its Vera CPU is built for agentic AI workloads, pairing strong per-core performance with enough concurrency to absorb bursts of parallel tool calls. Telemetry from 163,594 agentic sessions showed that over 97% of sessions had unique trajectory profiles, which NVIDIA says makes it impractical to right-size a fleet with multiple specialized CPU design points. Estimated SPEC CPU 2026 results, measured internally in July 2026, put Vera at up to 1.5x the agentic performance of the latest competition.

title: NVIDIA Vera CPU Optimizes Agentic AI Workloads with Balanced Performance

labels.reference_summary: Google Deepmind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu said there is nothing other than being at the frontier that is important for Google, and that he is 100% certain the company will be at the frontier. He admitted Google's current models are a little bit below the frontier. He gave no new detail on Gemini 4 beyond calling it the most ambitious run so far, and no update on Gemini 3.5 Pro, which is months late. He pointed instead to the Flash series moving from 3.5 through 3.6 to 3.7.

title: Google Deepmind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu prioritizes frontier AI leadership

labels.reference_summary: Ai2 released OlmoEarth v1.2, which uses rotary positional embeddings to cut the artifacts that absolute positional embeddings left in the embeddings. The team said partners asked for cleaner embeddings, and that kNN and linear-probe evaluations improved across all model sizes. The release comes in Nano, Tiny, Small and Base, all open source. The earlier v1.1 cut compute costs by up to 3x against v1 by reducing token sequence length, since compute scales quadratically with that length.

title: OlmoEarth v1.2 Enhances Efficiency with Rotary Positional Embeddings

labels.reference_summary: Mistral said it is taking three steps toward customer AI sovereignty. Mistral Regional Endpoints are now generally available and let customers choose whether their inference runs in Europe or the US. A new Mistral Priority Tier is in public preview, with custom rate limits and an uptime SLA. The platform will also support third-party open models, starting with Z.ai's GLM-5.2. Mistral is assembling an anchor group of enterprises whose multi-year commitments, called European Compute Units, back plans to build up to 1 GW of capacity by 2030.

title: Mistral enhances AI sovereignty with regional control and open model access

labels.reference_summary: India has recorded a rainfall deficit of 14% since the monsoon season began, and the India Meteorological Department confirmed El Nino will gain strength over August and September. The kharif sown area report shows paddy down 13 lakh hectares on last year. The 2016 Manual for Drought Management sets a three-step declaration process, but IIT Gandhinagar researchers found droughts in central India are detected and declared more often than in Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. This year 315 districts are declared vulnerable, and 111 of them have irrigation coverage below 25%.

title: El Niño threatens India's crops as drought declaration gaps persist

labels.reference_summary: Microsoft released Aurora 1.5, an update to its Aurora Earth-system foundation model, as open source on GitHub with model checkpoints on Hugging Face. The update adds 22 new variables to Aurora's original 4, moves to hourly temporal resolution, and adds probabilistic ensemble forecasting. Microsoft says the ensemble beats the ECMWF dynamical ensemble on 88.9% of evaluated targets, and that tropical cyclone track error fell by roughly one-third against the original Aurora. A final round of auto-regressive fine-tuning used ECMWF High Resolution analysis data from 2018 to 2023.

title: Microsoft Releases Aurora 1.5 for Enhanced Weather and Earth-System Forecasting

labels.reference_summary: The gasoline crack spread in New York Harbor has averaged about $1 per gallon higher since May than in 2025, when it peaked around 60 cents per gallon. Gasoline supplies are tight because of disruptions to refining in Russia, China and the Middle East. Total U.S. gasoline imports have run 32% below the 2021-2025 five-year average since March. Retail regular-grade gasoline cost $4.07 per gallon nationally on the Monday before Labor Day, against $5.21 on the West Coast and $3.62 on the Gulf Coast.

title: Elevated crack spreads and tight supplies drive higher U.S. gasoline prices

labels.reference_summary: The West Virginia Division of Air Quality determined on Aug. 13 that Fundamental Data held legal site control when it received an air quality permit for the Ridgeline Facility in Tucker County. The first phase covers roughly 800 MW of gas generation, nearly 1.3 GW of solar and 14 data center buildings using more than 2 GW of computing load, with a second phase adding 3.1 GW of gas-fired capacity. Community groups had appealed Construction Permit R13-3713, issued Aug. 15, 2025 for a 291-acre tract, and the Air Quality Board upheld it in a Feb. 5, 2026 final order.

title: West Virginia Agency Confirms Site Control for Data Center Complex Amid Legal Challenges

labels.reference_summary: The National Council on Electricity Policy released a framework to help state agencies coordinate planning for major new electricity users, including data centers and advanced manufacturing facilities. It sets three priorities: coordination among state agencies, shared data and analysis, and evaluation of economic costs, benefits and risks. It also outlines six approaches, among them state-level electricity demand forecasting, policies for connecting large new customers to the grid, and rate structures designed for large users. NCEP Director Deborah Reynolds said the framework gives states practical strategies while balancing reliability, affordability and economic opportunity.

title: NCEP Framework Guides States on Coordinating Electricity Demand Growth

labels.reference_summary: Tuhin Chakrabarty and co-authors used the infini-gram engine and Google Books to measure how far top-selling self-published books on Amazon draw on rare expressions from previously published work. Among the 100 highest-revenue books, those with substantial detected AI text carried such expressions across 43.2% of the text, against 37.6% for books with no detected AI text. A reference set of award-winning or nominated literature averaged 19.1%. The team counted only multi-word expressions appearing in no more than five Google Books volumes and absent from the infini-gram web snapshot.

title: AI-generated books draw more from existing literature than human-written ones

labels.reference_summary: OpenAI published a 37-page postmortem into the hacking of Hugging Face by its own AI agents. Independent audits by METR and Redwood Research found more than 700 agents took part, far more than had been revealed. Hugging Face disclosed the incident on July 16 and OpenAI acknowledged responsibility five days later. Attorneys general from 15 states asked OpenAI to preserve evidence, and Alabama's attorney general subpoenaed the company. OpenAI says a new alert system will notify human safety, security and research teams within 30 minutes of severe incidents.

title: OpenAI's Hugging Face Hack Report Raises Unanswered Questions About AI Safety

labels.reference_summary: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission said on Sept 11 it will automatically award successful whistle-blowers 30 per cent of collected enforcement penalties when a tipster is due US$5 million or less. The agency said the change speeds up payouts, reduces paperwork and aligns its programme with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Qualified whistle-blowers may receive 10 per cent to 30 per cent of collected penalties, subject to the commission's discretion. Smaller penalties make up more than 80 per cent of the CFTC's whistle-blower awards.

title: CFTC approves automatic payouts for smaller tipster awards under $6.3 million

labels.reference_summary: The US labor market added 162,000 jobs in August and the unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%, beating economists' expectations. The gains came largely from a rebound in leisure and hospitality and local government after declines over the summer. Fed funds futures traders raised the odds of a 0.25-point Federal Reserve rate hike in September by 11 points, per CME Fedwatch, with inflation still above the Fed's 2% target. Kory Kantenga, LinkedIn's head of economics, Americas, said the labor market is steady but that is not a relief to job seekers.

title: US Adds 162,000 Jobs in August, Boosting Rate Hike Odds

labels.reference_summary: Ford emptied its 3-million-square-foot Louisville Assembly Plant by February 2026 for a $2 billion overhaul that converts it from a gas-powered vehicle facility to one building the midsize electric Ford Fathom. The plant now houses the Universal EV Production System, which uses large aluminum unicastings in place of dozens of stamped and welded pieces and installs interior components on top of the battery. Fathom prototype builds with production qualified parts are due in the first quarter of 2027. Chief manufacturing officer Bryce Currie said the wiring harness is more than 4,000 feet shorter and 22 pounds lighter than in Ford's first-generation electric SUV.

title: Ford transforms Louisville plant for 2027 Fathom EV production

labels.reference_summary: A writer tested Apple's Siri AI in the iOS 27 beta, found it better at surfacing old text messages and photos, then used it less and less over the following month and went back to Instagram, Yelp and Anthropic's Claude. Dipanjan Chatterjee, vice president and principal analyst at Forrester, said Siri will take criticism for trailing its peers but will not push the installed base of iPhone users elsewhere. Avi Greengart, founder and lead analyst at Techsponential, said he is using Siri more, and for more things, with the latest beta software.

title: Tech writer finds Apple's new Siri AI helpful but ultimately unused

labels.reference_summary: Google, Tesla, PG&E and Sunrun announced a virtual power plant in California on 3 September. PG&E's Smart Home Assets for Reliability and Efficiency programme, fully funded by Google, will enroll approximately 21,000 existing flexible energy devices in Santa Clara and Alameda counties, and a spokesperson said it can deploy 12MW during peak demand. Customers can take US$5,000 off a Carrier battery-enabled heat pump, and 25 households will receive US$10,000 off. The resource is expected to start supporting the grid as early as this fall and run through 2027.

title: Google, Tesla, PG&E and Sunrun launch California virtual power plant

labels.reference_summary: Ai2 compared its strongest 7B transformer, Olmo 3, with its hybrid model, Olmo Hybrid, token by token across articles, Wikipedia entries, books, scientific papers, Python, HTML and LaTeX. Olmo Hybrid predicted content words better, with a loss gap around 0.04, against a gap closer to 0.02 on function words. The hybrid's advantage nearly disappeared on closing braces and on tokens that repeat text already in the passage, where attention can look the answer up. Tests on three 1B-parameter models showed a pure recurrent model falling behind on repeated tokens.

title: Hybrid models excel at predicting meaningful tokens but lag on repeated ones

labels.reference_summary: Boomi built Boomi Scribe, an AI agent that generates documentation for integration workflows as developers work. The agent parses XML representations of Boomi integration processes into directed acyclic graphs in dot notation, then passes them to Claude Haiku 4.5 through Amazon Bedrock to write the documentation and compare versions. It stores DAG files, generated documentation and metadata in Amazon S3, uses Amazon DynamoDB as an internal backend datastore, and uses AWS Lambda to orchestrate the pipeline. Boomi has more than 33,000 customers, and case studies report documentation time cut by up to 85 percent.

title: Boomi Scribe automates documentation for enterprise workflows using AWS AI

labels.reference_summary: Men purportedly associated with Hindutva outfits painted parts of the Anandabazar Patrika office building saffron, The Hindu reported, days after the newspaper used the phrase saffron hooliganism in a headline. Videos showed police personnel standing nearby as the men shouted slogans. The newspaper repainted the walls a few hours later, and no complaint has been filed. The headline referred to an August 20 clash at Jadavpur University between the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad and Left-affiliated student groups. A first information report was filed against the newspaper's editorial team, including two journalists.

title: Men paint Anandabazar Patrika office saffron after newspaper uses phrase

labels.reference_summary: The Center for AI Standards and Innovation at the National Institute of Standards and Technology published a Request for Information on the secure development and deployment of AI agent systems, seeking input from industry, academia and the security community. The notice focuses on risks that arise when AI model outputs are combined with software functionality, including indirect prompt injection, data poisoning and specification gaming. Responses will inform future voluntary guidelines and best practices, and CAISI's own research and evaluations. The comment period closes on March 9, 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time under docket no. NIST-2025-0035.

title: CAISI seeks input on securing AI agent systems

labels.reference_summary: Mistral AI added web search with citations, a Canvas interface for ideation and in-line editing, document and image understanding, and image generation to le Chat, all as beta features. Document and image understanding runs on the new multimodal Pixtral Large, which Mistral says is significantly more powerful than its previous vision model, Pixtral 12B. Image generation comes from Black Forest Labs Flux Pro. Users can also codify repeated prompts as agents and publish them to teammates. Mistral is offering the beta features on a free tier while working towards premium tiers with higher service guarantees.

title: Mistral AI adds web search and image generation to le Chat beta

labels.reference_summary: The OpenClaw Foundation released version 2.0 of its open-source AI platform, its largest release to date with over 16,000 pull requests. First-run setup now detects existing ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions, API keys and local models, cutting out configuration steps. The browser app was rebuilt from scratch and adds a Session Rail status display and a companion thread for asking questions about a running session. Shared Cloud Sessions let several users work on the same tasks, and sessions can run on the local gateway, on paired devices, or on rented disposable machines through the Crabbox provisioning tool.

title: OpenClaw Foundation releases version 2.0 with simplified setup and multiplayer sessions

labels.reference_summary: Six months after the assassination of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in a joint US-Israeli operation on 28 February, more than 8,000 people have been killed across the Middle East and the war with Iran is no closer to a resolution. The Pentagon counts 18 US service member deaths and 758 wounded. Benchmark crude prices are around $90 per barrel, up 25 per cent from $72 on the eve of the conflict, and the Watson School of International and Public Affairs puts the cost of energy inflation to consumers at $91.6bn as of 26 August. A Reuters/Ipsos poll found 33 per cent of Americans approve of Donald Trump's performance and 31 per cent support military action against Iran, down from 37 per cent in March.

title: US Secret Service aware of Iranian video alleging plot to assassinate Barron Trump

labels.reference_summary: Five Chinese solar manufacturers reported first-half losses in 2026 as oversupply and weak prices continued to weigh on the polysilicon, wafer and module segments. Longi's revenue fell 17.6% to CNY 27.05 billion and its net loss widened 43.4% to CNY 3.68 billion. TCL Zhonghuan's revenue rose 6.8% to CNY 14.31 billion and its loss narrowed 24.5% to CNY 3.20 billion. GCL Technology's loss widened 17.2% to CNY 2.08 billion, and Daqo New Energy's revenue fell 57.6% to CNY 623 million as it restricted deliveries. Xinte Energy improved most, with revenue up 38.9% to CNY 10.15 billion and its loss narrowed 17.3% to CNY 212 million.

title: Five Chinese solar makers report H1 losses amid oversupply

labels.reference_summary: India's data-centre capacity increased fourfold from about 375 MW in 2020 to around 1,500 MW by 2025, and the Economic Survey 2025-26 cites industry estimates of around 4 GW by 2030. The IEA expects India's electricity demand to grow by an average 6.4% a year between 2026 and 2030. Annual renewable procurement lowers the carbon intensity of consumption but does not guarantee clean power every hour, so data centres need renewable generation, battery storage, firm grid supply, substations, transmission capacity and backup arrangements designed as one system. Time-to-power is now a strategic investment variable alongside land, fibre connectivity and construction economics.

title: India must integrate power planning with data centre growth for sustainable digital expansion

labels.reference_summary: Donald Trump defended his trade war with Canada by telling Fox News host Trey Gowdy that Canada is not a state and asking why the United States should be subsidizing it. His administration placed new 50 percent tariffs on a range of Canadian exports after trade talks collapsed, and Prime Minister Mark Carney pledged to mirror US levies dollar for dollar. Trump announced he was renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America and demanded that Canadian companies move their headquarters inside US borders to avoid tariffs. The two countries conduct almost $900 billion in cross-border business every year, according to the US trade representative.

title: Trump defends trade war with Canada by arguing it is not a state

labels.reference_summary: Singapore recommends colorectal cancer screening for average-risk individuals from age 50. Desmond Wai Chun Tao asks the Ministry of Health to review the evidence and consider lowering that to 45, citing the stage 4 colon cancer diagnosis of Sheikh Haikel at the age of 49. About 10 per cent to 12 per cent of colorectal cancers in Singapore occur in people below 50, and the conventional polyp-cancer sequence is thought to take around seven to 10 years, so a screening colonoscopy can remove precancerous polyps as well as find cancer early. The American Cancer Society lowered its recommended starting age from 50 to 45 in 2018.

title: Author suggests Singapore consider lowering colorectal cancer screening age to 45

labels.reference_summary: DD News published videos of seven farmer leaders backing E20 ethanol blending on its YouTube channel on July 28 without disclosing that all seven already supported the Modi government. Several had backed the three farm laws at the centre of the 2020-21 farmers' protest. Krishanveer Chaudhary and Vinod Anand branded critics anti-national, and K Sai Reddy alleged the oil lobby, certain NGOs and foreign forces were behind the opposition. Contacted by Newslaundry, Dharmendra Chaudhary said ethanol blending was currently yielding no benefits, and Rampal Jat said farmers in his region derive absolutely no benefit. The broadcaster has aired more than 50 explainers, debates and ground reports promoting E20 since May.

title: DD News promotes E20 with pro-Modi farmer leaders without disclosing affiliations

labels.reference_summary: India voted for a United Nations General Assembly resolution on 6 September 2026 that seeks to correct distortions in the world map, particularly the underrepresentation of Africa's true size. The resolution, titled Correct the Map, was sponsored by Togo and supported by 164 countries, with only the United States voting against and six countries abstaining. India's representative Raghoo Puri said India backed the broader use of equal-area projections rather than any specific projection such as Equal Earth. The Mercator projection, widely used since the 16th century, makes Africa appear similar in size to Greenland, though Africa is approximately 14 times larger.

title: India Votes For UN Resolution To Correct World Map Distortions

labels.reference_summary: State-owned power utility Elektroprivreda Srbije issued a public call to companies and investors, offering to acquire or co-develop renewable energy projects. The first category covers solar, wind and hybrid projects of at least 50 MW connected to the transmission grid, where battery storage is not mandatory but adds extra weight in the evaluation, and will run as a two-phase competitive process. The second covers biomass, waste, waste-to-energy, biogas, landfill gas and green hydrogen projects, for which EPS offers existing sites including the Morava and Kolubara A thermal power plants. Letters of intent are due within 30 days, and EPS will notify bidders within 60 days.

title: Serbia's EPS issues call to acquire renewable energy projects

labels.reference_summary: Mistral renamed le Chat as Vibe and made it one agent and one licence across work and code, carrying over every conversation, setting and plan. Work Mode runs long, multi-step tasks across connectors including Google Workspace, Outlook, SharePoint, Slack and GitHub, analyses uploaded data, and drafts deliverables in Canvas. Code Mode launches remote coding agents that run in an isolated sandbox, can run in parallel, and finish at a reviewable pull request. Mistral also released a Vibe extension for VS Code. Plans are Free, Pro at $14.99 a month, Team at $24.99 per user a month, and Enterprise.

title: Mistral Launches Vibe: Unified AI Agent for Work and Coding

labels.reference_summary: A group allegedly associated with the Bajrang Dal and Vishva Hindu Parishad disrupted a silent reading session at AUDA Garden in Vastrapur, Ahmedabad on August 27, tore copies of I Am Malala and The Diary of a Young Girl, and beat participants with sticks and rods. Organisers said around 40-50 people attended and around 30-40 activists arrived. Police registered an FIR naming Hiren Rabari and Jimit Rabari, and Station House Officer G M Chaudhri said three people were arrested and have since got bail. The session was held in solidarity with Anand Niketan school, where a class 8 student found a hard object in canteen food and the row widened into objections to the two books.

title: Ahmedabad school food row escalated to Malala book controversy and street violence

labels.reference_summary: Microsoft's September preview update for Windows 11, released on August 27 as KB5120998, is wiping out or changing personalized mouse cursor settings, leaving cursors too large, too small or missing. Microsoft said reports describe high-DPI cursors replaced with larger white cursors and custom animations reverting to standard settings, with attempts to restore customization unsuccessful. The optional update also brings a resizable Start menu, a movable taskbar and a cleaner Search window. Windows Latest reports it is also resetting the wallpaper to a black screen and blurring fonts on some systems. Uninstalling the update is the only fix for now.

title: Microsoft Windows 11 update breaks cursors, wallpaper, and fonts

labels.reference_summary: The Marmot Project at the Rocky Mountain Biological Laboratory in Colorado ran its first Fat Marmot Week, won by a male named Dawn who went from about 8.6 pounds in June to about 13 pounds on Aug. 15. Graduate student Emily Renkey said the project has monitored the population since 1962. An OnlyFans account called OnlyMarms has about 2,600 subscribers, and a meme coin created by an outside community has raised over $140,000 in transaction fees for the project. A winter with no snow cut the population from about 160 animals last fall to about 60 emerging this year.

title: Marmot Project uses OnlyFans and meme coins to fund decades of wildlife research

labels.reference_summary: Kashish Shah, senior strategy lead at the Finnish power solutions company, said Australia's battery storage market has moved past the point where Frequency Control Ancillary Services drove project revenue, leaving energy arbitrage as the dominant source. He said access to the one-second FCAS market is a key reason developers pay the extra cost of AC coupling, and that the choice between AC and DC coupling sits with developers rather than suppliers. Sungrow Australia's Alistair Gibson said DC-coupled projects can cut grid connection approval times by up to six months. Shah said prices in five-minute settlement intervals can swing from minus AU$1,000 per megawatt-hour to AU$20,300 per megawatt-hour.

title: Wärtsilä strategy lead discusses Australia's battery market volatility and storage design

labels.reference_summary: Google raised the Pixel 11's starting price to $899 from $799 for the 256GB storage configuration. The phone keeps a 6.3-inch AMOLED display, which maxes out at 3,000 nits against 3,600 nits on the Pro models, and caps out at 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. Its main sensor is 48MP against 50MP on the Pro, and the telephoto is 10.8MP against 48MP. It runs the same Tensor G6 processor and Android 17 software as the Pro models, and Google slimmed the camera bar to nearly half the size of last year's.

title: ZDNET reviewer prefers base Pixel 11 over Pro models despite higher price

labels.reference_summary: ATL Saathi is rolling out to an initial cohort of 100 pilot schools across the country. The Gemini model provides the underlying intelligence and creates concise instructional materials, including AI infographics, video overviews and interactive quizzes for core curriculum modules. The Gemini 3.5 Flash model generates grade-appropriate, curriculum-aligned project ideas and gives educators step-by-step assembly instructions, wiring diagrams and safety precautions for the problem statements students bring forward.

title: ATL Saathi AI Tool Enhances STEM Education in Indian Schools

labels.reference_summary: Serena Ng and Nikolay Gospodinov analyse cross-section regressions run on time-compressed I(1) data in NBER Working Paper 35700. They show that the cross-section variance of a non-stationary panel fans out with time, which magnifies variability. Such regressions can yield estimates that are super-consistent and asymptotically normal whether the regressors are stationary, non-stationary or highly persistent. Omitted fixed effects preclude noise dilution but the estimates remain superconsistent. In three applications the long-run relations between consumption and income, and between growth or inflation and demographic variables, are reasonably well determined, while the estimated relation between growth and warming temperature is fragile.

title: Ng and Gospodinov analyze time-compressed data for long-run economic relations

labels.reference_summary: Amazon wants to build what would be the country's largest power plant in Texas and run it entirely on natural gas, and OpenAI is plotting an even larger plant in Ohio that would become the world's largest gas power facility. Emily Pontecorvo says transmission bottlenecks push developers toward off-grid solutions, and that removed clean energy tax credits and permitting obstacles for wind and solar add to the pull. Developers argue that building their own generation keeps the project from raising rates for other customers. Polling found 75% of Americans would oppose a data center built near where they live.

title: Tech giants build massive US natural gas plants for data centers

labels.reference_summary: Orsted, acting for its joint venture with PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna, selected Northern Helicopter to provide medevac services during construction of the 1.5 GW Baltica 2 offshore wind farm. The contract is valued at a little over EUR 2 million and runs from 1 September this year to 1 November 2027, with an option to extend by one month up to five times. Baltica 2 sits about 40 kilometres off the Polish coast near Ustka and will comprise 107 Siemens Gamesa 14 MW turbines. Once operational in 2027 it will meet the annual electricity demand of around 2.5 million households.

title: Ørsted Awards Baltica 2 Helicopter Medevac Contract

labels.reference_summary: Ukraine's Ministry of Defense announced in January that it would make millions of data points gathered during tens of thousands of drone flights available to military contractors and commercial companies, and more than 100 companies and the UK government have since gained access. Enabled Intelligence says it has already made more than half a million hours of Ukrainian drone footage available for AI training. Cory Alpert argues that battlefield data should not be treated as ordinary commercial material, that governments should record its origin, license its users and restrict onward sharing, and that they should require disclosure when models trained on wartime material enter civilian products. He says the soldiers and civilians visible in the records did not consent to becoming training material.

title: Ukraine sells battlefield drone data to train AI models

labels.reference_summary: Scientific American released a special section called The Young American Scientists on June 16, profiling early-career researchers including many MIT faculty, students and alumni. President Sally Kornbluth said discovery is part of our American DNA and called for a rededication to public investment in American science. Professor Feng Zhang cited funding instability at the National Institutes of Health and the National Science Foundation, immigration uncertainty for international scientists and an erosion of public trust in expertise. Visiting Scientist Alice Stanton described miBrain, a 3D tissue model of the human brain. Institute Professor Robert Langer said there have been setbacks before and people keep persisting.

title: MIT faculty discuss curiosity-driven science and funding challenges

labels.reference_summary: Mast Reforestation buries fire-killed trees deep underground in oxygen-free clay vaults. That stores the timber's carbon and generates credits which pay for clearing the land and hand-planting new fire-resilient forests. High-severity blazes in the American West leave behind barren moonscapes of dead trees that act as fuel for future fires, and clearing them is expensive. A shortage in the conifer seed supply chain adds to the problem. Grant Canary, CEO and founder of Mast Reforestation, talks with host Lara Pierpoint about shutting down a hardware project, buying a legacy seed bank, and making the case for startup pivots to investors.

title: Mast Reforestation buries dead trees to fund forest regeneration

labels.reference_summary: Beyond Data-Driven Aesthetics, by MIT Architecture alumnus and researcher Alexandros Haridis, is on view at the MIT Keller Gallery through June 30. The exhibition examines 20th- and 21st-century efforts to turn computing into a medium for creative production and aesthetic judgment in architecture and the applied arts, and translates algorithms, theories and machine-learning systems into physical installations and interactive visualizations. It is organised around five themes: Aesthetic Measure, Aesthetic Guidelines, Algorithmic Aesthetics, Aesthetic Appropriation and Aesthetic Novelty. Haridis says many questions presented as new in relation to AI have a longer history, pointing to the 1956 Dartmouth Summer Research Project.

title: Exhibition Explores Computational Aesthetics in Architecture

labels.reference_summary: DBS chief executive Tan Su Shan ruled out entering politics, saying she is too old, during a fireside chat organised by the Singapore Press Club on Sept 11. The 57-year-old was part of the ruling People's Action Party before she resigned to serve as a Nominated Member of Parliament from 2012 to 2014. Her comments followed a parliamentary debate on raising the salaries of ministers, in which Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said he wanted to attract private sector candidates into the Government. Tan received a total compensation package of $9.64 million for the year, while the reference annual salary for an entry-level minister at the MR4 grade will be raised to $1.8 million from $1.1 million.

title: DBS CEO Tan Su Shan rules out politics, urges diverse talent for policy debate

labels.reference_summary: Indra Renewable Technologies, an electric vehicle charging company in the United Kingdom, consolidated its data estate onto Databricks from Cosmos DB, Synapse, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Functions and Power BI. The move began with a parallel prototype migration from Synapse, then expanded to monthly Delta tables and a consolidated fleet pipeline built on a medallion design with bronze, silver and gold layers. That removed the need for three legacy Azure functions and let one pipeline serve three clients on a daily schedule. Dashboards now replace manual Excel trackers, and a Charger Uptime Analysis dashboard shows 14,975 devices with an average uptime of 90.25% over a selected period. CTO Matthew Noonan and Data Engineer Meghana Ganatra describe the work.

title: Indra consolidates fragmented EV charging data onto a unified Databricks platform

labels.reference_summary: DeepSeek AI released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters, 196B additional Engram parameters and a 1M-token context window. It activates 8B parameters per token during prefill and 16B during decode. The global KV cache footprint falls to 890 bytes per token, about 1/4 of DeepSeek-V4-Flash and roughly 437x smaller than DeepSeek-V1. The 40-layer backbone splits into a 20-layer causal encoder and a 20-layer decoder, and the main KV cache is quantized to E2M1. Open weights ship under an MIT license with vLLM, SGLang and Transformers paths on Hugging Face. Pre-training covers 45T multimodal tokens at a 7:1 text-to-multimodal ratio.

title: DeepSeek AI releases V4.1-Flash model with 1M context and compressed attention

labels.reference_summary: Spammers have adopted ASCII smuggling to evade filters on email platforms. The technique encodes characters in a block of 128 Unicode tags that mirror ASCII, so the tag point U+E0041 mirrors A and U+E0061 mirrors a, and the characters are readable by computers but almost completely invisible to humans. It gained attention two years ago as a way to make prompt injections against LLMs more stealthy. Microsoft said signatures detected by Microsoft Defender for Office spiked from roughly 21,000 per day to more than 1.3 million beginning on one day in early February, and reached 2.5 million within four days. The deluge persisted for months and then fell off sharply in mid-May.

title: Spammers adopt ASCII smuggling to evade email filters

labels.reference_summary: The U.S. District Court for the Northern District of New York struck down the state's Climate Change Superfund Act on Monday, ruling the 2024 law invalid under the federal Clean Air Act, with Judge Brenda K. Sannes citing the Supreme Court's 2011 ruling in American Electric Power v. Connecticut. President Donald Trump wrote on Truth Social that communities which reject data centers should expect to end up backwards and poor, while Heatmap Pro polling shows three-quarters of Americans oppose data centers built in their backyards. Holtec International started loading fuel into the Palisades reactor in western Michigan, the first U.S. plant to return after a permanent shutdown. West Texas Intermediate closed just below $104 per barrel as Houthi rebels seized the port city of Mokha.

title: Trump Defends Data Centers While Courts Strike Down Climate Superfund

labels.reference_summary: Apple may not launch camera-equipped AirPods until next year. Bloomberg tech reporter Mark Gurman reported that sources familiar with Apple's plans told him the devices would not launch alongside the new iPhone 18 this year, and that the delay was triggered by supply-chain constraints and software issues rather than privacy complications. The devices are designed to work with Apple Intelligence, and a leaked video showed they could scan a book so the text can be accessed later. Commenters on LinkedIn and Reddit raised privacy objections and drew parallels to Meta's Ray-Ban wearables. Gurman also suggested the AirPod cameras will not work in the way people think.

title: Apple delays camera AirPods amid privacy concerns and supply issues

labels.reference_summary: On September 4 the United Nations passed a resolution declaring November 27 the International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage. Sierra Leone submitted the resolution to the UN General Assembly and 50 nations, including India, co-sponsored it. Bhuwan Ribhu, founder of Just Rights for Children, had addressed the United Nations about six months earlier to call for the day, and was the only civil society representative present when it was adopted. Dr Fatima Maada Bio, First Lady of Sierra Leone, supported the call. The Union government launched its Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat campaign on November 27, 2024. NFHS-5 found 23.3 percent of women aged 20-24 were married before the age of 18, falling to 20.1 percent in NFHS-6.

title: UN declares November 27 International Day against child marriage

labels.reference_summary: A paper presented at the International Conference on Learning Representations adds three architectural factors to the Chinchilla scaling law: hidden size, the ratio of MLP parameters to attention parameters, and grouped-query attention. Two models with the same parameter count, the same training data and the same accuracy can differ by up to 40% in inference-time throughput depending on those choices. The authors trained more than 200 models, from 80 million to three billion parameters on eight billion to 100 billion tokens, and produced two families, Panda and Surefire. Surefire models match or exceed LLaMA-3.2 accuracy while improving throughput by 12-47%, with gains reaching 42% on A100 using vLLM and 47% on H200 using SGLang.

title: Researchers develop framework to optimize LLM efficiency without sacrificing accuracy

labels.reference_summary: Production code written by Claude should be held to a higher bar than code written by a human. Anthropic has many guardrails in place to make sure that happens: lots of lint rules, lots of tests, Claude-driven end to end tests, Claude-powered fuzzers running daily, automated code reviews and security reviews, and automated code refactoring. Without these, the result can be a mess that is hard to maintain down the line.

title: Anthropic's Boris Cherny says AI code needs stricter quality standards

labels.reference_summary: Indiana Michigan Power proposed a base rate reduction that would cut Indiana customer bills by approximately $59 million in 2027, subject to approval by the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission. A residential customer using 1,000 kWh per month would save an estimated $100 annually. The company also proposed to freeze all rates included on Indiana residential customers' monthly bills for three consecutive years. It said load growth and increased revenue from large customers, including data centers, support the proposal. A decision is anticipated in June 2027, and customers would begin seeing changes on their bills in summer 2027. Indiana Gov. Mike Braun said economic growth should not come at the expense of existing customers.

title: Indiana Michigan Power Proposes $59 Million Rate Cut for 2027

labels.reference_summary: Ezekiel Emanuel, Vinod Khosla and their coauthors argued in the Journal of the American Medical Association that medicine is approaching the point at which AI alone will exceed physicians and physician AI-hybrids at five fundamental tasks: taking medical histories, establishing a diagnosis, identifying what tests are needed, prescribing treatment and managing chronic diseases. They reviewed published articles on AI in medicine since January 1, 2024, and concluded a superior autonomous AI will likely surpass humans using AI by 2030. John Whyte, CEO of the American Medical Association, said some of the surveyed studies are simulations rather than blind experiments and do not all support the conclusion. Robert Wachter, head of medicine at UCSF, said the argument is important but that the attributes of trained physicians remain irreplaceable.

title: Authors argue AI alone will soon exceed doctors in core medical tasks

labels.reference_summary: A November 2025 report by the MIT Sloan School of Management and Boston Consulting Group found that 35 percent of surveyed businesses had already deployed AI agents and another 44 percent planned to implement agentic AI soon. Phillip Isola, an associate professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science and a member of CSAIL, said agentic AI takes actions in the world, either physical like robotic manipulation or digital like booking a flight, while generative AI makes up stories, poems, art and images. He said the biggest challenge in developing agentic AI is a lack of training data, so agents often learn by trial and error. He named coding agents as the area of most success and cited risks of unverified output, leaked private data and de-skilling.

title: Experts Discuss Agentic AI's Current State and Future Potential

labels.reference_summary: Food insecurity in the United States is rising as prices climb and assistance is cut. The Food and Drug Administration lists more than 12,800 illnesses tied to foodborne outbreaks in 2026, far surpassing any year since 2020. The Big Beautiful Bill created a food assistance cliff and sent ICE $75 billion, Stephen Semler wrote. The USDA lost approximately 20,000 employees from January 2025 to January 2026, and its Animal Plant and Health Inspection Service lost 2,009 employees, 23% of the service. Imports in the first half of 2026 represented nearly 30% of the beef produced from domestic cattle. US conflicts with Iran and Russia destroyed fertilizer supplies and caused natural gas and diesel shortages, which raises food costs.

title: Trump Administration Policies Accelerate US Food System Collapse Amid Global Disruption

labels.reference_summary: Hitachi Energy and Daikin Industries announced a long-term strategic supply relationship for Hitachi Energy's EconiQ portfolio of sulphur hexafluoride-free high-voltage technologies. Daikin Chemical Europe will supply C4-FN, a specialty gas component used in insulating and quenching gas mixtures, produced by Daikin Refrigerants Frankfurt GmbH at its facility in Frankfurt, Germany. The new production capacity becomes available in 2027. Using C4-FN reduces CO2-equivalent emissions by 99 % compared with conventional SF6-insulated equipment while retaining the same technical performance, reliability and compactness. Markus Heimbach of Hitachi Energy said adding a production site in Germany enhances supply resilience.

title: Hitachi Energy secures C4-FN gas supply from Daikin for SF6-free switchgear

labels.reference_summary: Nadia Shirley Beller Delgado, a 33-year-old Bolivian lawyer and activist, was shot three times at point-blank range outside a hotel in Santa Cruz de la Sierra on the night of August 17. She survived and accused her Argentine ex-boyfriend of ordering the attack. He is Fernando Cerimedo, co-owner of La Derecha Diario and an adviser to Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz, and he was arrested the next morning at Viru Viru Airport as he tried to fly to Buenos Aires. The Bolivian Prosecutor's Office requested a minimum of 180 days of preventive detention on charges of attempted femicide, money laundering and illicit enrichment, and he is held at Palmasola prison. Police searching his premises found cash and devices that functioned as bot farms.

title: Bolivian Lawyer's Attack Exposes US Influence in Latin America

labels.reference_summary: A 2024 Tesla Model Y left Interstate 35 near mile marker 68 in Daviess County, Missouri, struck a guardrail and killed its driver, a 64-year-old woman from Raymore, at around 3 p.m. on Monday, April 14, 2025. The Missouri State Highway Patrol reported a single-vehicle wreck and no coverage mentioned a driver-assist system. Tesla's own report to NHTSA says the system was engaged, logs a pre-crash speed of 73 mph in a 70-mph zone and records the crash as a fatality. Tesla redacted the crash narrative, the operating domain flag and the system, hardware and software versions as confidential business information. Electrek matched the redacted federal record to the reported crash and has requested the crash report from the Missouri State Highway Patrol.

title: Tesla Autopilot Engaged in Fatal Missouri Crash, System Details Redacted

labels.reference_summary: A major upgrade to Gemini 3 Deep Think, a specialized reasoning mode built for science, research and engineering, is being released. It set a new standard of 48.4% without tools on Humanity's Last Exam, reached 84.6% on ARC-AGI-2 as verified by the ARC Prize Foundation, attained an Elo of 3455 on Codeforces and reached gold-medal level performance on the International Math Olympiad 2025. It also showed gold medal-level results on the written sections of the 2025 International Physics Olympiad and Chemistry Olympiad and scored 50.5% on CMT-Benchmark. Deep Think is available in the Gemini app for Google AI Ultra subscribers and, for the first time, through the Gemini API to select researchers, engineers and enterprises.

title: Google releases upgraded Gemini 3 Deep Think for science and engineering

labels.reference_summary: Google Research scientists have used Empirical Research Assistance, introduced in a preprint in September, in epidemiology, cosmology, atmospheric monitoring and neuroscience. When the CDC flu forecast challenge opened in November for the 2025-26 season, Google began submitting weekly forecasts for every U.S. state at all time horizons up to four weeks ahead, and it also joined CDC live forecasts for state-level COVID-19 hospitalizations and for RSV. Public leaderboards run by Nicholas Reich, a biostatistics professor at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, show Google at or near the top. Combining ERA with Gemini Deep Think derived six general solutions for the gravitational energy radiating from cosmic strings. A physics-guided neural network distilled a column-averaged CO2 signal from GOES East observations every 10 minutes.

title: Google Research Scientists Use AI to Advance Epidemiology, Cosmology, and Climate Science

labels.reference_summary: Census Bureau data show that almost all firms using AI report no effect on total employment. In the November 2025 to February 2026 supplement of the Business Trends and Outlook Survey, 2.3% of firms said AI increased employment, 2.0% said it decreased employment and 95.7% reported no change, close to the December 2023 to February 2024 answers of 2.8%, 2.6% and 94.6%. Reported use of AI to produce goods and services rose from 3.7% in September 2023 to about 10% by late 2025, and a broadened question in November 2025 produced a jump to about 18%. Among firms using generative AI, 85% cited writing or editing documents and email as the biggest use and 13% cited coding.

title: Census data shows most AI-using firms report no employment change

labels.reference_summary: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs published a joint approach to bioresilience covering prevention, detection and response. Over the past 12 months they advanced more than 15 partnerships with government bodies, biosecurity organizations and research groups. For models like Gemini they follow a four-step safety process of threat modeling, evaluations, mitigations and monitoring, and they are adapting SynthID watermarking to biology so DNA synthesis providers could screen for risky AI-generated biological sequences. The agent AlphaEvolve can optimize algorithms used for producing and analyzing metagenomic sequencing data. Isomorphic Labs has established a unit to deploy its drug design engine during novel outbreaks.

title: Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs outline bioresilience strategy using AI

labels.reference_summary: Mistral released Leanstral, an open-source code agent designed for the Lean 4 proof assistant, with weights under an Apache 2.0 license, an agent mode in Mistral Vibe and a free API endpoint. The model has 6B active parameters and a highly sparse architecture. On FLTEval, which scores completing formal proofs and defining new mathematical concepts in each PR to the FLT project, Leanstral reaches 26.3 at pass@2 and 31.9 at pass@16, while Qwen3.5-397B-A17B needs 4 passes to reach 25.4 and GLM5-744B-A40B and Kimi-K2.5 cap at about 16.6 and 20.1. Leanstral pass@2 costs $36 to run against Sonnet's $549, and Claude Opus 4.6 costs $1,650.

title: Leanstral: Open-Source Code Agent for Formal Verification

labels.reference_summary: A finetuned multi-vector model, mLateOn-medical, trained in 14.5 hours on a single RTX 3090 at a peak of 17.5 GB VRAM, topped an evaluation of over 50 retrieval model configurations across four architecture families. The test used 1,000 held-out medical questions from MIRIAD searching 200,000 unique passages. It beat the strongest zero-shot model of any architecture by 0.062 NDCG@10, returning the right passage as the first hit for 84.9% of queries against 75.8%. Training used 1 million question-passage pairs, in-batch negatives with GradCache, a batch size of 128 and a learning rate of 1e-4, and starting from a pre-supervised checkpoint beat continuing from a finished one. The raw index is about 45 GB at fp16.

title: Finetuning Multi-Vector Models for Enhanced Retrieval Performance

labels.reference_summary: Flint is a visualization intermediate language that lets AI agents generate charts from compact, human-editable specifications. Its compiler derives parsing rules, scales, axes, aggregations, formatting, color schemes and layout from the data, semantic types, chart type and encodings, and a single spec can compile to Vega-Lite, Apache ECharts or Chart.js. Compared with DirectVL, a baseline that asks the model to generate full Vega-Lite specifications, Flint scored 16.27 against 15.91 with GPT-5.1, 16.16 against 15.60 with GPT-5-mini and 15.91 against 15.34 with GPT-4.1. The open-source project includes the flint-chart library and the flint-chart-mcp server, and Flint now powers Data Formulator, a Microsoft Research project.

title: Flint enables AI agents to generate polished charts from simple specifications

labels.reference_summary: Sudden floods and landslides in Nepal killed or swept away relatives of Nepali families living in Delhi, and many have lost contact with remote areas. On 26 August, Sunita Thapa and her son Dinesh Thapa were at their home in Trishuli Bazaar when the water came; Dinesh's body was found about three days later in the plains near Narayangarh, and Sunita is still missing. Sagar Sapkota, 33, was driving a bus carrying about 38 people, including his mother Rammaya Sapkota, 57, and sister Sushmita Kunwar, 19, when the flood swept the bus away about seven kilometres from the China border, and only one body has been recovered. Sudhir Kumar Shah, 34, a mechanical engineer, was working with a team of about 60 people at the Trishuli-1 hydropower project in Rasuwa when all were swept away.

title: Delhi Nepali families mourn relatives lost in Nepal floods

labels.reference_summary: Parents in Illinois and California sued Meta in federal court in Chicago, saying it used their Facebook and Instagram photos without consent to build NameTag, an unreleased face-recognition system for its smart glasses, and to train Emu and Muse Image. The proposed class action seeks $5,000 for each intentional or reckless violation under Illinois' Biometric Information Privacy Act. Meta said the lawsuit is without merit and that it is not building a universal face database. In 2020 Meta paid $650 million to settle an earlier Illinois class action over face recognition.

title: Parents Sue Meta Over Alleged Illegal Use of Photos for AI and Face Recognition

labels.reference_summary: The United Nations says the planet now sits in the danger zone of extreme weather, based on data suggesting the current El Nino will break all previous records. The relative index for August was 2.3C above average, and the event is unusually warm this early in the season. Indonesia battled massive wildfires this month, and four tropical cyclones are active in the Pacific at once. Nearly 50 million people in vulnerable communities are likely to be pushed into acute hunger. Australia's Bureau of Meteorology expects an unusually dry spring and summer across eastern and central Australia.

title: Scientists warn record El Niño will trigger extreme global weather

labels.reference_summary: AWS published a walkthrough for a WhatsApp ordering assistant built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. One WhatsApp Business number handles text, voice notes and voice calls. Amazon Nova 2 Lite handles text through the Converse API and Amazon Nova 2 Sonic handles speech. AgentCore Gateway exposes the restaurant backend as Model Context Protocol tools the agents call by name, and one shared AgentCore memory keyed by a hashed customer ID recognizes the same person across all three channels. The AWS Cloud Development Kit deploys the stacks, and the first build of each container takes roughly 8-12 minutes.

title: AWS demonstrates multimodal WhatsApp ordering assistant using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

labels.reference_summary: Residents of Sisak and other Croatian towns protested against proposed industrial poultry facilities. Organizers said they had identified 24 planned poultry projects across three counties by April 2026, advanced separately by MHP and Premium Chicken Company. Around 5,000 people marched in Zagreb in February, more than 1,000 attended a follow-up protest in Sisak, and over 51,000 signed a petition. MHP said in May 2026 that it had withdrawn from its Sisak-area project because the local community did not support it, which cancelled 12 of the 24 subprojects. On March 3, 2026 the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Green Transition terminated the environmental assessment procedure for the PCC complex.

title: Croatian communities protest planned industrial poultry slaughterhouses

labels.reference_summary: Norwegian shipbuilder Vard launched the hull of an offshore subsea construction vessel it is building for Taiwan-based Dong Fang Offshore. The launch was celebrated on 21 August at the Braila shipyard in Romania, and the vessel now goes to Vard Soviknes in Norway for final outfitting, commissioning and delivery. Delivery is scheduled for Q2 2027. The 121.3-metre vessel is equipped for subsea duties, offshore wind operations and maintenance, and cable installation and repair. It will carry a 250 MT active heave compensated offshore crane and a 1,200 m2 work deck, and can accommodate up to 130 people.

title: Subsea construction vessel bound for Taiwan is heading to Norway for final outfitting

labels.reference_summary: A Hindi podcast panel discussed large-scale deletion of names from the Delhi voter list under SIR, and the first-quarter growth rate of 7.8% that the prime minister presented as evidence of a strong economy. A former finance secretary disputed the method behind that figure. A guest economist said the 2.6% number has no basis because nominal figures from two different base years cannot be compared, and that the last reliable inflation calculation, in January, was 2.5%. The panel also covered floods in Nepal and a Supreme Court decision quashing FIRs against NEET-UG protesters.

title: NL Charcha 439 covers Delhi voter list cuts, GDP growth debate and more

labels.reference_summary: A three-judge panel of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit ruled unanimously that the Department of Energy acted outside its legal authority when it ordered the J.H. Campbell coal plant in Michigan to keep running. The DOE has used Section 202(c) of the 1935 Federal Power Act to force seven fossil-fuel power plants to stay open. It issued the first Campbell order in May 2025 and six more since, because each emergency order lasts only 90 days. Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel said the order cost Consumers Energy customers $180 million through March. The Sierra Club estimated the total cost of the must-run orders at nearly $550 million.

title: Federal Court Rules Trump Administration Exceeded Authority Forcing Michigan Coal Plant To Stay Open

labels.reference_summary: Google announced AlphaGenome Atlas, a resource that tries to predict the consequences of every possible single-base variant in the human genome. The human genome is about 3 billion bases long, so trying the other three DNA bases at each position sends a total of 9 billion bases through AlphaGenome. The software identifies potential functions of non-coding DNA, which makes up the vast majority of the genome; the protein-coding portion is less than 3 percent. Until biologists use it heavily, it will not be clear what AlphaGenome offers beyond what its training data already held.

title: Google announces AlphaGenome Atlas to evaluate single-base genome changes

labels.reference_summary: AWS described HyperPod InstantStart, an open source control plane for Amazon SageMaker HyperPod that runs as a single management container in a customer's AWS account. A web interface and an AI agent drive the same backend APIs. The agent plans the multi-stage workflow, polls each long-running operation to a terminal state, and pauses only for choices such as Availability Zone, instance type and capacity type. The MCP server publishes 38 tools covering cluster lifecycle, instance groups, managed features, storage and inference deployment. EKS control-plane creation finishes in roughly 8-12 minutes, and every later stage is independently retryable.

title: Amazon launches InstantStart for agent-driven SageMaker HyperPod operations
