labels.reference_summary: Cypress Creek Energy's Ostrea Solar project in Yakima County, Washington has reached commercial operation, adding 104 MWDC to the Bonneville Power Administration transmission system. The project was supported by $180 million in private funds, and Microsoft is the long-term offtaker of the energy and environmental products it generates. Cypress Creek modified the design to conserve approximately 275 acres of shrubsteppe habitat and added wildlife corridors for Rocky Mountain elk. PCL Solar Constructors was the construction contractor. Construction created approximately 300 jobs at prevailing wage rates, and about 75 apprentices contributed 39,000 hours.

title: Cypress Creek Energy activates Washington solar project with wildlife corridors

labels.reference_summary: TutorMoments is a replay-based evaluation that measures whether a language model knows when to help a student and when to hold back. It pauses a real math tutoring transcript at a teacher-flagged decision point, hands the session to a model for five turns with a simulated student, then scores the continuation. The preview dataset holds 462 de-identified transcripts of one-on-one tutoring with U.S. students in grades 2-7, with more than 1,500 teacher-annotated key moments from 27 teacher annotators. Seven models were tested, and every one scored higher under a prompt that spells out the trade-off. Human tutors scored 0.458 on appropriate scaffolding and 0.182 on appropriate rigor.

title: TutorMoments evaluates AI tutors' ability to balance support and challenge in math sessions

labels.reference_summary: Romanian hydropower company Hidroelectrica selected Bucharest-based Synergy Construct to install a battery energy storage system at its Iron Gates II hydropower plant. The company is investing RON 296.8 million, or EUR 56.5 million, in a system with 64 MW of installed capacity and 434.76 MWh of storage capacity. It will become the largest battery storage asset in the company's portfolio. Hidroelectrica operates 6,300 MW of hydropower capacity, is about to commission its first battery at the Crucea Nord wind park, and is designing battery facilities totalling 200 MW and 800 MWh on the lower Olt River.

title: Hidroelectrica selects contractor for Iron Gates II battery storage project

labels.reference_summary: Google won a $10 million bid in mid-August to buy some 34 years of Spirit Airlines data out of the airline's bankruptcy, beating a $7.5 million offer from Mercor. The union representing 5,500 former Spirit flight attendants filed an objection, arguing the sale sweeps in sensitive employee records and that deidentifying data is not the same as confidentiality. A court filing lists more than 1 million time-card records, over 175,000 employee records, 80,000 email accounts and 500 million Microsoft Teams records. A judge must approve the sale. The union is separately demanding roughly $68 million in unpaid vacation, health care and back pay.

title: Spirit Airlines' Data Sale Sparks Labor Union Opposition Over Employee Privacy

labels.reference_summary: The final electrolyser array for the 100 MW Hamburg Green Hydrogen Hub has arrived at the construction site. Luxcara is developing the project with Hamburger Energiewerke on part of the former Moorburg power plant site, repurposing existing energy infrastructure rather than building a new one. The equipment will convert renewable electricity into hydrogen through electrolysis. With deliveries complete, the project moves on to installation, system integration and commissioning, and is expected to become a significant source of renewable hydrogen for Hamburg and the surrounding industrial region.

title: Hamburg's 100 MW hydrogen hub receives final electrolyser array

labels.reference_summary: OpenReel Video is a free timeline-based video editor that runs entirely in a browser, with dedicated Android and iOS apps for mobile. Timeline editing lets a person combine several video files into one, add captions or background music, and tweak the transitions between clips. Nothing has to be installed, and a first result can come in as little as a minute or two. The tip originally appeared in the free Cool Tools newsletter from The Intelligence.

title: OpenReel Video offers free browser-based timeline editing

labels.reference_summary: Chevron announced plans to double its production in Venezuela with a $7 billion investment, eight months after U.S. forces arrested former dictator Nicolas Maduro and Washington backed his vice president, Delcy Rodriguez, as the new leader. GE Vernova signed its own deal to repair large portions of Venezuela's power grid. U.S. exports of liquefied natural gas averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to the Energy Information Administration. Diesel sold for $5.69 per gallon and regular gasoline averaged $4.12 per gallon.

title: American Energy Companies Scramble Into Venezuela Amid New Leadership

labels.reference_summary: Chinese company Tencent released Hy4 Preview, a new open weight text input language model with no vision, carrying 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, a 1M token context window and 1.56TB of files on Hugging Face. That is a large size increase over Hy3 in July, which had 295B total parameters, 21B active, a 256,000 token context window and 598GB. The published chat template exposes only two reasoning effort levels, high and no_think, with high as the default.

title: Tencent launches Hy4 Preview, a massive 770B parameter open-weight LLM

labels.reference_summary: SB Energy, the SoftBank subsidiary, filed for an initial public offering with the SEC, reportedly aiming to raise between $5 billion and $7 billion, and describes itself as an integrated data center and power infrastructure company. It was founded in 2019 as a renewables developer and only began pivoting to AI infrastructure in 2025. Its operational assets as of June 2026 were about 2.2 GW of solar and storage projects in California and Texas, with no data center or gas capacity in operation. The filing shows $138.7 million of revenue for the first half of 2026. It says the company does not expect to own or operate the gas-fired generation serving the PORTS-Pike campus.

title: SB Energy files IPO seeking $5-7B for AI data center and gas projects

labels.reference_summary: Insurance claims adjusters are the most critical group about AI in the American workforce, according to Glassdoor research finding that adjusters who mention AI in reviews are critical 98 percent of the time. Adjusters describe misclassified claims, hallucinated summaries and extra rework they must clean up. Employment in the sector dropped 21 percent between May 2025 and May 2026, and entry-level postings have fallen 50 percent since 2025. The Bureau of Labor Statistics cited technology as a major force behind the decline. At Lemonade, the chatbot AI Jim handled initial reports 96 percent of the time by the end of last year.

title: Insurance Claims Adjusters Express Strong Opposition to AI Implementation

labels.reference_summary: Databricks raised the size of Postgres shared buffers on fixed-size Lakebase computes and backed them with explicit 2 MB huge pages across its VM infrastructure. Shared buffers had been capped at 1 GB, which forced most cache hits through the slower local file cache tier. In benchmark tests, huge pages reduced tail read latency by up to about 40% and cut CPU utilization by up to about 30%. On one large endpoint, accessed Postgres blocks per second doubled and storage GetPage calls fell from about 8K per second to about 1.5K. Work to bring larger shared buffers to autoscaling computes continues.

title: Databricks improves Lakebase Postgres compute cache performance

labels.reference_summary: Databricks will present four accepted papers at VLDB 2026 covering Lakebase, Spark Structured Streaming and automatic Lakehouse optimizations, plus a demo of Enzyme, its incremental view maintenance engine. Co-founder Reynold Xin gives the opening keynote on how AI agents are ushering in a third golden age of database engineering. Lakebase decouples serverless PostgreSQL compute from storage and persists data and write-ahead logs directly in cloud object storage using open formats. AutoLiquid outperformed customer-selected clustering keys on over 95% of evaluated workloads, and Ultron improved median join latency by 25%.

title: Databricks presents Lakebase and LTAP innovations at VLDB 2026

labels.reference_summary: A senior Singaporean argues that ministers' high salaries should be judged against the cost of inadequate leadership, not by the dollar amount alone. Singapore is a small country with no natural resources, so its people are its greatest resource and it needs capable, honest and committed leaders to guide it through a competitive world. Competitive remuneration helps attract and retain talented people from the public and private sectors. High salaries must come with high expectations of integrity, accountability, transparency and performance. Ministerial pay is to rise by up to 9% in the first adjustment since 2011.

title: Ng Choon Lai argues capable leadership is vital for Singapore's survival

labels.reference_summary: Google announced Vibe Coding XR, a rapid prototyping workflow that pairs Gemini Canvas with the open-source XR Blocks framework to turn prompts into interactive, physics-aware WebXR applications for Android XR. It translates natural language into a working app in under 60 seconds, and a simulated reality environment in desktop Chrome lets creators test interactions before deploying to a headset. The team built VCXR60, a dataset of 60 prompts from 20 Googler participants sourced from four one-hour internal workshops, and measured inference time and one-shot success rate. Early versions reached roughly a 70% success rate before 11 major releases.

title: Google Announces Vibe Coding XR for Rapid AI Prototyping

labels.reference_summary: IBM announced a modular architecture for the cryogenic systems that cool its superconducting quantum processors. Instead of isolated cylindrical cryostats, each unit is a box-shaped cell of solid aluminum panels that sits tightly beside its neighbours, with quantum cables routed through a shielded tunnel between them. Each cell provides approximately 0.53 square meters of wiring area and 2.75 cubic meters of vacuum chamber volume, roughly 3x the size of a typical kitchen fridge. IBM coupled and operated two prototype cells at its Poughkeepsie facility. The architecture is a step toward IBM Quantum Starling, its first fault-tolerant quantum computer, expected in 2029.

title: IBM Introduces Modular Cryogenic Architecture for Quantum Computing Scalability

labels.reference_summary: A large-scale empirical study examined Group Relative Policy Optimization in multilingual and non-English settings, across a wide range of base models, training languages and reasoning language rewards. Training a model to reason in the native language often leaves only a small gap to training for English reasoning. Training in one language often improves performance in many others, showing strong crosslingual transfer. But trends are highly model- and language-dependent, and in some cases training in a particular language induces severe regressions on out-of-domain capabilities in other languages. The authors conclude that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards beyond English requires broad evaluation to detect those regressions.

title: GRPO Study Shows Crosslingual Gains and Language-Specific Risks in Multilingual Training

labels.reference_summary: A video circulating on social media claims Jawaharlal Nehru said he was not involved in the fight for independence and that he opposed it. The claim is false. The clip has been cropped and given misleading subtitles. In the longer version Nehru says 'Mr Jinnah was not involved in the fight for independence at all. In fact, he opposed it', so he is describing Muhammad Ali Jinnah's position rather than his own. The original is Nehru's last television interview from May 1964, uploaded by Prasar Bharati Archives, and the exchange sits at around the 14:34 timestamp.

title: Nehru's Interview Clarifies He Spoke About Jinnah's Opposition, Not His Own

labels.reference_summary: TUV SUD certified Ansaldo Energia's GT36 gas turbine for Hydrogen Readiness, and DNV validated operation of the AE94.3A combustion system on hydrotreated vegetable oil, a liquid fuel made from biological feedstocks. The GT36 is currently offered with hydrogen capability of up to 70% by volume, and the certification confirms a pathway toward 100% hydrogen capability. DNV ran an independent witness testing campaign at the Sesta Lab facility in Radicondoli, Italy, which confirmed combustion stability across the operating range with no flashback events or test trips during full HVO operation.

title: Ansaldo Energia gains hydrogen and HVO fuel certifications for turbines

labels.reference_summary: John Iliffe, a scholar of African history, died on 20 August 2026 at the age of 87. He wrote 12 books over a career lasting more than 40 years, taught undergraduates in Tanzania, Malawi and the UK, and trained over two dozen doctoral students. He took up a lectureship at the University College of Dar es Salaam in 1965 and coordinated the Maji Maji research project with Gilbert Gwassa, sending students to interview elderly people who had taken part in that anti-colonial war. His Modern History of Tanganyika, published in 1979, chronicled the economy and politics from 1800 to the 1950s in 616 pages. He insisted on putting African political actors at the centre of the story.

title: John Iliffe, historian who reshaped African history understanding, dies at 87

labels.reference_summary: Nextpower was issued a patent for its NX PowerMerge, a trunk bus that consolidates multiple field connections on ground-mounted solar projects onto one device. In utility-scale solar plants, DC collection systems connect power from multiple solar panel strings to larger trunk conductors across thousands of locations. The connector body is universal across trunk cable sizes, and an installation tool verifies pressure on every connection. BUILD Renewables has ordered NX PowerMerge for a pipeline of PV projects, increasing the Nextpower backlog for the product to over 2 GW.

title: Nextpower's NX PowerMerge trunk bus secures patent for solar projects

labels.reference_summary: Norway is the Guest Country of Honor at the China International Fair for Trade in Services in Beijing, which runs from September 9 to 13. Norwegian companies are showing green energy, digital technology, healthy living products and premium nutrition, and China is Norway's most important trading partner in Asia. DNV, which began ship inspection and classification in China in 1888, now works with Chinese shipbuilders on vessels designed for alternative fuels. Falkor built a digital model of the Deep Sea No. 1 gas field in the South China Sea. Huawei Norway helped develop an AI fish trap that separates invasive pink salmon from native Atlantic salmon with an accuracy of more than 90%.

title: Norway seeks deeper cooperation with China on green energy and digital solutions

labels.reference_summary: The Social Platforms Data Access Taskforce, established by Smart Data Research UK and co-chaired by the Universities of Sheffield and Cambridge, concludes that no single mechanism can meet the range of research needs for studying online harms. Its report argues for a layered approach across three routes: public-interest web scraping, data donation, and an independent statutory data intermediary. Twitter, now X, withdrew its free research API for academic researchers in 2023, and Meta closed CrowdTangle the following year, making platform data harder to obtain. The Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 already created powers to establish a researcher-access framework for online safety research.

title: UK Taskforce Recommends Layered Approach to Social Media Data Access

labels.reference_summary: The dollar's share of global official foreign exchange reserves fell from 64 percent in 2015 to 56 percent in 2025, but that decline is not a broad shift away from dollar assets. Across both four-year windows, roughly equal numbers of countries increased and decreased their dollar holdings. From 2015 to 2019, across seventy-six countries with complete data, the fall split almost evenly between a preferences channel worth 1.2 percentage points and a reserve change channel worth 1.5. China and Russia dominated the preferences channel. For 2019 to 2023, four countries missing from the data imply a preferences contribution of 2.0 percentage points.

title: Goldberg, Hannaoui, and Parthasarathy find central bank dollar shifts are concentrated

labels.reference_summary: Therese Bonomo, Krista J. Ruffini and Diane Whitmore Schanzenbach studied four pandemic-era transfers to low-income families with children. They compared one-time food vouchers, monthly food benefits, one-time cash payments and monthly cash payments using high-frequency household scanner data. Households spend more out of in-kind benefits than out of cash transfers of similar value, and more out of recurring than one-time transfers in the short run. Short-run food-store spending rates were 0.18 for one-time in-kind and 0.38 for monthly in-kind, against 0.06 and 0.20 for cash.

title: Researchers find transfer design shapes how households spend pandemic aid

labels.reference_summary: Mitsubishi Electric agreed to acquire PCI Energy Solutions, a US provider of enterprise software for energy management and optimisation, in a transaction valued at $1.4bn. The deal is expected to close in 2026, subject to regulatory approvals, after which PCI will become a wholly owned subsidiary. Mitsubishi Electric says about 60% of US power generation is managed by PCI's platform. Soichi Hamamoto said the objective is to build on PCI's strengths while creating capacity for long-term innovation and global growth. Fred Lee said Mitsubishi Electric intends to retain the core management team.

title: Mitsubishi Electric Acquires PCI Energy Solutions for $1.4bn to Expand Smart Energy Capabilities

labels.reference_summary: T&D World Live 2026 will hold an Innovation Shares general session from 3:45 to 5 p.m. on Sept. 1, where five solution providers show technologies addressing grid reliability and resilience, digital transformation and workforce efficiency. Speakers include Jay Jenkins and Matt Zafuto of Cyberhawk, Mark Esguerra of Southern California Edison, Codie Boggs of Exodigo, Georg Rute of Gridraven, Miguel Cordeiro of Spotlite and Joseph Hunter of TS Conductor Corporation. After the presentations the audience will vote to determine the Most Innovative Solution. The event runs Sept. 1-3 in Orlando, Florida.

title: Utility Professionals to Judge Grid Innovation at T&D World Live 2026

labels.reference_summary: Elektroprivreda Republike Srpske launched a tender to build the 60 MW Hrgud wind farm in southern Bosnia and Herzegovina. The plan covers 10 wind turbines and annual generation estimated at around 160 GWh, with total investment estimated at BAM 187 million, or around EUR 95.7 million. Bidders must also arrange financing under the EPC+F model, so the financing percentage and terms will be evaluated alongside capacity factor and completion timeline. The German government suspended financing in 2023, and the project was reactivated in December 2025. Bids close on October 12, 2026.

title: Bosnian utility invites bids for 60 MW Hrgud wind farm project

labels.reference_summary: US utility-scale battery storage grew at an annual average rate of 70% over the last three years. The power system held 43.6 GW of operational battery storage at the end of 2025, and operators added another 8.3 GW during the first six months of 2026, reaching nearly 52 GW. Operators plan a further 54 GW over the next two and a half years, including 14 GW in the second half of this year, 26 GW in 2027 and 14 GW in 2028. The Bellefield Solar and Energy Storage Farm pairs 500 megawatts of photovoltaic capacity with 500 megawatts of storage for the California Independent System Operator.

title: U.S. battery storage capacity grows 70% annually, reaching 52 GW

labels.reference_summary: Bailey Flanigan is a shared faculty member between the MIT Schwarzman College of Computing and the MIT departments of Political Science and Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, and a principal investigator in the MIT Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems. Her joint appointment began in fall 2025. She has developed algorithms that randomly choose participants of citizens' assemblies, balancing representation against equality among individuals' chances to participate, resistance to manipulation and transparency. That work is deployed on panelot.org, an open-access website hosting algorithms for randomly selecting citizen assembly participants. She studied at the University of Wisconsin at Madison, worked at Princeton and chose Carnegie Mellon for her PhD.

title: Bailey Flanigan's interdisciplinary journey shapes research on democratic participation

labels.reference_summary: Companies putting AI systems into production still need engineers to hand-assemble persistence, memory, permissions, tracing, retries, orchestration, durable execution, tool access, context management and evaluation. Frontier models, elastic cloud infrastructure, vector databases, managed APIs and large amounts of computation are available to any serious company, but the missing piece is a higher-level abstraction. The comparison drawn is with programming before high-level languages, citing John Backus on 'hand-to-hand combat with the machine' and IBM's history of Fortran expressing up to a thousand machine instructions in 47 statements. LangChain's own split between an agent's harness and the runtime underneath is offered as evidence that the layer is missing.

title: Author argues corporate AI lacks fundamental programming abstractions

labels.reference_summary: Interconnects launched two free data projects covering the open model ecosystem: the Artifacts Hub, a curated view of models trending on Hugging Face, and an Adoption Dashboard tracking download and derivative model numbers by geography and organization. The Artifacts Hub covers 792 models released in the last two years, across text-focused language models and multimodal generative models. It shows inference tokens via Open Router, model intelligence via Artificial Analysis, and relative adoption metric scores for time-size normalized downloads. The Hub was built with Project VAIL, an AI verification startup. The dashboard updates daily the US-China adoption data behind The ATOM Project.

title: Interconnects Launches Artifacts Hub and Adoption Dashboard to Track Open Model Ecosystem

labels.reference_summary: Cities that become regional capitals grow faster than comparable cities, according to research by Bluhm, Lessmann and Schaudt using hundreds of administrative reforms worldwide. The study documents changes in first-order regions and their capitals between 1987 and 2018 and combines them with spatial data on city boundaries, population and night-time lights. Five or more years after a reform, night-time light intensity is roughly 14-22% higher in the preferred estimates, and the effect becomes visible after about two years. Nearby cities also grow faster. Gains are larger where internal market access is stronger, and new capitals attract more educated migrants.

title: New research shows regional capital status boosts urban growth when market access is strong

labels.reference_summary: PyTorch Conference North America 2026 runs October 20-21 in San Jose, CA, with vLLM appearing across sessions on KV cache management and disaggregated serving, hardware portability, kernel optimization, PyTorch integration, Mixture-of-Experts inference, attention and production serving. Talks cover native tiered KV cache offloading, Elastic Expert Parallelism, prefix caching for multi-stage pipelines, and running SGLang and vLLM on TPUs. Speakers come from Red Hat, IBM, NVIDIA, Meta, Google, Amazon, Intel, Huawei, Arm and Mistral AI. One session reports 4.8x to 7.5x faster model loading with fastsafetensors and up to 28 GB/s of NVMe read throughput.

title: vLLM Sessions at PyTorch Conference North America 2026

labels.reference_summary: Europe's ePrivacy framework controls access to a person's device and the confidentiality of communications, a separate question from what the GDPR governs once personal data are processed. Article 7 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights protects private life, the home and communications, while Article 8 protects personal data. Article 5(3), the provision behind many cookie banners, controls when an actor may store information on or obtain information from terminal equipment, which includes phones, connected cars, televisions, wearables and smart glasses. The Commission proposed an ePrivacy Regulation in 2017, withdrew it in 2025, and has now proposed moving terminal-equipment rules into the GDPR through the Digital Omnibus. One proposed remedy is letting people express privacy choices once through browsers, operating systems or apps, with services required to respect those machine-readable signals.

title: Authors argue Europe's cookie law protects device access rather than just data

labels.reference_summary: MIT President Sally Kornbluth said the innovation and talent pipeline could run dry without federal support for curiosity-driven research. She spoke on a Washington Post Live panel moderated by Zachary Goldfarb alongside Arizona State University President Michael Crow. Kornbluth said money has been appropriated for universities but has not been released to them by and large. She said MIT's new curriculum leans into basic STEM fields while resurrecting moral, civic and ethical educational goals, and that students should use AI as an augmentation tool. She said MIT has spun out north of 30,000 companies and offers free tuition to students with parental incomes under $200,000.

title: MIT President Warns of Innovation Drought Without Federal Research Funding

labels.reference_summary: US Air Force cadet Joshua Lynch built a working application over three months using only chatbot prompts and no previous coding experience, mentored by Laura Niss of MIT Lincoln Laboratory. He used the paid models of Anthropic's Claude, OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini, and produced the final application with Google AI Studio App. Limits in the chatbots and in development time forced him to re-scope the project from battlefield assistance to basic document processing, such as analyzing tactical maps and generating mission-planning documents. Lynch did not realize the final application was sending input documents to a Gemini model rather than parsing them locally. The Department of the Air Force Artificial Intelligence Accelerator sponsored the work.

title: Air Force Cadet Uses AI to Develop Battlefield Software with Minimal Coding Experience

labels.reference_summary: Repeated power cuts in eastern Libya have interrupted water supply from the Great Man-Made River system. A region-wide blackout on July 18 cut power to the Sarir and Tazerbo wellfields and a pumping station in Benghazi. On July 3 the Man-Made River Authority said a single electrical disturbance had knocked 41 Sarir wells and 11 Tazerbo wells offline. On July 23 an outage linked to a generating unit at the Sarir gas power station forced 143 wells out of service, 92 in Sarir and 51 in Tazerbo, and water supply to some cities was reduced for 24 hours. Libya holds Africa's largest proven oil reserves, so the failures point to planning, governance and accountability rather than scarcity.

title: Libya's Cyrenaica faces repeated power cuts disrupting water access

labels.reference_summary: In 1914 Yitzhak Ben-Zvi and David Ben-Gurion were studying law at Istanbul University in the Ottoman capital, hoping one day to serve in the Assembly of Deputies as elected representatives from Jerusalem. Both later became president and prime minister of Israel after 1948. With war on the horizon they returned to Palestine and volunteered for military service in the Ottoman army, and proposed a Jewish legion to fight under the Ottoman banner, which was not taken up. Moshe Sharett, another future prime minister of Israel, served in the Ottoman army during the Balkan Wars and through the First World War. The passage comes from The War That Made the Middle East by Mustafa Aksakal.

title: Two Israeli leaders studied law in Ottoman Turkey before WWI

labels.reference_summary: Inox Clean Energy acquired Vena Energy India in a transaction valued at around $626.7m, or Rs60bn, through its subsidiary Inox Neo Energies. Vena Energy India was the Indian renewable energy business of the Vena Group, owned by BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners. Its portfolio includes around 1GW of operational assets, 1.7GW of solar and wind capacity and 1.2GWh of battery storage at an advanced stage, plus a pipeline of 2.7GW of solar and wind and 1.3GWh of storage. Inox Clean Energy's combined operational and near-operational portfolio is expected to approach 4GW, with a development pipeline above 12GW. Devansh Jain said the speed of the closing demonstrates fast execution capabilities.

title: Inox Clean Energy acquires Vena Energy India's renewable assets for $627m

labels.reference_summary: Google DeepMind is working with the UK government, Google Cloud, Faculty and the local planning authorities in Barnet, Dorset and Camden to co-develop an AI prototype for householder planning applications. The goal is to help officers cut application decision times by 50%. Householder applications account for nearly 70% of planning applications each year, and the UK is working to build 1.5 million new homes by 2029. The prototype consolidates site data, identifies relevant national and local policies with citations, summarizes consultation letters and drafts assessments. Following early trials, the government plans to make the tool available to all councils nationally from 2027.

title: UK government and Google DeepMind develop AI tool to speed up planning applications

labels.reference_summary: Siemens Energy's Omnivise Energy Management System moves utilities from monitoring a plant to deciding what should happen next, said Sarah Dietrich-Smith and Katie Hanley on The POWER Podcast. Dietrich-Smith said assets were historically managed individually and the aim is a fleet optimization mindset that allocates flexibility and manages risk across a portfolio. Hanley said rising renewable penetration makes dispatchable options scarcer, and that batteries now create dispatchable flexibility that previously came only from large gas assets. Hanley said customers typically see returns within a year through reduced fuel costs, better-monetized excess capacity and penalty avoidance. Dietrich-Smith said deep equipment knowledge separates Siemens Energy from competitors coming from an AI software layer background.

title: Siemens Energy shifts from monitoring to decision-making with Omnivise

labels.reference_summary: Finno Exergy, a Finnish company founded in 2013, is developing pressure gain combustion, which raises rather than reduces the pressure of the working fluid during combustion in a gas turbine. The system uses controlled, pulsating fast deflagration rather than detonation, and replaces the conventional combustion system while retaining the principal compressor and turbine components. A 2025 simulation-based feasibility study with a gas turbine original equipment manufacturer indicated fuel consumption could fall by more than 10% on a 10 MW industrial machine. Frame 3 and Frame 5 gas turbines were identified as priority platforms because their can-type combustion systems leave more physical space. Finno Exergy worked with Shell between 2021 and 2024 after winning the New Energy Challenge in 2020.

title: Pressure gain combustion: an efficiency step-change for gas turbines

labels.reference_summary: A video shared widely on social media purports to show a roadside food vendor adding sewage water to a rice dish, and users claimed it came from India. The video carries a watermark for Google's AI model Gemini. Asked for a SynthID check, which detects whether media was made or altered using Google's AI tools, Gemini confirmed that both the visuals and the audio were edited or generated using Google AI and that the SynthID watermark was present throughout. The video is AI-generated and the claim about the street vendor is false.

title: Fact-Check: Video of Hawker Adding Sewage Water to Biryani Is AI-Generated

labels.reference_summary: A video of a group of boys in a boat finding a backpack with money was shared with the claim that it came from the aftermath of the floods in Nepal, and one post by the Instagram page 'newsly.india' gathered nearly 6.5 lakh views. The claim is false. Keyframes made with InVID and reverse image searches led to an Instagram account, 'parshuram_676', where a user identified as Parshuram Nishad had shared the video on 14 July 2026, predating the floods by at least a month. Nishad commented that the video was shot in Vrindavan, in Uttar Pradesh. Odisha TV also published a report about the video.

title: Old Varanasi video falsely linked to Nepal floods goes viral

labels.reference_summary: The US power sector added 20.2 gigawatt-hours of battery capacity from April through June, more than in any previous quarter, according to a report from the Solar Energy Industries Association and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence. That is one-tenth of the nation's entire grid storage capacity, and seven of the new projects mustered at least 1 GWh. The quarter's installations can inject 6.7 gigawatts of instantaneous power onto the grid. Benchmark Minerals raised its prediction for cumulative installs through 2030 by 11.5% from a report issued three months earlier. Solar plants hosted 44% of the new storage capacity, and 74% of the second-quarter additions happened in states that voted for Trump.

title: US grid battery installations hit record levels in second quarter

labels.reference_summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta and the California Energy Commission sued the Trump administration and Golden State Wind LLC on 28 August over the buyout of an offshore wind energy lease. The Department of the Interior reached a deal worth USD 885 million in April with Bluepoint Wind and Golden State Wind developers to terminate their leases in exchange for a refund of lease fees. Golden State Wind would recover about USD 120 million after making an equivalent investment in US oil and gas assets, energy infrastructure or LNG projects along the Gulf Coast. California argues the agreement violates the Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act and settles litigation Golden State Wind never brought. The state aims to develop 25 GW of offshore wind by 2045.

title: California Sues Trump Administration and Wind Developer Over Lease Cancellation

labels.reference_summary: Michael S. Barr said recent steps by the Federal Reserve and other agencies will undermine the safety and soundness of banks and increase financial stability risks, speaking at American University on June 06, 2026. He said the deregulatory proposals reduce the capital required for the largest banks by 6 percent in aggregate, which he put at $60 billion less capital, and that the eight GSIB firms hold around 60 percent of banking sector assets. He said the Board weakened the rating system used for the 36 largest financial institutions, and that matters requiring attention had fallen to roughly half their 2024 level by the end of 2025. He said bank credit commitments to other financial entities reached over $2.6 trillion in the second half of 2025.

title: Barr Warns of Financial Risks from Deregulation Amid Economic Boom

labels.reference_summary: A walkthrough deploys a customer-operated LiteLLM gateway on Amazon Elastic Container Service, connects it to an OpenAI model on Amazon Bedrock, and configures OpenAI Codex to use the gateway's Responses API. LiteLLM becomes the shared control point for model authentication, routing, budgets, rate limits and telemetry, while Codex keeps the local task and tool-execution loop on the developer workstation. The reference deployment also uses Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon ECR and optional AWS WAF protections. It was validated in the US East (N. Virginia) Region with the gateway alias openai.gpt-5.5. Direct access through IAM Identity Center and a managed path through Portkey are set out as alternatives.

title: OpenAI Codex integrates with LiteLLM gateway on Amazon ECS and Bedrock

labels.reference_summary: Five advanced nuclear companies will build, own and operate more than 20 commercial nuclear microreactors across five US Army installations under the Janus Program, drawing on up to $2.2 billion through fiscal year 2031. The Army selected BWXT Advanced Technologies for Fort Campbell, Radiant Industries for Fort Benning, General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems for Fort Hood, Antares Nuclear for Fort Bragg and Westinghouse Government Services for Fort Drum. Selected projects range in output from 100 kWe to 20 MWe, and the program targets first useful service by September 2028. Radiant secured a binding agreement worth up to $750 million for 15 Kaleidos units by 2030. Westinghouse's eVinci achieved zero-power criticality on Aug. 24, two days before the Janus announcement.

title: Five Companies Build 20 Microreactors for Army Under Janus Program

labels.reference_summary: Early placental mammals living about 160 million years ago regularly formed stable female-male pairs rather than living only solitary lives. A literature survey covering more than 15,000 scientific publications built a dataset of 806 of the 5,740 extant mammal species, 80 of them marsupials and 726 placental mammals. Of those species, 24% are solitary-living, 17% pair-living and 59% group-living. Statistical models that control for evolutionary relatedness estimated that about one-quarter of the ancestral placental population was pair-living. Among shrews and their relatives, around 400 species had been classified as solitary living but only 16 had actually been studied.

title: Scientists find early mammals lived in pairs alongside dinosaurs

labels.reference_summary: A tool that displays GeoJSON files on a map and exports the result as a PNG was built after GPT-5.6-Sol was asked for suggestions and proactively built one, followed by iterations using Claude Code for web and Fable 5.1. The maps covered local political boundaries for the Granada Community Services District and the Midcoast Community Council, which operates near Half Moon Bay, CA. The GeoJSON polygons came from ChatGPT Work, which extracted and combined files from different government data sources in response to plain requests for each boundary.

title: Developer builds GeoJSON map viewer after AI assistance

labels.reference_summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, the fastest and most cost-efficient model in its Gemini 3 series, rolling out in preview to developers via the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and to enterprises via Vertex AI. It is priced at $0.25 per 1M input tokens and $1.50 per 1M output tokens. Google says it outperforms 2.5 Flash with a 2.5X faster Time to First Answer Token and a 45% increase in output speed on the Artificial Analysis benchmark. It reaches an Elo score of 1432 on the Arena.ai Leaderboard, 86.9% on GPQA Diamond and 76.8% on MMMU Pro. Thinking levels let developers select how much the model thinks for a task.

title: Google launches Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite for high-volume developer workloads

labels.reference_summary: Meta described Hierarchical Interest Representation, a research area building an upstream representation layer over the universe of Ads entities including users, advertisers, products and services. It uses in-house transformer based graph learning with bias-aware attention and self-supervised cross-view distillation, trained end-to-end on real Meta ads data at the scale of billions of interactions. Multimodal advertiser and product content is processed through LLMs to enrich sparse interactions and generalize to rare and unseen entities. The system outputs universal embeddings and Bag-of-Meaning interest tokens intended to power personalization, retrieval, supervision and ranking across the ads stack, including GEM, Andromeda and the Adaptive Ranking Model. Pipelined subgraph fetches achieved a 30x wall-clock speedup over the synchronous baseline during testing.

title: Meta Develops Hierarchical Interest Representation for Deep Funnel Ad Optimization

labels.reference_summary: Baseten is now a supported Inference Provider on the Hugging Face Hub, reachable from model pages and through the huggingface_hub Python and @huggingface/inference JavaScript SDKs. The initial integration launches support for conversational and text-generation tasks, giving access to open-weight models including Kimi K3, the latest DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM-5.2. Users can set their own provider API keys, in which case the provider bills them, or route requests through Hugging Face at the standard provider rates with no added markup. PRO users get $2 worth of Inference credits every month.

title: Baseten integrates with Hugging Face for serverless model inference

labels.reference_summary: Micron Technology will give its engineers in Taiwan a cash bonus of NT$1 million, or S$40,000, plus equity rewards, after local unions demanded a larger payout. The company said on Sept 11 that average compensation for entry-level, Taiwan-based engineers will reach NT$3.4 million for the past fiscal year. The unions had asked for a one-time cash payout equal to about seven years of base salary, which Bloomberg calculated as about US$170,000 a worker. Micron reported a fifteenfold gain in net income in the third quarter, and its share price has risen more than 500 per cent over the past year. It employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan.

title: Micron offers Taiwan engineers $40,000 bonus amid union demands

labels.reference_summary: Alabama Power has marketed automated license plate readers and surveillance cameras to local governments since at least 2019. A company representative confirmed in 2025 that the utility has partnered with more than 80 municipalities across the state. Each camera and its related services cost cities around $250 per month, added as a line item on the power bill. Birmingham approved a $9.7 million contract with the utility in 2025 to install and maintain 100 cameras, adding to 330 approved the year before. Officers in Springville and Moody left their departments after alleged misuse of Flock data.

title: Alabama Power Partners With Surveillance Firms To Expand City Monitoring

labels.reference_summary: Roxanne D. Brown, international president of the United Steelworkers Union, argues that working people must elect their own to public office. Ryan Kominakis, a section griever with USW Local 1066 at U.S. Steel's Gary Works, is running for state representative in Indiana's 4th District after his energy bill doubled. A 2024 study from Duke University and Loyola University Chicago found that just 116 of the 7,300 state lawmakers it examined came from working-class backgrounds as of 2023. In 10 states the researchers found no such lawmaker at all.

title: Union Leader Calls for More Workers in Public Office

labels.reference_summary: OlmoEarth Studio now lets users compute and export embedding vectors from the open source OlmoEarth foundation models. Exports arrive as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs with one band per embedding dimension, stored as signed 8-bit integers running from -127 to +127, with -128 reserved for nodata. Encoder variants are Nano at 128 dimensions, Tiny at 192 dimensions and Base at 768 dimensions, at 10, 20, 40 or 80 meter resolution. A logistic regression trained on 60 labeled pixels over Ca Mau, Vietnam reached a weighted F1 of 0.84 across mangrove, water and other classes.

title: OlmoEarth Studio enables custom embedding exports for Earth observation analysis

labels.reference_summary: A monitor with at least one HDMI input can be reused as a TV. Plugging in a streaming device such as the Amazon Fire TV Stick or Roku Ultra gives access to apps, but copy-protected shows need High-Bandwidth Digital Copy Protection support. A digital tuning box such as the Tablo Gen 4 picks up free over-the-air channels, which carry no HDCP protection and can be recorded. For sound, a Bluetooth speaker such as the Sonos Era 100 SL or PC speakers such as the Logitech Z313 will work.

title: Repurposing old PC monitors as TVs with simple setup options

labels.reference_summary: A Federal Reserve policymaker told the 2026 Economic Luncheon of the Anchorage Economic Development Corporation that inflation is too high and has exceeded the 2 percent target for more than five years. The personal consumption expenditures price index rose 3.7 percent in the 12 months through June, and core prices rose 3.3 percent. Unemployment was 4.2 percent nationally in June and 4.4 percent in Alaska. Output grew at a 1.8 percent pace in the first half of the year and business investment rose at a 10 percent annual rate. The policymaker said a rate increase is possible if disinflation does not continue.

title: Economist Outlines U.S. and Alaska Economic Outlook at Anchorage Event

labels.reference_summary: IBM Research designed CoFrGeNets, or Continued Fraction Generative Networks, which replace transformer attention and feed-forward components with structures derived from continued fractions. The team presented the results at the International Conference on Machine Learning in Seoul, South Korea. CoFrGeNet variants often matched or slightly beat GPT2-xl on downstream classification tasks while using hundreds of millions fewer parameters, and scored better on perplexity. The team adopted continuants so that only one division is needed however deep the ladder goes, and added incremental training for stability. Amit Dhurandhar said the work aims to widen the set of architecture ideas beyond the transformer.

title: IBM Researchers Introduce CoFrGeNets to Improve Model Efficiency

labels.reference_summary: A ZDNET writer charged an iPhone 4 from 2011 and found that a full charge lasted 15 minutes of use. The phone would not authenticate with iCloud, which also blocked the App Store and a factory reset, and Safari could not display modern sites. 3G networks were fully phased out in the United States in 2022, leaving only a 2.4Ghz Wi-Fi connection. Connected to an M4 Mac Studio, the phone appeared in the Finder sidebar and could serve as an iPod-like media player. Listings on eBay ran from $5 to $30, and the writer decided to recycle the device.

title: ZDNET author tests old iPhone 4 and finds it mostly useless

labels.reference_summary: A co-author of a Human Rights Watch report published in August found that Colombian armed groups recruit children through Facebook and TikTok. Child recruitment has affected more than 1,500 children in the past five years, and some estimates indicate almost half of it is driven by social media. Groups use emojis as code, with a clover standing for coca crops and the Angolan flag for the ELN, and explicit recruitment posts stayed online for months. A 17-year-old recruited by a FARC dissident group in Catatumbo said the group first reached him through social media. Meta and ByteDance removed dozens of reported accounts.

title: Colombian Armed Groups Recruit Children via Social Media Algorithms

labels.reference_summary: The odds of a severe financial crisis are high and rising, but the Federal government does not face a funding crisis because it can always pay its dollar obligations. When interest rates rise, the riskiest companies and bonds correct first, and safe assets like Treasuries go last. The private credit fund market is $3 to $3.5 trillion against US GDP of $32.5 trillion, and AI capex produced nearly 50% of GDP growth in 2025 and early 2026. John Mearsheimer said the attempt to isolate Iran's economy will fail because China and Russia will not play ball. Saudi Arabia is routing tankers around Africa, more than doubling voyages to roughly 17,000 miles.

title: Analysts Discuss Risks of Financial Crisis Amid Rising Interest Rates and Geopolitical Tensions

labels.reference_summary: The yield on the 30-year US Treasury bond closed above 5.3 per cent in August, its highest level since 2007, and long-term yields in Britain, Germany and Japan also rose to levels not seen in years. Brent crude hit US$100 a barrel on Sept 9 because of the blockade around the Strait of Hormuz. The US federal government recorded a deficit of US$1.78 trillion in the financial year ended September 2025, and gross national debt has passed US$40 trillion. Singapore's 10-year government bond yield stayed under 2.5 per cent in September, and the average 10-year return on the next Singapore Savings Bond tranche is 2.32 per cent.

title: Rising global bond yields impact Singapore borrowing costs and investments

labels.reference_summary: The Federal Trade Commission is consulting on an enforcement policy for personalised pricing, as algorithms let businesses tailor prices and discounts to individual customers. Consumer NZ warned about the data collected through supermarket loyalty programmes, though there is no evidence New Zealand supermarkets price this way. Research on 1.5 million Uber trips in the UK found dynamic pricing was associated with lower real hourly earnings and greater inequality. An FTC investigation found pricing intermediaries had access to location, demographics, browsing histories, shopping-cart activity and even mouse movements. Lyft has documented systems that determine which drivers receive incentives.

title: Experts warn AI helps firms learn customer and worker payment limits

labels.reference_summary: The National Institute of Standards and Technology is allocating $3.19 million to eight small businesses in seven states under the Small Business Innovation Research program. The funding supports work on artificial intelligence, medical diagnostics, biotechnology, semiconductors, quantum and other technologies. The projects were competitively selected in September 2025. These are Phase II awards covering 24 months, after which selected grantees move to Phase III funded by non-SBIR sources. Recipients include AMAG Consulting of Schenectady, New York and Icarus Quantum of Boulder, Colorado, each at $400,000.

title: NIST Funds Eight Small Businesses for Advanced Tech Research

labels.reference_summary: Roughly 160 people are dead and hundreds more, including dozens of international tourists, are missing after flash floods hit the mountainous border of Nepal and Tibet on Wednesday. Satellite imagery and reports from the Nepalese government indicate the flooding was likely triggered by a landslide caused after a piece of a glacier fell hundreds of feet. Daniel Shugar, a geologist at the University of Calgary, said satellite imagery suggested a 2,000-foot-wide piece of ice may have fallen almost 4,000 feet. The U.S. Geological Survey recorded the collapse and debris flow as a magnitude 5.2 seismic event. Nepal's glaciers lost nearly a quarter of their area between 1970 and 2010.

title: Rising temperatures likely contributed to Nepal's deadly flash floods

labels.reference_summary: Officials in North Macedonia praised the former commander of the Bosnian Serb forces after he died on August 27 while serving a life sentence. He was found guilty of genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes in 2017, and the verdict was upheld on appeal in 2021. The Democratic Party of Serbs in Macedonia, led by Minister of Local Self-Government Ivan Stoilkovic, portrayed him as a general who served the army and the people. On July 16 North Macedonia had endorsed the European Union declaration at the OSCE stating there is no place in Europe for genocide denial or the glorification of convicted war criminals. Article 407-a of the Criminal Code provides for criminal liability for publicly denying or justifying genocide.

title: Author argues North Macedonia must stop glorifying convicted war criminal Ratko Mladić

labels.reference_summary: Open source AI models are likely further behind closed models than public benchmarks show. Kimi K3 from Moonshot AI, at 2.8 trillion parameters, scores 93% on GPQA Diamond against the best closed model's 95%, but 72% against 89% on the standard tiers of FrontierMath and 39% against 88% on the hardest problems. On public benchmarks the open and closed lag reads as four to six months, and on private benchmarks it roughly doubles. The supply of frontier open models comes entirely from a few Chinese firms, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Alibaba and Z.ai, after Meta retreated. In June 2026 the US government ordered Anthropic to suspend all foreign access to its newest model.

title: Experts warn open source AI may fall behind closed models

labels.reference_summary: A research project called the AI Observatory aggregated 85,633 conversational turns across 24,521 conversations from seven real-world datasets, covering 5,000 users interacting with 52 models between 2023 and 2025. Applying the methods of the Anthropic Economic Index to that data would have filtered out 48% of the conversations. Those non-work conversations more often involved health and relationships, at 44.2% against 31.2%, and harassment and hate, at 27.5% against 5.66%. The latest Anthropic index analyses 1 million Claude conversations and the OpenAI report analysed 1.5 million. Anka Reuel and Shayne Longpre co-led the work.

title: We still don’t know how people are really using AI

labels.reference_summary: Craig Hewitt, founder of the podcast hosting platform Castos, demonstrated the voice mode of the Codex application on an episode of Zero to Agent in 30 Minutes. He ran his development environment without touching the keyboard, directing the agent to open websites, search for information and navigate pages. The agent opened Cursor, found a specific repository, reported on uncommitted changes and later committed them after receiving permission. Hewitt said he requires approval before the agent accesses most applications or sites, grants broader access only to selected tools and local development sites, and avoids sites he does not trust.

title: Craig Hewitt Demonstrates Voice-Driven Development Using Codex

labels.reference_summary: The Blink Battery Doorbell 2K+ is bundled with a Blink Outdoor 2K+ camera and a Sync Module Core for $100, a 41% discount available for a limited time. The doorbell alone is typically priced at $70 and a single Outdoor 2K+ costs $100, so the bundle saves $70. The Outdoor 2K+ runs on two AA lithium batteries and can last up to two years before a replacement, with no solar panels or wires required. The doorbell uses three lithium AA batteries and offers person detection. One Sync Module Core connects up to 10 Blink cameras.

title: Blink offers discounted security camera bundle with 2-year battery life

labels.reference_summary: Lloyd Axworthy, who served as Canada's Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1995 to 2000, said 40 to 50 years of nuclear guardrails, constraints and standards have been eliminated. The last nuclear arms control treaty between Russia and the U.S.A expired earlier this year, and Washington has struck a civil nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia while using military force against Iran's nuclear program. Doug Saunders said Ukraine occupied an oblast of Russia for more than a year and India destroyed a significant amount of Pakistan's air force, showing deterrence is useless against an adjoining state. Axworthy led the 1997 Ottawa Treaty banning anti-personnel landmines.

title: Former Canadian Foreign Minister Says Nuclear Safeguards Have Collapsed

labels.reference_summary: Pacific Gas and Electric Company launched a virtual power plant program called SHARE, for Smart Home Assets for Reliability and Efficiency, in Bay Area communities. PG&E is working with Tesla, Sunrun and Renew Home to enroll nearly 21,000 existing flexible energy devices. Carrier is the launch partner for the new deployments, providing a battery-enabled heat pump that shifts energy use during peak demand. Google will fully fund customer incentives, technology deployment and program delivery. The resource is expected to begin supporting the grid as early as fall 2026, and the program is expected to run through 2027.

title: PG&E launches SHARE virtual power plant program with multiple partners

labels.reference_summary: Solar has overtaken coal in China by capacity, but coal still generates far more electricity. At current capacity factors, China's solar fleet would need to be about 3.5 times bigger than its coal fleet to generate more electricity. The country has built solar and wind faster than the grid can absorb, and curtailed more than one-quarter of that power in the first half of this year, wasting 360 terawatt-hours of carbon-free power, more than the U.K.'s entire electricity use last year. The United Nations warned the world will soon surpass the 1.5 degree Celsius warming target set by the Paris Agreement.

title: China's solar capacity exceeds coal but generation remains lower

labels.reference_summary: Loan rates shape borrower incentives and also determine how informative repayment is about unobservable effort inside a bank, so the bank designs its wage contract and its loan rate menu jointly. The cost-minimizing wage contract is non-monotone and includes pay after default, and the bank tilts loan rates toward levels that make rewarded outcomes most diagnostic of correct assignment. When failure pay is restricted, the bank re-prices some loans and may take more risk to conserve on agency costs. Under a countercyclical capital requirement, the economy can enter a permanent two-point cycle. Kinda Cheryl Hachem sets this out in NBER Working Paper 35696.

title: Cheryl Hachem studies how loan rates and wage contracts interact in banking

labels.reference_summary: The US NEMA 5-15 wall outlet outputs 120V/60Hz power, and other countries differ, with Japan pushing out 100V and Paraguay delivering 230V. Most modern chargers support 100-250V AC at 50/60Hz with internal auto-sensing. The Ceptics 140W gallium nitride universal travel adapter carries Type A, Type C, Type I and Type G prongs covering well over 150 countries, has a built-in fuse and three USB-C outputs, and costs $51. The BMX GanSTA 140W laptop charger uses interchangeable prongs that clip over the US pins and costs $89. Neither device converts voltage.

title: Universal travel adapter vs. travel-ready charger: Choosing the right device for international travel

labels.reference_summary: Meta introduced ZGateway, a stateless proxy tier between ZippyDB clients and the ZServer database fleet. ZGateway can handle greater than 1 billion operations per second and carries about 40% of all ZippyDB traffic, projected to grow past 60%, while adding about 6% computational overhead to an average use case. Total persistent connections drop by roughly 19x because each backend connection multiplexes many clients. In a controlled overload above 90% CPU across roughly 1,350 active tenant buckets, only 6 buckets were shedding and goodput held near 97-98%. A shared batcher merges requests for the same shard into one backend RPC.

title: Meta introduces ZGateway proxy to unify ZippyDB traffic and improve reliability

labels.reference_summary: Permanent income risk in the United States increased across the distribution since the 1970s, but most sharply among high earners, rising nearly 70% among the top 5%. The study uses newly digitized IRS tax returns from 1969 to 2019 and distinguishes permanent from transitory risk. Large negative income shocks strongly predict financial distress even among top earners, and higher income risk is linked with higher savings. In a quantitative life-cycle model, rising income risk concentrated at the top lowers the risk-free rate by 0.7pp, increases wealth inequality, and contributes to the savings glut of the rich.

title: Researchers document rising income risk among top U.S. earners since 1970

labels.reference_summary: IFBench, accepted to NeurIPS 2025, tests how well language models follow precise natural-language instructions, forcing a model to adhere to several rules in a single response. Artificial Analysis added IFBench to its Intelligence Index. Grok 4.20 leads at 82.9% and Grok 4.3 follows at 81.3%. Gemini 3 Flash Preview reaches 78.0%, and GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 follow at 75.9% and 73.9%. Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude 4.5 Haiku score between 54.3% and 58.6%. Declan Jackson said most evaluations added to the Intelligence Index saturate within about six months, but IFBench has not.

title: IFBench Evaluates AI's Instruction-Following Ability in Real-World Contexts

labels.reference_summary: Feminist activist Gloria Steinem has died aged 92. She was born in Toledo, Ohio on March 25 1934, studied government at Smith College, and spent two years studying and researching in India on a Charles Bowles Fellowship. She came to national attention in 1963 with her expose I Was a Playboy Bunny, based on the 11 days she worked undercover at Hugh Hefner's Playboy Club. In 1971 she and fellow journalists established Ms. Magazine as an insert in New York magazine, and by 1972 it was an independent paper. President Barack Obama presented her with the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2013.

title: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies at 92 after six decades of activism

labels.reference_summary: Turnstile is a proxy written in Rust that sits between an agent harness and the backend system that runs the model, recording the exact token-level history of every request at the moment of generation. It records the token IDs the model sampled, the per-token log probabilities, and a loss mask marking which tokens the model generated. It stores a multiturn rollout as a single growing token path, and starts a new training sequence when the harness rewrote earlier messages or the tokens drifted. The current implementation has a Rust core and an SGLang backend, with a vLLM backend planned. A text-only coding agent and a multimodal computer-use agent both improved over their reinforcement learning runs.

title: Turnstile captures token IDs for accurate reinforcement learning in agent interactions

labels.reference_summary: HYDAC introduced a Square Wave heat exchanger design for wind turbine gearbox oil cooling, engineered to let debris pass more freely through the exchanger fins instead of clogging them. Wind turbine gearbox oil typically operates between 45 and 65 degrees Celsius, and field data shows a 12 degree rise can reduce viscosity by nearly 28 percent. A one-year trial on GE 1.x turbines reduced clogging and lowered maintenance requirements compared with traditional panel cut cores. Long-term SCADA analysis showed turbines with Square Wave operate about 20 to 25 percent cooler, and data from Mitsubishi platforms after two years showed 19 to 25 percent cooler.

title: HYDAC's Square Wave Heat Exchanger Improves Wind Turbine Cooling Efficiency

labels.reference_summary: A security design for Amazon Quick shapes one employee dataset of 5,000 rows and 30 columns into three authorization-aligned views for HR leadership, department managers and all employees at a fictional company called AnyCompany. Row-Level Security maps users to departments through a rules dataset, so an HR admin sees 5,000 rows and a manager sees only their own department. Three purpose-built Chat Agents each connect to exactly one dataset and are shared with one group, and are tested with adversarial queries. A Flow named Weekly Attrition Risk Alert pauses for human approval before notifying managers. AWS CloudTrail logs the resulting events.

title: Amazon Quick security patterns scale from pilot to production

labels.reference_summary: The US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approved a waiver allowing Constellation Energy to fast-track the restart of Pennsylvania's Three Mile Island unit 1, now renamed the Crane Clean Energy Center, to supply power to Microsoft data centres. Constellation aims to begin delivering 835 MWe to the grid by late 2027. Grid studies from PJM Interconnection had found the plant could not fully deliver its output until 2031 without extensive transmission upgrades. FERC granted permission to transfer 760 MWe of capacity interconnection rights from the retiring Eddystone facility near Philadelphia. The Nuclear Regulatory Commission issued a draft finding that the restart would cause no significant environmental impacts.

title: FERC approves capacity rights transfer for Crane Clean Energy Center restart

labels.reference_summary: Microsoft fixed roughly 972 vulnerabilities in its September patch release, and 112 of them are rated critical. The count rises to 997 when the porting of Chromium browser fixes into Edge is included. Microsoft patched a then-record 570 vulnerabilities two months ago and some 620 last month. Already this year Microsoft has fixed 2,760 vulnerabilities, more than double the number from last year. Dustin Childs of the Zero Day Initiative called the spikes the new normal and said AI-assisted vulnerability discovery shows no signs of slowing down, but that there has been no correlating spike in active exploits yet.

title: Microsoft patches record 972 vulnerabilities in September update amid AI threat

labels.reference_summary: A new report by the Family Caregiving of Older Persons in Southern Africa Programme drew on 80 households of older people and their family caregivers in Namibia. Roughly one in ten older Namibians holds a personal loan with NamPost borrowed against the old age grant. A loan of N$13,000 can end up costing nearly N$25,000 to repay, at N$420 a month for five years. Combined water and electricity costs consumed 25% to 40% of household income in some areas, and loan repayments absorbed an average of 15%. Most caregivers were women - 59 of the 80 primary caregivers studied.

title: Namibian elderly face debt traps as strained budgets force borrowing for basic needs

labels.reference_summary: Cape Town's Municipal Planning Tribunal approved a planning application by King Air Industria in July for two data centers that planning documents identify as intended for Equinix. Equinix said it has not submitted any planning or development applications for a data center in Cape Town. The Legal Resources Center estimated the two data centers could consume about 1.2 billion gallons of water a year if conventional evaporative cooling were used. Documents before the tribunal put the proposed system at about 157 megawatts. Cape Town has no separate land-use category for hyperscale facilities and assesses data centers under existing industrial or warehousing rules.

title: Cape Town Approves Data Centers While Treating Them Like Warehouses

labels.reference_summary: EDP Renewables North America and the Redwood Coast Energy Authority completed the Sandrini Energy Storage project in Kern County, California. The battery energy storage system has a capacity of 92MW/368MWh. It is co-located with the 300MW Sandrini Solar project, and RCEA has an agreement to purchase 100MW from the solar site plus an energy storage service agreement for the full capacity of the battery. Construction of the battery system supported approximately 50 jobs, and the combined solar and storage construction accounted for around 250 jobs.

title: EDP Renewables and RCEA complete 368MWh Sandrini BESS project

labels.reference_summary: The National Institute of Standards and Technology announced an agreement with SRI International to establish the Quantum Manufacturing Engineering Center. NIST plans an initial investment of $20 million in the center's activities. The center is meant to remove engineering and manufacturing barriers for scalable quantum components and systems. The agreement advances the June 22, 2026 Executive Order on Ushering in the Next Frontier of Quantum Innovation. It builds on the partnership NIST and SRI began in 2019 to establish the Quantum Economic Development Consortium.

title: NIST and SRI Establish Quantum Manufacturing Center to Boost U.S. Industry

labels.reference_summary: A Federal Reserve official gave welcome remarks at the State of Small Business Symposium hosted by the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland. The remarks noted that 99.9 percent of businesses in the U.S. have fewer than 500 employees and that since 1995 those businesses accounted for 61 percent of net new job creation. The 2025 Small Business Credit Survey found nearly half of small employer firms reported using artificial intelligence in some capacity, and 71 percent of those firms reported increased productivity. This year marks 10 years since the survey went national.

title: Fed Official Highlights AI Adoption by Small Businesses in Speech

labels.reference_summary: Heat pumps came with 53% of new apartment complexes built in the United States in 2025, up from 46% in 2024, according to U.S. Census Bureau data. Among new houses, including row houses and town houses, 48% were built with heat pumps, up from 45% in 2024. Electric heating of some form went into 78% of new apartment units and 56% of new houses. A federal tax credit expanded under the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act offered developers up to $5,000 per energy-efficient housing unit, but it expired last month. New Mexico land developer John Moscato said skipping gas-line construction cuts costs by $3,000 per lot.

title: Heat pumps dominate U.S. apartment construction as electric heating rises

labels.reference_summary: After 21 years of writing the blog almost daily, Calculated Risk will stop writing the daily updates. The author will write a weekly economic summary at the end of each week through a newsletter, in three parts: the schedule of economic data for the following week, a review of data for the previous week, and a commentary on a current topic. The Real Estate Newsletter continues, usually 4 to 6 times per week, and remains the main focus.

title: Calculated Risk Ends Daily Blog, Introduces Weekly Newsletter

labels.reference_summary: Avantus obtained a $300m tax equity commitment from Truist Bank for the Aratina 2 solar and battery storage project in Kern County, California. The funding follows more than $525m in construction financing secured the previous month from CIBC, BBVA and Santander. Aratina 2 has 150MW of solar generation and 452MWh of battery storage and is scheduled to begin operations by the end of 2026. Avantus entered into 15-year power purchase agreements with Southern California Edison for the output. The project is expected to create more than 300 union construction jobs.

title: Avantus secures $300m tax equity for Aratina 2 solar storage project

labels.reference_summary: China launched the reusable rocket Zhuque-3 on Wednesday morning and achieved its first recovery of a rocket's first stage on land, according to an embedded China Xinhua News post. The page is a daily links roundup, and its other entries cover a Manhattan-sized ice island breaking off Greenland, TikTok settling a $400 million children's privacy lawsuit, Israeli minister Ben Smotrich announcing the start of the Greater Israel project, and Iran's response to Trump's economic warfare announcement.

title: China launches reusable rocket with first-stage recovery, advances space innovation

labels.reference_summary: Chemours asked the U.S. government for permission to manufacture a new compound it calls Opteon 2P50 and flagged it for priority review, citing the build-out of data centers. EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin had announced the agency would prioritize Toxic Substances Control Act reviews for data center-related chemicals. An Earthjustice-fronted coalition of 17 environmental groups asked the EPA to deny the premanufacture notice, saying the compound presents unreasonable risk as a PFAS. Chemours says Opteon 2P50 can lead to a 90% reduction in cooling energy and nearly eliminate water use, with an estimated upper-bound emission rate of 2% per year. It breaks down into perfluoropropanoic acid and trifluoroacetic acid.

title: Chemours seeks EPA approval for new PFAS coolant amid data center boom

labels.reference_summary: Architects and developers are becoming orchestrators, one person directing work that once required entire teams. An orchestrator oversees a system, orchestrates tools and agents, and stays accountable for what ships rather than writing the code. The author puts these systems in a category he calls delegated intelligence, arguing the word delegated ties every system back to an accountable operator. He describes adding an inaudible watermark to self-published audiobooks in 40 minutes, work he says would once have taken weeks or months. He argues the role needs years of apprenticeship rather than a bootcamp, and will move toward licensing like doctors and lawyers.

title: Software Engineers Transition to Orchestrators as Systems Become Autonomous

labels.reference_summary: Indian state governments are competing to attract data center developers with subsidized land, infrastructure status, tax incentives and commitments to expand electricity supply. Cumulative investment commitments exceeded US$126 billion by the end of 2025 and are projected to surpass US$180 billion in 2026. India is home to around 18 percent of the world's population but has around 4 percent of its freshwater resources, and data center water demand is projected to rise from roughly 150 billion liters in 2025 towards 358 billion by 2030. Mumbai and Chennai together account for roughly two-thirds of India's data center capacity. A large AI data center project in Visakhapatnam had its environmental clearance challenged after it was approved without a public hearing.

title: India's data center boom must learn governance lessons from its dam history

labels.reference_summary: AWS describes how to embed individual Amazon Quick Sight visuals into React applications using Amazon Cognito registered user authentication. The four-layer serverless architecture serves the React front end through Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3, uses Cognito User Pools for sign-in, and routes authenticated requests from Amazon API Gateway to an AWS Lambda function. The Lambda function calls describe_user and register_user to provision each Cognito user as a READER, then calls GenerateEmbedUrlForRegisteredUser scoped to a DashboardId, SheetId and VisualId. The backend deploys through a single AWS CloudFormation stack.

title: AWS shows how to embed QuickSight visuals with Cognito authentication

labels.reference_summary: A failed lightning arrestor on a 230 kilovolt line in Virginia on July 10, 2024 triggered a voltage dip lasting under 70 milliseconds, causing 1,500 megawatts of load from 60 facilities across 25 substations to disconnect in under one second. NERC issued a Level 3 Alert in May 2026 requiring dynamic fault recording devices for computational loads, with responses due August 3, 2026. FERC issued show cause orders in June 2026 under Docket No. RM26-4 requiring all six US regional grid operators to evaluate Grid Enhancing Technologies. EGM says its Meta-Alert platform locates faults within about 300 feet and its Dynamic Line Rating module shows up to 50 percent improvement over static ratings.

title: AI Data Centers Create New Grid Risks as Utilities Adopt Monitoring Tech

labels.reference_summary: The California State Senate passed AB 1813, the Community Renewable Energy Program Act, over the weekend. The bill has one procedural step in the Assembly before going to the Governor's desk. It directs regulators to value community solar and storage using the CPUC's own Avoided Cost Calculator and requires paired battery storage. California passed AB 2316 in 2022, but not a single community solar project has come online under the program the CPUC produced. Supporters project 5.4 GW of new community solar and storage, clean power for more than 2.2 million Californians, and $6.5 billion in ratepayer savings statewide.

title: California Senate passes industry-backed community solar bill

labels.reference_summary: U.S. marketed natural gas production is forecast to average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025. Production averaged 121.3 Bcf/d in the first half of 2026, 4% more than the same period in 2025, with most of the expansion in the Permian and Haynesville regions. Permian gas production is forecast to average 29.2 Bcf/d in 2026, 6% more than in 2025. West Texas Intermediate crude prices rose from an average of $65 a barrel in 2025 to $84 a barrel through July 2026. The Henry Hub spot price is forecast to fall 2% to average $3.44 per million British thermal units.

title: U.S. natural gas production set to hit record in 2026

labels.reference_summary: Google says running-related searches such as run club, how to choose running shoes, and how to train for a marathon have reached all-time highs this year. It points to three Search features for race preparation. AI Mode with the Canvas tool can build a training schedule and recommend cross-training and strength-building strategies. Connecting a YouTube Music account to Search lets AI Mode create a custom running playlist. Shopping in Search draws on Google's Shopping Graph of over 60 billion product listings for gear recommendations and side-by-side comparisons.

title: Search offers three AI tools to help runners prepare for races

labels.reference_summary: Luce is a 3D representation that unifies geometry and physically based rendering materials within a voxelized multimodal Gaussian cloud, using dedicated Gaussian primitives for each modality. A variational autoencoder compresses the representation into a unified material-aware latent space, and a rectified-flow transformer generates that latent from a single image. On Toys4K, Luce improves FID by 28% over the strongest baseline. On a new benchmark of AI-generated images it raises the CLIP image-alignment score to 0.8519 against 0.8299 for the best baseline.

title: Researchers propose Luce for relightable 3D asset generation from images

labels.reference_summary: IBM is introducing DocLang, a constrained dialect of XML built to tell an AI model in fewer tokens where a headline ends and a chart caption begins. Docling, IBM's open-source document parser, converts PDF, PPT, XLSX and MP4 files into an internal representation that is serialized into DocLang. Docling has 32 million downloads and 64,000 stars on GitHub. Peter Staar, the lead researcher behind Docling, said the syntax vocabulary is capped at about 1,000 tokens and that two systems reading a document correctly should produce byte-identical output. DocLang is an open spec under the governance of the Linux Foundation.

title: IBM Introduces DocLang to Improve AI Understanding of Documents

labels.reference_summary: Thousands of people marched in Stockholm ahead of Sweden's national elections on Sept. 13. Euronews counted more than 10,000 people, while Sveriges Radio and We Don't Have Time put the total at more than 50,000, five times the number organizers expected.
