More than 280 organizations were behind the march. Greta Thunberg told the crowd that no party in Sweden is proposing politics close to what science says is needed. Euronews said Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson was trailing the centre-left opposition by 10 points in a recent poll, and 37% of respondents identified climate change as their top vote-determining issue.

title: 50,000 Rally in Stockholm as Climate Becomes Top Election Issue

labels.reference_summary: Strands Robots, an open source SDK from AWS under Apache 2.0, runs a record-train-deploy loop over Hugging Face Storage Buckets, a mutable, non-versioned, Xet-backed object-storage repository type announced in March 2026. An agent records a LeRobotDataset, syncs it into a bucket with sync_dataset_to_bucket, and streams it back with stream_dataset so training reads from the Hub with no local copy. Hugging Face measurements put content-defined chunking at about four times less data transferred per upload across the Hub. On a single NVIDIA L4, 500 optimizer steps of ACT over a 120-frame episode completed in 133 seconds.

title: Strands Robots Enable Continuous Data Loop for Robot Training and Deployment

labels.reference_summary: The Wells Fargo Active Cash Card holds Motley Fool Money's Best Credit Card for 2026 title for its 2% cash rewards and no annual fee. New cardholders can earn a $100 cash rewards bonus after spending $500 in purchases in the first 3 months, and get 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, after which an 18.49%, 24.49% or 28.49% variable APR applies. The card includes built-in cell phone protection of up to $600 subject to a $25 deductible. Approval is most likely for applicants with a credit score of 670 or higher. Wells Fargo is an advertising partner of Motley Fool Money.

title: Experts: this is the best cash back card of 2022

labels.reference_summary: Hearing loss affects more than 1.5 billion people worldwide, and close to 80% live in low- and middle-income countries. In Africa an estimated 136 million people live with hearing loss, a figure expected to more than double to 337 million by 2050, yet fewer than 2% of people who need a hearing aid have one. A University of Pretoria research team reviewed a decade of evidence and found community health workers using validated smartphone and tablet apps can deliver hearing care outside clinics. In several studies more than 70% of people were still using their devices six months on. The World Health Organization estimates scaling up ear and hearing care globally would cost less than US$1.40 per person per year.

title: Researchers propose community health workers can deliver hearing care in Africa

labels.reference_summary: Several indicators point to continued growth. A chart normalizes nonfarm payroll employment, civilian employment with smoothed population controls, industrial production, personal income excluding current transfers, manufacturing and trade sales, and monthly GDP to 2025M01=0. A second chart adds ADP private nonfarm payroll employment, real retail sales, freight services indexes and a coincident index. The employment release surprised not only in terms of change but also in terms of previous months' numbers, which are compared against the Bloomberg consensus and the CES July release.

title: CES and CPS Employment Data Show Surprising Economic Growth

labels.reference_summary: The New Mexico Supreme Court held attorney Stephen Aarons in direct contempt of court for submitting a brief with false testimony from wholly fabricated witnesses, and referred him to a disciplinary board. Aarons admitted he did not verify the factual claims and legal authority in his AI-generated brief before signing it and filing it, and did not inform his client. He has been a criminal defense lawyer in New Mexico for over 40 years and was hired to appeal the murder conviction of Oscar Renee Sandoval, who was sentenced to life in prison in February 2025. The court concluded Aarons demonstrated a lack of remorse and a lack of concern for his client.

title: New Mexico Supreme Court punishes ChatGPT-using lawyer for fake testimony

labels.reference_summary: China's total carbon dioxide emissions dropped by 1% in the second quarter of 2026 as oil consumption fell, according to analysis from the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air produced for Carbon Brief. Oil fell 9% overall and 16% for transportation, and emissions declined despite a rebound in coal-fired power generation. It is the first time a reduction in oil consumption was directly responsible for falling emissions in China. West Texas Intermediate closed just below $104 per barrel as Houthi rebels ousted Yemeni government forces from the port city of Mokha, and Brent crude rose more than 6% to about $108. U.S. diesel prices reached an all-time high of $5.82 per gallon.

title: China's Emissions Drop as Oil Demand Falls Amid Gulf Crisis

labels.reference_summary: A rubric-based reward framework generates query-specific rubrics grounded in retrieved evidence and decomposed into multiple quality dimensions, providing fine-grained supervision during post-training for open-domain question answering. Averaged across composition, grounding and instruction-following, the approach improves over the instruction-tuned baseline by 6.5% and over flat rubric variants by 4%, with consistent gains across all evaluation datasets. Conditioning rubrics on retrieved evidence improves factual support, and decomposing rubrics into quality-specific dimensions further improves coherence, organization and adherence to query requirements.

title: Researchers propose rubric-based alignment for grounded open-domain question answering

labels.reference_summary: DiscoSign is a modular Large Language Model based framework for discourse-aware text to sign language gloss translation. It addresses spatial coreference resolution, Question-Answer Clauses, and concept-gloss consistency between English concepts and American Sign Language signs. Because traditional translation metrics fail to capture discourse-level quality, the work introduces a suite of new evaluation metrics for each dimension of discourse coherence. Experiments on sentence-level and discourse-level datasets show improved spatial consistency and entity tracking relative to sentence-only translation, while single-sentence gloss translation quality stays competitive.

title: Researchers introduce DiscoSign for discourse-aware text to sign language gloss translation

labels.reference_summary: Hybrid electric, battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles were 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States in the second quarter of 2026, up from 22% in the same quarter of 2025. Hybrid electric vehicles reached a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. Battery electric vehicle sales fell to 6% of new light-duty vehicles from 7%, and plug-in hybrid sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4%, according to estimates from Omdia. The New Clean Vehicle Credit and the Qualified Commercial Clean Vehicle Credit both expired on September 30, 2025. In 2024, electric vehicles accounted for 2% of all registered light-duty vehicles in the United States.

title: Hybrid vehicle sales increase as battery electric sales decline post-tax credit expiration

labels.reference_summary: Polyester is trending as an insult on TikTok, but the Oxford English Dictionary gives examples of the term used that way from 1979 and 1987, about half a century ago. Lexicographer Kory Stamper said TikTokkers are leaning into the inauthentic and low-quality edge of that meaning. Polyester was once sold as a miracle fabric that promised housewives liberation from ironing, and its production outpaced cotton starting in the 1960s. Anneke Smelik said the line between synthetic and natural fabrics is blurrier than people think, noting it can take more than 700 gallons of water to produce a single cotton shirt. A report from the Apparel Impact Institute found global fashion industry emissions rose 7.5 percent in 2023 and 6.3 percent in 2024.

title: Gen Z uses polyester as an insult, but the term has a long history

labels.reference_summary: The Administration's Mid-Session Review carried no economic forecast, so its forecast is taken to be the same as the one released in April, which was finalized in November 2025. A chart compares reported GDP against the Administration's FY2027 Budget forecast from OMB, Treasury and the CEA, the WSJ April survey mean, the SPF median forecast, and Hassett's 5% growth figure for 2027. Given reported GDP growth and the NY Fed nowcast, growth is more on track with the April WSJ mean forecast than with the Administration's forecast.

title: Economists question Administration mid-session review economic forecast accuracy

labels.reference_summary: AWS Agent Registry is now generally available, giving teams a single, searchable, governed catalog for agents, tools, skills and custom resources. It supports four record types: MCP servers, Agent2Agent agent cards, skill definitions in markdown files, and custom JSON descriptors. Records move through draft, pending approval, approved, rejected and deprecated states, and AWS CloudTrail captures a full audit trail of every action. Organization-wide auto-detection finds agents and MCP servers running on AgentCore runtime and AgentCore Gateway across every account. Southwest Airlines, PepsiCo, Sony, Mitsubishi Electric, Syngenta and Amdocs are named as users or early adopters.

title: AWS launches Agent Registry to govern and discover AI agents at scale

labels.reference_summary: The D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on September 11 that the Department of Energy cannot order the J.H. Campbell coal plant in Michigan to keep running. Judge Cornelia Pillard wrote for a unanimous three-judge panel that Section 202(c) of the Federal Power Act is a narrow, last-resort backstop and that no emergency existed. Consumers Energy, which owns the 1.5-GW plant, said it is reviewing the ruling and still complying with the current 90-day order. Operating the plant cost more than $248 million over the last year, or $642,000 per day.

title: D.C. Circuit Court Rules Against Trump Order to Keep Michigan Coal Plant Running

labels.reference_summary: Christopher J. Waller said monetary policy is at a crossroads. Core PCE inflation moved up from 3 percent in December 2025 to 3.4 percent in May, and headline PCE inflation ran at 4.1 percent over the 12 months through May. The labor market has created an average of 111,000 jobs a month over the past three months and sits close to the FOMC's maximum-employment goal. Waller said he would hold the policy rate at its current target range if inflation readings fall, but the FOMC will need to consider tightening if core inflation stays hot.

title: Federal Reserve Official Warns of Inflation Crossroads

labels.reference_summary: A Federal Reserve official opened the fifth Conference on the International Roles of the U.S. Dollar in Washington, D.C. on June 22, 2026. Financial innovations such as stablecoins and distributed ledger technologies are creating new channels for global dollar intermediation that run alongside traditional banking and payment systems. Conference papers test whether stablecoin flows affect exchange rates, dollar funding conditions and cross-border capital movements, and whether dollar-backed stablecoins link global liquidity demand directly to U.S. Treasury markets.

title: Federal Reserve Official Discusses Dollar's Evolving Role Amid Financial Innovations

labels.reference_summary: SolarEdge Technologies introduced a UL 3141-certified Power Control System for U.S. commercial and industrial solar developers and installers. The system builds certified power controls into the SolarEdge inverter instead of relying on external controllers and customized system architectures. Kleber Facchini, senior director of C&I products and applications for SolarEdge North America, said it gives installers a simpler way to address export constraints. In California it can support non-export and export limit applications, including Rule 21 non-export interconnection pathways, and preserve NEM 2.0 status where applicable.

title: SolarEdge launches UL 3141-certified power control system for commercial solar

labels.reference_summary: NVIDIA introduced Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, an omni-modal model covering text, image, video and audio. It pairs the Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B backbone with a C-RADIOv4-H vision encoder and a Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v2 audio encoder. NVIDIA says it delivers up to 9x higher throughput and 2.9x the single-stream reasoning speed on multimodal use-cases compared to alternatives, and leads document, video and audio leaderboards including MMlongbench-Doc, OCRBenchV2 and WorldSense. BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoints are available at HuggingFace.

title: NVIDIA launches Nemotron 3 Nano Omni for multimodal document and video analysis

labels.reference_summary: Dambe, a combat sport practised by Hausa communities in Nigeria and West Africa, is moving beyond its traditional settings. Dambe Warriors used YouTube to turn local competitions into content for a global audience, with millions of views coming from outside Nigeria. African Warriors introduced three three-minute rounds, a points system and clearer definitions of knockdowns. Nshua Cali-Dibang argues that fighters, elders, organisers and community members should take part in deciding how the sport is regulated, represented and commercialised.

title: Nigeria's Dambe evolves globally while communities demand control

labels.reference_summary: Fervo Energy signed a deal to supply Google with nearly 400 megawatts of clean electricity from its Cape Station geothermal project in southwest Utah. Fervo is investing over $2 billion to build the system, which is due for completion in 2028. Fervo shares jumped 15% on Tuesday morning following the news. Google said it intends to buy the power for a potential data center in Utah, and holds an option to expand the agreement by around 600 MW by June 2030.

title: Fervo Energy signs largest next-gen geothermal deal with Google

labels.reference_summary: Arvind Narayanan and Akash Kapur argue that AI labs cannot recoup the estimated $4-8 trillion projected to be invested in AI infrastructure by the early 2030s by charging for model inference. They say competition will push the price of inference toward the marginal cost of producing tokens, because models are largely undifferentiated, capital costs are similar and switching costs are minimal. Drawing on railroads, electricity, telecom, cloud computing and chip fabrication, they conclude the labs' path to durable profit runs higher up the stack, through vertical integration, embedded enterprise deployments and constructed switching costs.

title: AI Labs Seek Profitability Through Stack Migration Amid Concerns Over Lock-In

labels.reference_summary: Jayeeta Putatunda, forward deployed AI engineering lead at Turing, built a multi-agent workflow that turns a daily flood of financial headlines into a structured analyst briefing. A coverage planner breaks the research question into sections, a news researcher queries preferred sources first, a validation agent checks links and removes duplicates and paywalled pages, a briefing writer assembles the result, and a feedback agent saves corrections to a memory database. She built the entire stack on open source models so newcomers can run it without an API key.

title: Jayeeta Putatunda builds financial news agent using open source models

labels.reference_summary: The Trump administration has used federal emergency powers to force seven old fossil-fueled power plants to stay online, all but one of them coal-fired. State regulators, utilities and grid operators had already deemed those facilities unnecessary and spent years planning their retirement. A running tally from the Sierra Club put the total cost of the stay-open orders at roughly $430 million as of Aug. 6. More than 20 coal-burning units are supposed to close before the end of Trump's term, with the next batch due in December at Colorado's Comanche plant and Minnesota's Sherburne County station.

title: Trump administration forces seven coal plants to stay open despite retirements

labels.reference_summary: Microsoft built twelve training worlds for computer-use agents: ten deep domain worlds and two capability worlds drilling date pickers and nested filters. Trained on all twelve, a 9B model nearly doubles its base score, 36.5% to 67.1%, coming within fourteen points of GPT-5.4. Shallow worlds pulled the model down on Allrecipes, 80.0% to 75.0%, while the deep world lifted it to 85.0%. Reinforcement learning against five worlds raised the judged score on held-out tasks from 58% to 69%. Four worlds are released with code, data and grounded graders.

title: Echoverse creates deep synthetic environments to improve computer-use agents

labels.reference_summary: A study published in Nature Climate Change found that people overestimate the climate actions of their peers while underestimating how much support exists for climate action. Researchers surveyed more than 5,000 people across Germany and the US over 2024-25, split across five experiments. In survey one, 37% of participants said they were willing to donate to WWF but just 4% did when given the opportunity, and participants predicted 23% of other people donated. Lead author Dr Kevin Tiede said telling people how many support climate action is likely not enough to really change something.

title: Study reveals public overestimates peers' climate actions but underestimates own support

labels.reference_summary: The writer set up Gmail and Twitter accounts for a first child at birth, then guarded the second child's privacy and later scrubbed much of the older child's early digital footprint. Jonathan Haidt's best-selling 2024 book The Anxious Generation helped push the issue into the mainstream, Australia enacted a social media ban for children under 16, and the US Supreme Court upheld an age verification law in Texas. The writer has since retired the flip phone for an iPhone and given the younger child an Apple Watch.

title: Parents shift from digital exposure to cautious tech use for children

labels.reference_summary: Pacific Gas and Electric announced SHARE on September 3, a virtual power plant for communities around the San Francisco Bay Area. PG&E is working with Tesla, Sunrun and Renew Home to enroll nearly 21,000 existing flexible energy devices, and Carrier is the launch partner for battery-enabled heat pumps. Google will fully fund the program, covering customer incentives, technology deployment and program delivery. Eligible customers in Santa Clara and Alameda counties can receive new heat pumps, and the resource is expected to begin supporting the grid as early as fall 2026.

title: PG&E, Google, and partners launch new virtual power plant in California

labels.reference_summary: Danijar Hafner, 31, left Google DeepMind in the fall of 2025 to start a company that is still in stealth mode in San Francisco's SoMa district. He develops world models and trains agents inside them, an approach called model-based reinforcement learning, and imports the humanoid robots in his office from China. His earlier work includes PlaNet, Dreamer 2, the first agent to hit human-level performance on Atari 2600 games, Dreamer 3, which solved the Minecraft Diamond challenge, and DayDreamer. Timothy Lillicrap, a former manager at Google, said Hafner sits in the top half of 1%.

title: AI entrepreneur Danijar Hafner launches startup to build robots that plan for the unexpected

labels.reference_summary: The Hugging Face Kernels project now supports Helion, a tiled DSL from Meta for writing machine learning kernels. Developers package Helion kernels with kernel-builder, publish them to the Hugging Face Hub, and users load them with get_kernel. An AOT runner tunes a kernel across a set of shapes and builds a decision tree of configs shipped beside the source, so no tuning happens on the user's machine. A pre-tuned attention kernel beat the FLASH backend of PyTorch's scaled_dot_product_attention on 19 out of 19 pre-tuned shapes on an H100, with a geomean speed-up of 1.20.

title: Hugging Face Kernels adds Helion support for portable ML kernels

labels.reference_summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 with new classifiers for cybersecurity, biology and chemistry, and distillation, which hand those requests to Claude Opus 4.8 and tell the user when it happens. Separate safeguards for frontier LLM development stay invisible to the user and limit the model through prompt modification, steering vectors or parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Anthropic says more than 95% of Fable sessions involve no fallback at all. An edit dated Jun. 11 records that Anthropic changed its handling of AI research queries to use a classifier like the other safety domains.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5 with new safety measures

labels.reference_summary: Lake Mead and Lake Powell both reached record-low water levels this month, cutting what the Hoover and Glen Canyon dams can generate. When full, the two reservoirs can produce more than 3 GW. The Bureau of Reclamation projects a slim but real chance they sink too low to produce any power at some point next year. Quebec's yearslong drought has diminished its generation capacity, and two new transmission lines into New England and New York City have carried far less power than expected. Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro issued an executive order setting standards for data centers seeking expedited permits.

title: Hydropower shortages threaten U.S. and Canadian energy supply

labels.reference_summary: New Jersey utility Public Service Electric & Gas unveiled GridSmart, which gives homeowners a $5,000 incentive toward a home battery and 0% on-bill financing for the balance, with customers owning the systems and the batteries joining PSE&G's residential virtual power plant portfolio. Isshu Kikuma, an energy storage analyst at BloombergNEF, expects third-party ownership to dominate the U.S. market, in part because the 25D tax credit ended. Base Power has raised more than $2 billion and is valued at $13 billion. Evergy in Missouri and Green Mountain Power in Vermont run utility-owned lease programs.

title: Utilities test home battery financing models amid tax credit changes

labels.reference_summary: A Federal Reserve official chairing the Financial Stability Board's Standing Committee on Supervisory and Regulatory Cooperation set out four principles for modernizing financial regulation: prioritize material financial risks, tailor rules to each institution's risk profile, prioritize transparency and accountability, and stay forward-looking. Supervisors failed to act on the material risks that contributed to the failure of Silicon Valley Bank, which had dozens of outstanding supervisory matters when it failed. The Federal Reserve's 2026 Basel III proposal would move large banks to a single stack of risk-based capital requirements and index the G-SIB surcharge to nominal economic growth.

title: Federal Reserve Outlines Principles for Modernizing Financial Regulation

labels.reference_summary: On July 30 Google launched a feature that built image generation directly into Google Earth, letting users zoom to real coordinates, type a prompt and get an AI-generated photorealistic scene blended into satellite and aerial imagery. Within hours users had conjured a nuclear plant in Iran, a bomb crater beside a Gaza hospital, and floods lapping the U.S. Capitol. Google pulled the feature within a day after an outcry and said it would return with stronger guardrails. OpenAI shut down its Sora video app in March. Of 13 AI providers tested, seven had no public detection tool.

title: Google removes AI image generation from Earth after 24 hours of conflict misinformation

labels.reference_summary: Extreme heat cuts output from every kind of power generation. During the July 2026 heatwave, three of France's 57 nuclear reactors shut down and generation was reduced at another seven, causing an almost 9% dip in production. At 40C a gas-fired power station can expect its capacity to fall 13% and its efficiency 7% compared with running at 20C. One study found wind power decreased by an average of 30-50% during heatwaves across Australia, northern Asia and Europe. Across a four-day UK heatwave in June 2026, solar generated 484 GWh, a 46% increase over the same period a week earlier.

title: Heatwaves impact nuclear, gas, and wind power generation differently

labels.reference_summary: IBM introduced Qiskit Fermions, an open-source toolbox for expressing fermionic operators and circuits and defining fermion-to-qubit mappings. It delays fermion-to-qubit synthesis until transpilation, so the structure of the problem survives further into compilation. On time dynamics of the 1D Fermi-Hubbard model, adding a single ancilla qubit and grouping terms with flow sets held two-qubit depth constant at 12 from 4 sites up to 100, while a conventional Jordan-Wigner approach reached 407 at 100 sites. The package is built on a Rust core and integrates with ffsim and the SQD addon.

title: Qiskit Fermions enables fermionic-to-qubit mapping for quantum simulations

labels.reference_summary: Tim O'Brien argues that counting tokens does not show whether an AI workload was worth paying for. A bill shows how many tokens a system consumed, which models it called and how much those calls cost, but not whether the system accomplished anything. He compares the gap to FinOps and databases, where storage, compute, queries, replicas and utilization never explain what the database is for. A token from one model is not equivalent to a token from another, and a cheap call that produces bad work may cost more than an expensive call that succeeds immediately.

title: Tokens Are Not Dollars: Why AI Cost Metrics Fail to Measure Value

labels.reference_summary: Ai2 released MolmoPoint in March, a model that points by selecting directly from what it sees instead of generating text coordinates, first picking a coarse region then zeroing in on the exact spot. Chris Clark, Molmo research lead, said pointing matters for interpretability, counting, robotics and computer-use agents. MolmoWeb is a suite of multimodal web agents that predict the next browser action from a screenshot alone, without HTML or accessibility trees, led by Tanmay Gupta. Ai2 released model checkpoints, training data and a unified evaluation harness so others can reproduce the work.

title: MolmoPoint and MolmoWeb enhance open-source vision models with direct pointing and web navigation

labels.reference_summary: Brian Janous, co-founder and chief commercial officer of Cloverleaf Infrastructure, told Shayle Kann that data center developers have gone from red carpet to pitchforks in a short time. He said water-use fears ignore the shift to closed-loop cooling, and that general opposition to AI now sits on top of specific grievances about power bills and secrecy. He argued behind-the-meter generation makes the problem worse, citing a gigawatt data center that needs 2.6 gigawatts of capacity. Quincy, Washington built a $15 million aquatic center and cut unemployment from about 29% to 6% over 20 years of data center growth.

title: Data center industry faces backlash over AI concerns and grid impacts

labels.reference_summary: Connecting one MCP server to one client does little that the underlying app cannot already do. Composing servers unlocks work that crosses apps: Claude Code can find an IKEA order confirmation in Gmail, pull the attachment, retrieve the one-time code and submit the receipt to Benepass. Remote servers beat local ones for end users, and mcp-auth-wrapper turns a local server into a remote multitenant one, install-mcp generates per-client install links, and mcp-aggregator centralizes configuration and auth behind one endpoint. Anthropic measured one workflow dropping from 150,000 tokens to 2,000 by avoiding naive tool calling.

title: MCP Patterns Enable Multi-Server Integration for AI Workflows

labels.reference_summary: The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis concluded there is a poor chance the proposed West Coast Oil Pipeline repays its $35.2- to $43.7-billion cost. Energy finance analyst Mark Kalegha and independent consultant Will Scargill wrote that electric vehicles and a faster global energy transition will limit long-term oil prices, and that existing and brownfield expansion projects can already accommodate projected production growth. They said the project would represent a net loss to oil sands producers because it must charge significantly higher tolls than existing pipelines. Road transportation takes about 45% of global oil demand.

title: IEEFA Says West Coast Pipeline Cannot Recoup Its $43.7 Billion Cost

labels.reference_summary: The second-largest reservoir in the US reached a record-low water height on Saturday, days after the largest broke its own record. Lake Mead fell to 317.11 metres on 7 August against a full pool of 347.60 metres, and Lake Powell was recorded at 1,072.87 metres on 15 August against a full pool of 1,127.76 metres. Around 40 million people get some or all of their municipal water from the Colorado River. Flow along the Upper Colorado has declined by about 20% since the turn of the 20th century, and research attributes half of that decline to human-induced climate change.

title: Lake Mead and Powell reach record-low water levels due to climate and demand

labels.reference_summary: Research published in June 2026 found widespread air and water pollution around the copper and cobalt mines of the Lualaba mining area in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. At the Galaxy School in Kolwezi, less than 500 meters from a mining waste disposal site, almost 98 percent of hourly fine-particle levels exceeded World Health Organization thresholds, and 1,500 students and 68 staff members attend every day. A community well 200 meters from a tailings pond was 100 times more acidic than recommended, with manganese up to 14 times the health limit. The DRC accounts for three-quarters of global cobalt production.

title: The devastating impact of copper and cobalt mining pollution in Lualaba, DRC

labels.reference_summary: TIDAL PWR and BTQ Technologies unveiled a collaboration on July 20 to propose a trusted quantum data center reference architecture. An initial 90-day workstream will produce a planning blueprint covering quantum data center design principles, trusted supply chain requirements, vendor and device procurement standards, and post-quantum cryptographic security. TIDAL PWR's disclosed Texas development pipeline spans seven sites totaling 9.87 GW, including 4.8 GW of grid capacity and 5.07 GW of behind-the-meter generation. The work is pre-customer and pre-deployment, with no named customers, signed customer LOIs or pilot deployments.

title: TIDAL PWR and BTQ Develop Blueprint for Quantum-Ready Data Centers

labels.reference_summary: Sugar Cosmetics reached a valuation of around 2,700 crore rupees by 2022, and that valuation has fallen by nearly 80%. Rising advertising, influencer and customer-acquisition costs made the D2C beauty model hard to turn profitable. Aluminium can shortages are pushing India's alcohol and beverage companies toward PET and glass bottles before the festive season. Copper crossed $14,500 per tonne on the London Metal Exchange. Aditya Birla Group entered the wires and cables business with Ultravolt and 1,800 crore rupees, against Polycab's roughly 30% share of the organised market.

title: Sugar Cosmetics valuation drops 80% while copper prices surge

labels.reference_summary: Agent Seer builds AI agent test scenarios from a single Model Context Protocol specification, with no examples, no live tool access and no domain-specific tuning. The pipeline enriches raw schemas, generates graded scenarios with synthetic tool outputs, then expands them into multi-turn dialogues. Tests across seven MCP specifications measured tool-calling correctness and conversational coherence, with complete tool coverage on small and medium specifications. Parameter schema complexity correlated most strongly with quality variation, and argument value accuracy was the dominant failure mode.

title: Agent Seer synthesizes realistic AI agent test scenarios from tool specifications

labels.reference_summary: An autonomous coding pipeline consumed 595.7 million tokens to ship 77 stories, or 7.7 million tokens per delivered story, costing $837.53 at list prices and $10.88 per story. Cache reads were 95.4% of all tokens, while cache writes were 3.3% of tokens but 31.2% of the bill. The ledger under-recorded spend at $694.65 because a re-ask overwrote the original stage row's usage, so the session logs were treated as ground truth. The work ran on a $200-per-month Max 20x subscription.

title: Developer reveals hidden costs of autonomous code generation

labels.reference_summary: EveryEvalEver sets a common format for reporting AI benchmark scores and a crowdsourced database for sharing them. Researchers at IBM, Hugging Face and the Technical University of Munich lead the project, which is hosted on Hugging Face and lists more than 22,000 model results across 2,200 benchmarks, translated from 31 evaluation formats. Model providers named the platform serving their model 2% of the time and disclosed settings such as temperature less than 25% of the time. The team estimates reproducing the aggregated results would cost up to $370,000.

title: Researchers Launch Initiative to Standardize AI Benchmark Reporting

labels.reference_summary: A University of Houston report says U.S. electricity demand could rise by as much as 32% by 2030, driven by artificial intelligence, data centers and the electrification of transportation and industry. The UH Energy team expects natural gas, solar and battery storage to carry much of the near-term load, with advanced geothermal and nuclear taking larger roles as they mature. Greg Bean, executive director of the Gutierrez Energy Management Institute, said expanding transmission and improving use of the existing grid will be essential. Developers are turning to behind-the-meter generation to bypass interconnection queues.

title: Study: U.S. Electricity Demand Could Jump 32% by 2030 Amid AI Data Center Surge

labels.reference_summary: Trump has pushed to cut U.S. gasoline prices before the midterm elections through Venezuela oil deals and biofuel waivers. The U.S. average gas price on Thursday was around $4.11 per gallon, up more than 90 percent from a year earlier, and the crack spread passed $70 per barrel. The Pentagon said it would take a stake in North American Blue Energy Partners, and Chevron said it would double its production in Venezuela. Al Salazar of Enverus Intelligence said the price spike comes from a lack of refining capacity, not a lack of crude.

title: Trump seeks to lower gas prices amid midterms with Venezuela deals and fuel waivers

labels.reference_summary: A prompt line left in a post on a Chinese content farm told writers to target a Taiwanese audience and rewrite an article in Traditional Chinese within 500 words. The line was deleted within two minutes of publication but stayed in the editing history, where a team led by Austin H. Wang found it. Meta reported in March that it disrupted a China-based network that used Taiwan-based proxy IPs and paid a $15,000 ad fee in three currencies. Pei-Chi Jao calls on AI companies and social media platforms to examine how such accounts operate together, not only to block them.

title: China Adapts Disinformation Tactics in Taiwan Using AI Technology

labels.reference_summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, which scores 99.9% on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark against 7.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol and is strongest at computer use and rendering tasks. The Information reported that Astra uses recurrent depth, also called looped transformers, which pass hidden states through the same blocks more than once. Nanbeige4.2-3B runs 22 blocks twice for 44 block applications without storing a second set of weights. Shorter reasoning traces follow from more capable models rather than from looping, and Jakub Pachocki said the depth of the computation graph for current frontier models is within a factor of two of GPT-4.

title: Author analyzes GPT-6 Astra performance and looped transformer architecture

labels.reference_summary: China imported about 11.1 million barrels of crude oil a day in 2024, roughly three-quarters of what it consumes, but it now buys from around 55 countries and takes oil through three overland pipelines that bypass the Strait of Malacca. Commercial and strategic stocks give China about 120 days of import cover, above the International Energy Agency's 90-day standard, while India's caverns hold about 39 million barrels and national cover reaches about 74 days. China produced about 4.78 billion tonnes of coal in 2024 and added 277 GW of solar and 79 GW of wind. A blockade at Malacca could impose cost on Beijing but could not force it to relent.

title: China's energy diversification reduces Malacca blockade leverage

labels.reference_summary: Long-form non-fiction writing has stagnated in language models even as they went from okay to superhuman at coding and mathematics. The models get a sentence right but muddle a whole chapter, adding conceptual errors as they stack changes on each other. The author used models to write a post-training textbook, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, for LaTeX formatting, copyediting and diagrams, and says well less than 1% of the sentences came from a model. GPT models find typos well, Claude models work better as editors, and the best textbooks are expected to stay human-crafted for another two to five years.

title: Author reflects on AI's limitations in non-fiction writing despite progress in other areas

labels.reference_summary: Ghanaians are turning to traditional plant medicine as the cost of Western pharmaceuticals and medical care rises. The Center for Plant Medicine Research, created by the Ghanaian government in 1976, sees roughly 16,000 outpatients a month and validates traditional knowledge using scientific methods, said deputy director Kofi Donkor. A 2023 study in Frontiers in Pharmacology found that 60 to 70 percent of Ghanaians depend on traditional medicine markets for their care. Researchers are testing West African plants, including croton membranaceous, a shrub that has shown promise against prostate cancer.

title: Ghanaians turn to indigenous plants as Western medicine costs rise

labels.reference_summary: MN8 Energy, Eos Energy Enterprises and Google announced a clean energy project in Kanawha County, West Virginia, combining 86MW of utility-scale solar, 70MW/280MWh of lithium-ion storage and 10MW/100MWh of Eos zinc-based long-duration storage. MN8 will own and operate the site, and Google will buy the energy, capacity and clean energy attributes to support its data centres in the area. Solar operations are planned for 2028, lithium-ion storage for 2029 and long-duration storage for 2030. MN8 estimates up to $350m in capital investment and about 200 construction jobs.

title: MN8, Google and Eos launch clean energy project in West Virginia

labels.reference_summary: Civil society groups want the just transition mechanism agreed last year at COP30 in Belem to be made operational at COP31 in Antalya this November. Governments at the mid-year talks in Bonn produced an informal note setting out options for the mechanism but settled little else. Richer countries favour a narrow focus on phasing out fossil fuels, while developing countries want a whole of economy, whole of society approach. Anabella Rosemberg of Climate Action Network International said an ambitious outcome would establish the mechanism in Antalya and set up a transitional committee so it is fully operational by COP32 in Ethiopia in 2027.

title: Civil society pushes for operational Just Transition Mechanism at COP31

labels.reference_summary: AI inference moves the optimization problem from raw compute to coordinated infrastructure across memory, storage and networking, says Jim McGregor, founder and principal analyst at Tirias Research. Data movement is now the pressing constraint, because techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation make systems scan large databases in real time. The recommended procurement framework is to define the workloads being optimized, build a modular architecture, work with the full ecosystem of suppliers, reassess procurement continuously, and optimize for efficiency and ROI rather than peak performance. The content was produced by Insights, MIT Technology Review's custom content arm, in partnership with Micron.

title: Jim McGregor explains how AI inference requires integrated memory and storage

labels.reference_summary: Georgia's Ministry of Internal Affairs uses Polyface, a face recognition system bought from the Moscow-based company Papillon AO, to identify protesters. Nino, who protested against the alleged rigging of the October 2024 elections, was fined GEL 5,000 after the system matched her face, and her bank accounts were frozen five months later. By March 2025 at least GEL 2 million in penalties had been imposed on protesters. Polyface 3.7.0 was delivered in June 2025, is built on an algorithm from the Russian company 3DiVi, and matches faces against civil registry photographs. Many demonstrators have stopped attending protests.

title: Russian surveillance software suppresses Georgian protest rights

labels.reference_summary: Spain's government decreed on 14 August a three-year extension for two nuclear plants at Almaraz with a combined capacity of about 2 gigawatts, which had been scheduled to shut down in 2027. The decree blames the crisis in the Middle East, but energy economist Diego Rodriguez Rodriguez said the Ukraine war, the Iberian blackout and rising natural gas prices changed the calculation. The 28 April 2025 blackout cut power to more than 60 million people for about 12 hours. Spain had 28 megawatts of battery storage at the time of the blackout and 193 MW by April 2026.

title: Spain Extends Nuclear Plant Operations Amidst Energy Grid Instability

labels.reference_summary: IBM has completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories, adding silicon-spin qubit engineering to its quantum computing work. HRL builds quantum dots from SiGe and uses exchange only qubits, where each qubit is three electrons held in three quantum dots. HRL recently showed a digitally controlled silicon-spin machine with 54 quantum dots on three rails and up to 18 qubits, running one- and two-qubit gates and small-scale error-detecting codes. Spin qubits are made with existing semiconductor fabrication tools and operate at 1K. Jay Gambetta, IBM's Director of Research, said the HRL team brings quantum computing, sensing and networking technologies.

title: IBM Acquires HRL Laboratories to Expand Quantum Computing Research

labels.reference_summary: STARFlow2 interleaves a frozen pretrained vision-language model stream with a TARFlow stream through residual skip connections, with both streams running under the same causal mask. The design treats autoregressive normalizing flows as autoregressive Transformers that share the causal mask, KV-cache mechanism and left-to-right structure of language models. A deep-shallow flow design and a unified FAE latent space let text and visual outputs enter the KV-cache without re-encoding. Experiments cover image generation and multimodal understanding benchmarks.

title: STARFlow2 integrates language models and flows for unified multimodal generation

labels.reference_summary: The total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau. The trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased slightly over the same period. Higher natural gas prices and higher trade volume lifted that component even as the overall energy trade value declined.

title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025

labels.reference_summary: More than half of U.S. streetlights were LEDs by 2019 and that share is predicted to top 90 percent by 2030, but most installations replaced dumb fixtures with dumb LEDs and made light pollution worse. Lighting designer Simon Thorp measured two lux in Trafalgar Square and said excess light creates shadows and the illusion of safety. Cooler LEDs in the 4,000 to 6,500 kelvin range are blue-rich, scatter in the atmosphere and suppress melatonin; Phoenix converted 100,000 streetlamps to 2,700 K LEDs in 2020. France passed a law in 2019 that requires stores to switch off exterior lights after 1 a.m.

title: LEDs Could Reduce Light Pollution with Better Control

labels.reference_summary: llama.cpp tagged version 0.2.0, which begins consistent semantic versioning for the project. Tags of the form vX.Y.Z now mark stable releases recommended for downstream distribution and casual users, while b[NUM] tags continue to be created on almost every commit to master and are recommended for developers and technical users. The release names nightly build b10566 and bumps ggml to version 0.21.0. The changelog since v0.1.2 covers work across the CUDA, Vulkan, SYCL, Metal, OpenCL and WebGPU backends, the server and the web UI.

Meta is paying parent influencers and celebrities to promote its Teen Accounts, especially in countries considering a social media ban for children under 16, according to a report by the Tech Transparency Project. Indian actor Hiten Tejwani told his 732,000 followers that Instagram is okay in a paid reel, although he had barred his own twins from social media until they turned 16. Australia, Brazil and Indonesia have already banned social media for under-16s, and at least 22 other countries are designing similar policies. A November 2025 report found 64% of the 47 teen safety features it evaluated were broken, missing or ineffective.

title: Meta promotes teen safety tools globally while facing U.S. regulatory pressure

labels.reference_summary: Researchers used distributed acoustic sensing to record icequakes inside a Swiss alpine glacier, laying fiber optic cables in a grid and firing laser pulses through them with a device called an interrogator. Scattered light let the team place each fracture along the cable, turning one cable into what Thomas Hudson of ETH Zurich called thousands of strain sensors. In a week of fieldwork they detected more than a thousand icequakes. The work documents hydrofracturing, where meltwater seeps into cracks and forces the ice apart, which matters for glacier stability and sea level rise.

title: Swiss scientists use fiber optic cables to detect icequakes in glaciers

labels.reference_summary: Meta rebuilt its BLOB-storage architecture to stop storage bottlenecks from stalling GPUs. The team collapsed metadata spread across layers into one flat schema backed by ZippyDB for O(1) lookups, removed the dataplane proxy in favour of a client SDK that streams bytes directly from storage servers, and now deploys a regional stack alongside GPUs in every AI region. A distributed data cache on spare GPU host memory reaches an average 80% hit rate, and the read-plan cache returns metadata in 1-2 ms. Tiered caching with prefetching cut the cross-region ingestion wait that had cost researchers hours.

title: Meta's BLOB-storage redesign improves GPU utilization and research efficiency

labels.reference_summary: India's Cockroach Janta Party concluded on 24 August that the government had broken the deal that ended its sit-in at Jantar Mantar on 25 July. The government had agreed to the maximum possible compensation for the families of students who killed themselves after a leaked medical entrance paper, the withdrawal of police cases against protesters, and formal talks on a five-point charter for examination reform. The party says none of it has happened and used the word vishwasghaat, a betrayal of trust. It will march from India Gate to the New Delhi police headquarters on 5 September, Teachers' Day.

title: Cockroach Janta Party Reinstates Protest After Government Fails to Deliver Promises

labels.reference_summary: Data centers are projected to consume up to 12% of US electricity by 2030, and their combined water usage could increase fivefold by 2028. Between May 2024 and March 2026, $292 billion worth of projects were canceled or stalled by local opposition, $130 billion of that in the first quarter of 2026 alone. At the Data Center Dynamics conference in New York, developers ranked their priorities as speed, speed, speed, cost and only then sustainability. Cutting Power Usage Effectiveness by 16% saved $262,000 a year in one 1 MW pilot, and more than 200 bills to regulate data centers were introduced across all 50 states last year.

title: Data Center Developers Prioritize Speed Over Sustainability Amid Community Backlash

labels.reference_summary: As of February 2026 there were 75 operational carbon capture and storage projects worldwide, capturing 62.5m tonnes of CO2 a year, and almost all sit at fossil-fuel extraction and processing sites. Around three-quarters of captured CO2 is used for enhanced oil recovery. The IEA includes 1.7GtCO2 captured by 2035 in its net-zero scenario, nearly 30 times more than is captured today, and it has cut its outlook for CCS in the power sector by a third since 2021. The UK has committed up to 21.7bn pounds over 25 years to its first five projects. Critics point to low capture rates, high costs and ties to the fossil-fuel industry.

title: CCS's role in net-zero and its challenges

labels.reference_summary: Airtel streamed the Indian Premier League in 2026 with Google Cloud, delivering several hundred petabytes of egress data across 74 matches. The final match alone processed tens of billions of requests and hit a peak egress of several Tbps. Serving requests from nearby edge locations kept 99.9% of tournament traffic inside India, the cache hit ratio stayed above 98%, and p99 latency stayed under 300 ms. Joint engineering teams ran pre-tournament support readiness reviews, continuous telemetry monitoring and dedicated match-day support.

title: Airtel and Google Cloud deliver flawless IPL 2026 broadcasts

labels.reference_summary: Air pollution causes more deaths than infectious diseases, terrorism or AIDS, and costs India over five years of life expectancy, said Anant Sudarshan. Cities such as Lahore, Karachi, New Delhi and Dhaka routinely run above 100 micrograms per cubic metre a year, 20 to 25 times the WHO recommendation of 3.5 to 5, said Teevrat Garg. A large pilot emissions market run with the government of Gujarat cut factory pollution by 20 to 30% without hurting growth, because meters in the smokestack track emissions and penalties are fines that can be imposed automatically. Spraying water on roads and creating artificial rain are called distractions.

title: Economists say democracies can cut air pollution via automated emissions markets

labels.reference_summary: China's growth since 1978 came from gradualist reform, testing policies locally before scaling them nationally, rather than shock therapy, according to a review by Kaiji Chen and Tao Zha. Township and village enterprise employment grew from roughly 28 million in 1978 to 135 million by 1997, and their value added rose from under 6% to about 26% of GDP by 1996. After 1997 growth shifted to capital deepening, which accounted for more than 60% of the rise in GDP per capita. By July 2026 real estate investment had fallen 19% year-on-year, prices were down 20% from their 2021 peak, and total social financing stood at around 315% of GDP in 2025.

title: China's gradualist reforms drove growth but now fuel property slump and debt

labels.reference_summary: Project Eluna is an agentic AI model that assists operators running Amazon fulfillment centers, pulling historical and real-time data such as the states of conveyor belts or robots to anticipate bottlenecks. Four approaches ground such agents in the physical world: physics-guided deep learning, uncertainty-aware reasoning, bridging the text-to-numerical gap, and verifier-augmented grounding. The UQ4CT framework cut expected calibration error by over 25% across five benchmarks. Models post-trained with the adapting-while-learning framework reached 29 percent higher answer accuracy and 12 percent better simulator tool usage, and the Hilbert verifier showed a 422 percent improvement over the best publicly available prover LLM.

title: Amazon's Project Eluna Uses Four Approaches to Ground AI Agents in Physical Reality

labels.reference_summary: A report from the Plastic Pollution Coalition documents how the plastics industry puts lesson plans, worksheets and programs such as PlastiVan into U.S. classrooms, free or cheap. The Society of Plastics Engineers says PlastiVan has reached over 132,000 students since 2011. The American Association of Chemistry Teachers, funded by the Dow Chemical Company, has a lesson that asks students to pretend they are a Dow employee designing a plastic bag. Only 9 percent of all plastics are recycled worldwide. Katie Allen of Algalita argued against banning industry-sponsored content and said teachers should be trusted to give it context.

title: Plastic industry inserts agenda into U.S. school curricula

labels.reference_summary: Oracle is seeking two gigawatts of new renewable energy in New Mexico to offset the 2.45 gigawatts of Bloom Energy fuel cells that will power Project Jupiter, the $165-billion Stargate data center it is building with OpenAI. Local opposition over air quality, noise and water has delayed the hearing for the air quality permit, and the New Mexico Supreme Court paused the proceedings in late August. The Green Chile Project pipeline, developed by Energy Transfer, would supply roughly 400 million cubic feet of gas per day. Oracle will also publish an environmental data dashboard and spend $1 million on carbon capture research.

title: Oracle and OpenAI seek renewable energy to address local opposition to Stargate data center

labels.reference_summary: Google Cloud published its monthly roundup of AI infrastructure and orchestration updates for August 2026. Filestore now runs on a new backend built directly on Colossus, and gVisor sandboxes arrived in distributed Ray clusters on GKE through a partnership with Anyscale. A Cloud Run instance with 1 vCPU and 1 GiB of memory costs $5.70 to run continuously for 30 days. Google was named a Leader in the inaugural Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Infrastructure.

title: Google Cloud announces new AI infrastructure updates and orchestration tools for August 2026

labels.reference_summary: A paper on arXiv, Dissecting model behavior through agent trajectories, names the intent-execution gap: the mismatch between what a model intends and what its harness executes. The authors built Simple Strands Agent, a lightweight single-agent harness, and ran it on SWE-Bench-Verified with 500 examples, SWE-Bench-Pro with 731 and Terminal-Bench-2 with 89. Claude models were served via Amazon Bedrock. Model families differ in tool use preferences, so harness design is not model agnostic.

title: Research identifies intent-execution gap in AI agents and proposes solutions

labels.reference_summary: Kartik B. Athreya wrote up the Kansas City Fed symposium at Jackson Hole, Wyoming, where financial innovation in payments was the main theme. Blockchain technology can support smart contracts and tokenized deposits, but New York Fed research documents runs on stablecoins and shocks to the stablecoin market. Stablecoin adoption accelerated after the 2025 GENIUS Act. Todd Keister examined a narrow bank that offers payment and withdrawal services while leaving traditional lending to others.

title: New York Fed economist discusses financial innovation risks at Jackson Hole

labels.reference_summary: Amazon has adopted Verus, an open-source automated program verifier for Rust, to check mechanically that code matches a formal specification for all possible inputs. Developers write specifications and proofs in Rust-like syntax inside their source files, and Verus typically returns feedback in under a second. Amazon used Verus to prove key primitives in the Nitro Isolation Engine. Other projects verified with Verus include Vest, Verdict, CapybaraKV, Atmosphere, Anvil and CortenMM.

title: Amazon adopts Verus to verify Rust code correctness

labels.reference_summary: A paper titled What fits (into few tokens) doesn't overfit: Compression and generalization in ML research agents asks why benchmark hill-climbing does not produce rampant overfitting. An explorer agent optimized against a validation set, a compressor distilled the winning strategy into a short prompt, and a fresh reproducer rebuilt the strategy from that prompt alone. Across eight datasets, 32-token prompts matched the explorer on most problems, and one language-modeling strategy survived at 16 tokens. In 38 of 102 runs where agents were pushed to overfit, the gains did not survive compression.

title: Research agents avoid overfitting because successful strategies compress into few tokens

labels.reference_summary: Several companies now pay people to rent out spare computing power at home for AI inference. Far Labs, founded by Ilman Shazhaev in Abu Dhabi, is launching its Far AI platform, and John Federico's Evolving Edge in Austin, Texas is in open beta. Bless Network, Salad and Gradient started similar platforms over the last year. Far Labs cuts a model into pieces spread across devices and claims latency of 100 milliseconds or less. Evolving Edge uses the open-source tool Ray to split inference tasks.

title: Companies Launch Platforms to Rent Spare Home Compute for AI Inference

labels.reference_summary: Google added football features to Search. A Live Game Feed shows play-by-play updates, top social commentary, video highlights and AI-powered insights, marked by a red Live icon, and is available on mobile in the U.S. in English for professional football. Collegiate teams and more countries follow later this month. New stats cover passing touchdowns, rushing yards, sacks, fumbles and yards after catch. Users can link a Yahoo Fantasy or Sleeper account and ask AI Mode for lineup help.

title: Google Search adds live football feeds, stats, and fantasy integration

labels.reference_summary: Meta described how it classifies data assets so privacy controls can enforce retention, access and sharing policies. Deterministic rules resolve roughly 85 percent of production traffic in single-digit milliseconds, and an LLM handles the remaining 15 percent that is novel or ambiguous at roughly 400 times the compute cost. Three independent judge framings share one larger reasoning model, and Cohen's kappa against human-reviewed labels decides whether the tuning loop continues, widens its audit or halts. Fields masked from the LLM are also blocked from rule distillation.

title: Meta's Approach to Privacy-Aware Infrastructure Using AI for Asset Classification

labels.reference_summary: Governor Kathy Hochul imposed a moratorium of up to a year on data centers in New York that consume 50 megawatts or more, in an executive order on 14 July, the first statewide prohibition in the U.S. NYISO says the demand increase it has tracked is not yet attributable to data centers. Only 417 MW of extra power is available during typical peak demand, the lowest summer reserve margin since 2017. Since 2019, 2.9 GW of generation was added and 4.4 GW came offline.

title: New York Imposes Data Center Moratorium Amid Grid Strain

labels.reference_summary: Grist staff wrote about how climate change is altering summer where they live. Annual hot-season temperatures in parts of the United States have warmed by as much as 4 or 5 degrees Fahrenheit over the past half-century, and this past July was the hottest month ever recorded for the contiguous U.S. according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Annual precipitation in Tucson has declined by nearly 3 inches since 1970. Coastal California summertime fog hours declined by 33 percent over the last century.

title: Climate Change Is Altering Summer Traditions Across the United States

labels.reference_summary: August business surveys by the New York Fed found 61 percent of service firms and 51 percent of manufacturers in the New York and Northern New Jersey region used AI in the past six months, up from 40 percent and 26 percent last year. Only 4 percent of service firms laid off workers in response to AI, and no manufacturers did. About 15 percent of service firms hired fewer workers because of AI, while about 13 percent hired more to help them use it. Retraining remains the main adjustment.

title: Regional firms use AI to transform work rather than cut jobs

labels.reference_summary: Peak Energy, based in Colorado, says its sodium-ion cells can compete with lithium-iron phosphate batteries for grid storage. In July the company announced a $71 million, 17,000 square-meter factory near Sacramento with capacity for 4 GWh a year, due online in 2027. General Motors has partnered with Peak and tested the cells at up to 55 degrees C. Peak says its GS1.1 system retains 80 percent of capacity after 20 years and roughly 20,000 cycles. CATL agreed to supply 60 gigawatt-hours of sodium-ion cells to HyperStrong.

title: Peak Energy Aims to Revolutionize Grid Storage with Sodium-Ion Batteries

labels.reference_summary: Cheshire Academy, a private boarding and day school in Connecticut with about 400 students in grades 9 through 12, does not require instructors to use AI, but librarian and technology coordinator George Aiello says the vast majority use it in some way. Teachers use ChatGPT, Perplexity and MagicSchool to plan lessons and build grading rubrics. French teacher Miriam Przybyla-Baum has students judge which LLM edits were correct and which removed their voice. Assignments now carry green, yellow or red labels for how much AI is allowed.

title: Cheshire Academy explores AI integration strategies in education

labels.reference_summary: ON.energy argues that data center outages in Virginia were architecture failures, not supply failures. A transmission line fault in Ashburn on July 22, 2026 knocked more than 3 gigawatts of load off the grid in seconds, and two years earlier a single failed surge arrester dropped roughly 60 Virginia facilities and 1,500 megawatts at once. The company proposes moving power conditioning from 480 volts to medium voltage of 13.8 kilovolts and higher, out to modular enclosures near the substation, and into the path of every electron.

title: ON.energy proposes medium-voltage architecture to fix AI grid instability

labels.reference_summary: IEEE Educational Activities and the IEEE Power and Energy Society launched an online course program called Artificial Intelligence for Power and Energy Systems. Fangxing Fran Li, professor of electrical engineering and computer science at the University of Tennessee in Knoxville and chair of the IEEE Working Group on Machine Learning for Power Systems, developed it. Five modules cover AI fundamentals, deep reinforcement learning for grid control, forecasting, physics-informed and safe AI, and generative AI. The largest power transmission utility in Texas reported 220 gigawatts of new connection requests.

title: IEEE Course Teaches AI Integration for Grid Modernization

labels.reference_summary: The PyTorch Foundation announced on September 8, 2026 that Alibaba Cloud and Cambricon joined as Platinum members and Ant Group joined as a Gold member, alongside long-standing member Huawei. The announcement came at PyTorch Conference China 2026 in Shanghai. Platinum members receive one seat on the Governing Board and one on the Technical Advisory Council. More than 250 organizations across China contribute to Foundation projects including DeepSpeed, Helion, PyTorch, Ray, Safetensors and vLLM. Cambricon designs AI chips and accelerators.

title: Alibaba Cloud, Ant Group, Cambricon and Huawei Come Together in Shanghai to Advance the Open Source AI Stack at PyTorch Conference China

labels.reference_summary: WhatsApp is rolling out Scam Alert in Beta, an optional on-device machine learning model that warns a user about likely scam messages from non-contacts. No message content leaves the device for classification, and nothing is auto-reported to WhatsApp or Meta unless the user chooses to report it. Warning counts and user action counts are processed in confidential virtual machines and released only as differentially private aggregates. Every model version and its SHA-256 hash is published on a third-party append-only transparency ledger, with manifests signed by Cloudflare using Ed25519 keys.

title: WhatsApp Introduces Scam Alert Feature With On-Device Machine Learning and Privacy Safeguards

labels.reference_summary: Meta built an AI agent that acts as a secondary expert for a compliance domain. More than 200 knowledge files separate what the agent knows from how it reasons, and composable recipes prescribe the analytical steps. Restructuring a single flat instruction file into recipe-driven stages cut tokens consumed per turn by around 80 percent. Expert corrections are diagnosed, compiled into minimal edits, replayed and regression-tested before a human reviews the pull request. After three development sprints spanning six weeks, individual assessment time fell from days to minutes with zero regressions.

title: Meta builds AI agent that learns from experts without retraining models

labels.reference_summary: Odyssey Energy Solutions raised $74 million to expand a platform that streamlines financing of distributed renewable energy projects across Africa, Asia and Latin America. The round holds $27 million in equity from Broadscale Group, FMO and Al Mada Ventures and $47 million in debt from British International Investment and BIO. More than 6,000 solar installers and EPCs use the platform, which has helped unlock 1.5 gigawatts of projects. Co-founder and CEO Emily McAteer said the diesel price spike caused by the Iran war made solar and storage more attractive.

title: Odyssey Energy Solutions raises $74 million to scale distributed renewable energy financing

labels.reference_summary: The ratio of house prices to rents remains near historical peaks, which suggests renting today is a relatively better financial choice for housing. The FRED graph divides the all-transactions house price index from the U.S. Federal Housing Finance Agency by the CPI for rent of primary residence from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, both re-based to 100 in January 2015, and runs from first quarter 1975 to first quarter 2026. Dallas Fed researchers built a similar index and concluded that real house prices fall sharply while rents change very little.

title: High home price-to-rent ratio suggests renting is a better financial choice today

labels.reference_summary: KDDI built Buffmee, a consumer retrieval-augmented generation app that grounds answers in over 100 sources including books, magazines and web media. Working with KDDI iret and Google Cloud, the team reduced total application response latency by 38 percent and improved time to first token by nearly 18 percent. Groundedness scores rose 25 percent after the team built hundreds of automated evaluation tests. Sampling representative documents across a file format and media composition grid cut the evaluation workload by 75 percent.

title: KDDI launches Buffmee, a fast RAG app using Google Cloud tools

labels.reference_summary: Google released Mantis, an open-source harness that automates the discovery, triage, reproduction and patching of software vulnerabilities. Staff security engineers Nick Galloway and Yulong Zhang write that sloppy AI code scanning often produces hallucinated bugs with true-positive rates under 7 percent, so Mantis combines critic and review agents with sandboxed reproduction for grounding. It examines repository history to learn from past security fixes and builds a hierarchical security summary tree that reduced token overhead by over 85 percent. The code is available on GitHub.

title: Google engineers release open-source Mantis harness for automated vulnerability discovery and patching

labels.reference_summary: Data centers accounted for 5 of the nearly 31 gigawatt-hours of battery capacity installed nationally in the first half of this year, and 75 percent of the capacity installed at commercial or industrial sites, according to a report from the Solar Energy Industries Association and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence. More than 100 gigawatts of onsite gas power is planned for data centers across the U.S. Polling by the Yale Program on Climate Change Communication found 73 percent of Americans support requiring new data centers to offset their electricity use.

title: Data Centers Drive U.S. Battery Storage and Grid Solutions

labels.reference_summary: Richard Mitchell argues that organizations should design deliberate manual gates into AI-assisted work so engineers keep skills that would otherwise decay. A Harvard working paper covering some 65 million workers at more than 280,000 U.S. firms found junior employment fell roughly 9 percent within six quarters after companies adopted generative AI, while senior employment kept growing. He cites Air France flight 447, which fell into the Atlantic in 2009, and the FAA 2017 Safety Alert for Operators 17007 on manual flight proficiency.

title: Engineer argues AI efficiency risks losing future experts

labels.reference_summary: Senior Seaman Michael Coccon Johen drifted in the South China Sea for 15 hours after a free-fall parachute training exercise went wrong, and was the last of six navy special forces personnel to be rescued. A sudden change in weather severely affected visibility during the drill's second jump at 4.30pm. The team jumped from a helicopter about 10km from the island, and their parachutes stopped moving forward below 4,000 feet. They landed in the sea at about 5pm. Navy safety vessels could not reach them because the waves were too high.

title: Malaysian Commando Adrift in South China Sea After Parachute Drill

labels.reference_summary: Nathan Lambert and Florian Brand discuss the state of open models after the Kimi K3 release. They argue Chinese labs may be more capital efficient, and that chip smuggling and domestic Chinese chips have raised available compute, citing LongCat as a model trained entirely on Chinese chips. They say Ben Thompson is wrong to claim distillation matters more as training shifts to reinforcement learning, because grading millions of rollouts through an API would be slow and expensive. They warn that banning Chinese open-weight models in the U.S. would leave defenders using worse tools.

title: Nathan Lambert and Florian Brand discuss Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8, and open model progress

labels.reference_summary: President Trump issued an executive order declaring the presence of foreign-made equipment in the bulk power system a national emergency, which lets him block foreign transactions under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act. The Department of Energy must block certain new purchases from around two dozen countries, can force removal of installed equipment, and has four months to publish rules. Ben Boucher of Wood Mackenzie says 99.9% of the import values tie back to China, and that Chinese imports of large power transformers have quadrupled since 2023.

title: Trump executive order on bulk power leaves three industry questions unanswered

labels.reference_summary: Microsoft Research, the University of Washington and Providence released GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash, efficient pathology foundation models, under the Apache 2.0 license on HuggingFace. GigaPath-Flash pairs a 22M-parameter ViT-S tile encoder distilled from the original billion-parameter GigaPath encoder with a 21M-parameter LongNet slide encoder. On PANDA prostate grading and EBRAINS brain tumor subtyping it scores within 3 percent of the original GigaPath at roughly 50 times less compute. Both are research models and are not validated for clinical use.

title: Microsoft and partners release efficient GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash pathology models

labels.reference_summary: AI workloads swing power demand fast enough to damage data centre equipment and distort grid power quality. Sreemant Roy of Schneider Electric told Bloomberg News the loads cause grid instability that can lead to blackouts or power outages if not corrected. Drew Baglino, a former Tesla executive who started Heron Power Electronics, said a 1-gigawatt facility may use 1.5 gigawatts for a split second. Gas turbine engine cranks are breaking off and turbines are cracking. An AI query can use up to 10 times the electricity of a traditional Google search.

title: AI Power Fluctuations Damage Data Centres and Risk Household Grids

labels.reference_summary: The United States is expected to add more than 7 GW of wind installations in 2025, a 36 percent increase over the previous year, according to the U.S. Wind Energy Monitor report from Wood Mackenzie and the American Clean Power Association. The five-year outlook holds at 46 GW from 2025 to 2029, with 10.7 GW in 2026 and 12.7 GW in 2027. Leila Garcia da Fonseca said turbine costs remain elevated due to tariffs. U.S. onshore wind capex is projected to increase by 5 percent through 2029.

title: U.S. Wind Installations to Rise 36% in 2025, with 46 GW Expected by 2029

labels.reference_summary: The authors of AI as Normal Technology answer Derek Thompson, who accepts their case that AI labor market impacts are slow but wants extraordinary government action on AI risks. They define extraordinary interventions as precautionary, as falling on actors who did not cause the harm, and as bypassing normal governance through emergency declarations or executive orders. They argue nuclear nonproliferation was enforceable because enriched uranium is a physical bottleneck and AI has no equivalent. They call instead for resilience: broader bug bounties, AI-assisted red-teaming for schools, hospitals and power grids, and screening of synthetic biology orders.

title: AI Safety Debate: Normal Technology vs. Extraordinary Government Action

labels.reference_summary: The New York Independent System Operator imported 52 gigawatthours of electricity from Canada on July 3, 2026, the most traded between the two areas since January 2025. Some flowed along the new Champlain Hudson Power Express transmission line between Quebec and New York City, which reached commercial operations in May after three years of construction. Canadian imports fulfilled 9 percent of NYISO demand that day. Peak load reached 31,097 megawatts on July 2 at 7:00 PM. The 1,250 MW line was fully utilized on July 3.

title: New York imports significant electricity from Canada via new transmission line during heatwave

labels.reference_summary: EvoLib turns a language model's past attempts into a library of reusable skills and reflective insights, without ground-truth labels or external feedback. The library consolidates similar knowledge into more general units and reweights each unit by how much it helps on later tasks. Tests covered mathematical reasoning, writing code under efficiency constraints, and long-horizon decision making in an environment. EvoLib outperformed top retrieval-based memory approaches while using fewer tokens, and held up when the task order changed. Because it needs no model updates, it can be applied to black-box language models served through APIs.

title: EvoLib enables AI to learn from evolving knowledge

labels.reference_summary: New east-west transmission lines are Canada's top nation-building project, the Canadian Climate Institute says. Canadian provinces trade more electricity with the United States than with each other, and more than 80% of Canada's electricity trade flows south. Energy system modelling cited by the C.D. Howe Institute found that doubling B.C.-Alberta interconnection capacity would return nearly $6 for every dollar spent. More than 100 organizations asked Ottawa for $20 billion over five years to de-risk transmission projects and $5 billion for Indigenous-owned energy and grid infrastructure. A March 2026 Leger poll found 76% of Canadians support upgrading the grid.

title: Adamant calls east-west transmission lines Canada's top nation-building project

labels.reference_summary: Authorities said Monday that 903 people are confirmed dead and 4,247 are missing after a flood washed through Rasuwa, Nepal. Officials believe a glacier collapse on Langtang Lirung peak sent ice and rock into a valley, blocking the Trishuli River until the barrier gave way. In neighboring Tibet, 16 people are confirmed dead and 546 are missing, according to Chinese state media. The glacier on Langtang Lirung retreated roughly 1,500 feet between 1990 and 2020. Nepal's foreign minister Shisir Khanal asked other countries to treat climate change as a major challenge.

title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Rises as Officials Link Disaster to Warming

labels.reference_summary: Microsoft has open sourced a SymCrypt branch carrying formal specifications and machine-checked proofs for the Rust ML-KEM and SHA-3 code used in insiders builds of Windows today. New algorithms are written in safe Rust, translated by the Aeneas toolchain into a pure Lean model, and proved to refine a specification derived from the published standard. The method covers dispatch logic and platform intrinsics, compiling once per target so x86-64 and aarch64 paths merge into one model. Generated dashboards show engineers the preconditions, postconditions and remaining assumptions. AI agents draft Lean specifications and proofs, which Lean then checks independently.

title: Microsoft uses Rust, Lean, and AI to verify cryptographic code for security

labels.reference_summary: Love, Rendered is a documentary short about Burt and Ethelle Shatz, married for over 70 years, as they navigate Burt's cognitive decline. The film recreates the day they met at a student co-op in Cleveland, which was never photographed or filmed. Google DeepMind and Primordial Soup used generative models to restore black-and-white photos of the couple in their youth, then mapped their present-day mannerisms onto the younger likenesses using performance capture models. Liz Garbus directed the film and produced it with Dan Cogan and Darren Aronofsky. Ethelle sat with the team as a co-creator, correcting the curve of a staircase and the shape of a shoe heel.

title: Google DeepMind recreates 70-year love story with AI

labels.reference_summary: Stephen Hazell argues that Canada's 2026 Spring Economic Statement commits $280 billion over 10 years to subsidize pipelines, LNG terminals, nuclear plants, northern roads, mines and defence projects without impact assessment. The Calgary-based Major Projects Office assesses referred projects such as the $43.7-billion West Coast Pipeline and the $1.5-billion Mackenzie Highway, and Hazell calls it opaque and tightly controlled by the Prime Minister's Office. He notes ExxonMobil abandoned the Mackenzie Gas Project 15 years after proposing it, saving at least $16 billion in construction costs. He asks Parliament to legislate public risk assessment with independent expertise, public participation and Indigenous engagement.
